title: O VEO THO LAIKHE
firstLine: O, Veo tho laikhe hrülai jü veipu
author: Robert Great

lines: O, Veo tho laikhe hrülai jü veipu,
Puh vei khupa leshi lou soulaikhe
Etao vei rü alia vupeiyu Mapao,
Varuyu ki hinou Puhye paosho bue.
Puh nou khopeiyu, thaonou paolou süe?
Teikhai hinou süe, teiva hinou süe;
Deichi hi reitoutao, deikho hi kükoue,
Veishoyu zidzü nou kükou soushee peie.
Lülouho etao, halaiyu hrübai,
Etao nou louche Veo Ne kaolai moe;
Nevei khai koute zhuvea daizho zhou veie,
Newo eh soupei, khaipeiyu Mapaoe.
Etao Puo Ramai daizhou leshisa!
Raki vamai nou lou sousho buki;
Lülouho bu-a, Nevei basha khenou,
Checheyu nou ko-a Neye paoshowe.

title: MAPAOYE PAOSHOLO
firstLine: Khouko buyu Ramai puhye paosholo
author: F.J. Crosby

lines: Khouko buyu Ramai puhye paosholo,
Deiphao mai leshi sho-a Puh nah seipeie,
Khaipeire donou Puh mah mai süh thai peie,
Maihrülai ve louloure bosü hou peie.
Puh zhe nou hrülou-a khailu peiyu hi
Louche loumai sü khaipei laitea paopeie;
Mahmo soushoyuma Jisu lülou mai
Puh hinou khailu peiyu sü ngaolou lai.
Puh nou etaoye hali hala doupeie,
Nah Jisu vanou etao sasho bure;
Chujü nou veipu, dupuyu ngaolaihie,
Etao Jisu ngaoyuki khupa soulai.

chorus: Velo Nah Jisu vanou Puo hi velo

title: O MAI THETHE PAINOU
firstLine: O, mai thethe pai nou lou soue
author: C. Wesley

lines: O, mai thethe pai nou lou soue,
E khai-apeio pao shoe, (2 times)
A Jihovah vei dusho sü,
Puh zhuvea nou veiloue. (3 times)
Eye zhuvea süo A Mapao,
Soukhapeio ko paohi; (2 times)
Deiphao veishi paovete lai,
Nezhih avei nasü. (3 times)
Puh nou mah khouko soukho peie,
Hukha ki houpa peie; (2 times)
Puh zhe nou khüshee peilou süe,
E donou zhe kükoue. (3 times)
Noupea, lahamai Puh pai keio,
Nemü nou lou sousho (2 times)
Nghicha mai ne Mapao vere,
Phicha bumai salo. (3 times)

title: NE DAIZHOU DUE!
firstLine: A Mapao-wo Nevei khouko dushoyu
author: S.K.H.

lines: A Mapao-wo Nevei khouko dushoyu,
Paosha louhoe, choyuma sülouhoe,
Nenou souyu basha khesü ngaolou-a,
Basha khenou Nevei dusho pongaoe.
Vaokou süübe hrohi tahoyu phaki,
Raohou khenou lou souyu E nou choue,
Deichi vanou E nou zhukouyu phaki,
Reitou hi teikhai hüphiphi vewe.
Amahmo kou pokou peiloure donou,
Nah poutou sü deiphaova seivepeie;
Sasho-a nou kros vanou Amah pfüpeie,
Athao sou-a Amah donou thaipeie.
Teihao vanou Mapao nou dakhai veki,
Puhye kho-a bumai sü saloulai,
Süthaisü Apei pfünakou khurülai,
“Ne daizhou due!” tea E nou paosholai.

chorus: Ne daizhou due, Ne daizhou due. (Repeat)

title: TAVEO VEO DUPU
firstLine: Taveo he! Veo dupu, Ne zhih shore donou

lines: Taveo he! Veo dupu, Ne zhih shore donou
Eh soukhapeio; Veishoyu hrülai Puo,
Reih kolouyu Mapao,
Tave etao kho peio, Daorai ki büa.
Taveo, Mapaowo Jisu, Ne khoche polapeio;
Khoyu nou peio, Nenah khemai hapeio,
Ne chipao vetepeio,
Vepeio sheeyu Rako; Etao peihi.
Taveo, Rako Mashi, E pa chupha hinou
Nepai choulo; Khouchi shoyu nebaie,
Eye ve süthai peio;
Eye thaota peiso, Rako Mashi.
Asü nou ali sou-o, Teisa nou paosho lai,
Nevei dusho Etao ye pa ngaolo,
Teisa halouhoyu,
Neye leshilou-a, Pa khurülo.

title: ELETAO SOU PEIPU
firstLine: Eletao soupeiyu Mapaoye sholo
author: F.J. Crosby

lines: Eletao soupeiyu Mapaoye sholo,
Eletaoye thai hinou khaipeiyu
Puh dusho lou sou po-a tave tholo,
Khailu peiyu khouko buyu Mapaoe.
Eletao soupeiyu Mapao ye sholo,
Chudu süna phinou ve bailoulai;
Puh etaoye khopeiyu zhaokhoyu pue,
Kaona shoyu dzünghou hi save peie.
Eletao soupeiyu Mapaoye sholo,
Maihrülai jü kuyu raki Mapao,
Puh vei zhuvea hinou louchea pa sholai,
Teisa nou Puh leshi nou khopeilai.

chorus: Etao Mapao Veo zhih sü sholo.

title: VEO PEIRÜ RÜPEIO
firstLine: Peirü rüpeio Khrista, Vewo sü
author: Ida A. Hushower

lines: Peirü rüpeio Khrista, Vewo sü,
Teithe tsü nou Puh ye sü sholo;
Puh zhih veisü E paosho bulai,
Phateile busasü.
Showe, showe Rakivamai-a,
Veo puh hisü lounou soushowe;
Deiphao mai hrülai Puhye sholo,
Veomai pei Veowo sü.
Puh nou veiloure mahmo jünou,
Puh rako nou Eye khopeilai,
Mapao zhih nou Eh nou veiloulai,
Veo peirüsü rüpeio.

chorus: Raki buh hi lounou sou sholo;
Peirü Puhye rüpeio, Mapaoye sü sholo.

title: MASHEEO, MASHEEO, MASHEEO
firstLine: Masheeo, Masheeo, Masheeo, khouko bu Jihovah
author: R. Heber, D.D.

lines: Masheeo, Masheeo, Masheeo, khouko bu Jihovah,
Shona tashulou-a eh Neye lou sousholai;
Masheeo, Masheeo, Masheeo, leshi sü Jihovah,
Asü nou ali souyu Jihovah.
Masheeo, Masheeo, Masheeo, hrülai nou Ne thowe,
Raki vasoumai-a Neye nakou tho-a bue;
Araikhanou buwo, zhaodao koute bu-wo,
Teisa bukoutere Mapao sü Ne.
Masheeo, Masheeo, Masheeo, Azhinou holou-a,
Mahsoumai nou nevei cheche ngaoloumo yuma;
Ne likhei Masheeo süe, Ne thai Mapao ku hae
Khouko leshi chekhoyu sü Ne baie.
Masheeo, Masheeo, Masheeo, khouko bu Jihovah,
Raki deiphao Ne bahsha hrülai nou Ne sholai;
Masheeo, Masheeo, Masheeo, leshi süo Jihovah
Asünou ali souyu Jihovah.

title: ETAO VEO SÜ PAOSHOLO
firstLine: Mapao hai due, Puh nou hrülai pei khoe
author: L. Edwards

lines: Mapao hai due, Puh nou hrülai pei khoe,
Kaishu lou-a sousho loukhaio;
Puh phihi nakou lou-a tholaikhe,
Etao Veo sü paosholo.
Mapao hai due, Puh nou paoyu sü soue,
Kaishulou-a sousho loukhaio;
Deiphao hrülai Mapao nou koloure,
Etao Veo sü paosholo.
Mapao hai due, poukai nüvei poveo
Kaishu lou-a, sousho loukhaio;
Maita hrülai, velo, asa laikhe,
Etao Veo sü paosholo.
Mapao hai due, Puh zhih hai sheesho-ye,
Kaishu lou-a, sousho loukhaio;
Rakivamai, Puh vei vah shapaowe,
Etao Veo sü paosholo.

chorus: O, khailoumai hrülai leshiyu pai sü nou,
Puhvei khupayu ko, sha-a paosho peikhaio,

title: MAI HRÜLAI JISU ZHIH
firstLine: Maihrülai Jisu zhih sholo
author: Edward Perronet

lines: Maihrülai Jisu zhih sholo,
Nakoulou nou khurüo, (2 times)
Veo peirü nghoujü pokoulo.
Ramai donou thaiyu khemai
Veo peirü Puh rüpeio (2 times)
Jesse tyao sholea Puh sholo.
Deiphaova buyu mai hrülai,
Tahrü veishi panou (2 times)
Puh vei dusho sü paosholo.
Rakiva buyu maime koa,
Puh phinou ve hrülai; (2 times)
Teisa lou sü ve souzholai.

title: JESU NOU VEO SOULAI
firstLine: Jisu nou Veo soulai deiphao
author: Isaac Watts

lines: Jisu nou Veo soulai deiphao,
Khouh teinghei nou vah bu koute;
Puh vedei sü khai souyu hae,
Khou teinghei vah hamo koute.
Deiphao hi mai tahrülai nou,
Leshi lou souzhoa ko hrülai;
Nahpumai paikho koute nou
Puh zhih dusho sü paosholai.
Teisa Puh hi veachi paolai,
Paoshoyu peirü rüpeilai,
Puh zhih hai shona rathohi
Kainü veisho payu bülai.
Deiphao mai hrülai tashuloua,
Veo adusü tsükhou peilai;
Rakimai lou soupoa koulai,
Deiphao mai-a sholai, Amen.

title: VEIKAYU JISU
firstLine: Veikayu Jisu, deiphao peihi Mapao
author: Arr. R.S. Willis

lines: Veikayu Jisu, deiphao peihi Mapao,
O, Ne mainah Poutuo Ramaie;
Neye E jüpae, E Neye tsükhoue,
Ne hai Arako vei peirüe.
Veishoyu heiphao, veisho puyu vaosüü,
Khana khou poupah nou banoue;
Sükhe veishijü Jisu veipuhie,
Vealaimai Puh nou sousapeie.
Veishoyu teinai, vei puyu khei khouva,
Pei vavayu teihi vuh tao;
Jisu vavei hie, Jisu nou veihie,
Raki vamai hrülai jünou.

title: PUHYE SHOLO
firstLine: Mapao Jisu khaipeiwo sü paosho laikhe
author: F.J. Crosby

lines: Mapao Jisu khaipeiwo sü paosho laikhe,
Puhye leshi lou nou sousho laikhe;
Veikou shoyu Mapaoye sü paosho laikhe,
Zhih vei zhihko sü Jisu Khrista veie;
Zhaokhomai büa Puh nou Eye sü khopeie,
Nahtoumai büa Puh nou Eye doupeie.
Mapao Jisu khaipeio sü paosholaikhe,
Puh thaipei vanou Eye khailupeie;
Puh vanou E teisa hriyu sü ngaoloure,
Jisu kros vanou thaipei paosholo;
Eye donou veayu sounou hrülai pfüe,
Eye leshipeio paosholaikhe.
Mapao Jisu khaipeio sü paosholaikhe
Puh nou raki kikhu houpeiwure
Mapao Jisu Khristanou teisa Veo soulai,
Maihrülai pei Jisu Veo souloure;
Teideiphao hai pei Jisu nou veiloure,
Mapao Puh zhihdu paolai, hosana.

chorus: Sholo, sholo kouli veiyu Mapaoye sü
Teisa adu sü Puh vei souloutea.

title: DEIPHAO HI HRÜYU MAI
firstLine: Deiphao hi hrüyu maihrülai

lines: Deiphao hi hrüyu maihrülai,
Pai veishoa Mapao lou sousho;
Puh vahsoulo, Puh ko paolo,
Sasho-a Puh hi tavelo.
Mapao hai checheyu Ramaie,
Puh nou etao hrülai soupeie;
Eh puh zhaotue, Puh nou vaipeie,
Sasho-a Puh hi tavelo.
Sashoa loulo Puh kikhu hi,
Puh vebuh hi takou ngheilo;
Puh zhih hai teisa paosholo,
Vah süna sü etao souzüe.
Jihovah veishoyu Mapaoe,
Puh vei leshi teisa kheihaoe;
Puh chipao veishi cheche khaoe,
Teisa khai koute halaimoe.

title: ARAKO, MAPAOYE HAPEIO
firstLine: Veo adu sü sholo, Puh nou Mapaoe, Puh sholo
author: E.E. Hewitt

lines: Veo adu sü sholo, Puh nou Mapaoe, Puh sholo,
Puh vei khupa souvah donou; Puh nou
Paopei chipao hai veikhailaimoe,
Mei alia teihaonou Eye salaipeie.
Mapaowo sü sholo, khailupei donou
Puh zhenou Eye souvei peiyu donou.
Puh nou Eye khu-leshi shoyu donou,
Puh nou Avei veachi keipeiyu donou.
Mapaowo sü sholo, leshi pei vanou,
Raki hi Eye save ngheipei donou;
E Puh lülou vanou, ngaopi lai more;
Leshi mai Puh buh hinou ve koa hrülai.

chorus: Ra- (ki mai Puh sho) kimai Puh sholo,
Lou (nou sou sho khaio) nou sousho khaio,
Teisa (Puh ye sholo) Puh ye sholo,

title: KAILO, KAILO
firstLine: Kailo, kailo, ko avei lousü soukhaio
author: Charlotte G. Homer

lines: Kailo, kailo, ko avei lousü soukhaio,
Kailo, kailo, Nevei paoshoyu lou soukhaio;
Kailo, kailo deiphao hi vasü phoubue,
Raki hinou avasü vakoupei.
Deichi dei kho teitei asayu pai shusoubue,
basha veishi veilouyu lou soulo.
Dalo, dalo, lesayu husü dalo,
Paopu peikhaio, chipao veisü paopu peikhaio,
Deiphao teitei leveayu khaita mosa,
Shakhaio, kovei nasü shapu peikhaio.
Khailupei lou soulo, Rakivamai sa-a nou,
Athai ea mah jünou Puh nou koloue.

chorus: Jihovah nou veiloue, mah sii hutawure!
Salo, salo! Paisü kulo, Puhnou veiloue;
Puh ko shakhaio, deiphaomai hrülai hi,
Puh nou veloue! Salo! salo! salo!

title: DUSHOE NEVEI CHECHE
firstLine: Dushoe Nevei cheche, O! Ramai Apuo
author: Thomas O. Chisholm

lines: Dushoe Nevei cheche, O! Ramai Apuo,
Datare khu alia hae Ne hisü;
Taku tamoe, Nevei leshi, veiwu moe,
Ne chuvei büa teisa nou koutelai.
Teilü, teisai, poubo ali-a chadu,
Teinghei, khou, vuh, puletao peikou nou
Rah basha zhai ta-a zhopaoh sou-a bue,
Nevei cheche, zhuvea leshi hisü.
Mahmo khaipei-a teisa kaonayu peie,
Ne leshi nou sousapeie, süthaipeie;
Zhou vei khouko alia dosho vei areih,
Süpeinou Ne vei ha thethe E peie.

chorus: Teithetsü Nevei zhuvea E nou ngaoe;
Adonou molou shi veishi Ne nou peie,

title: PUH SHOYU LOU SOULAI
firstLine: E sayu lou soudou loure, Etao Veo paoshoyu
author: J.B. Aitchinson

lines: E sayu lou soudou loure, Etao Veo paoshoyu,
Chuo vupa peiyu khouko nou, E Puhye paosholai.
Enou kaonayu lou souwe, Teithetsü veipu pae,
Jisu nou soukaona peire, Puh nou Amah pfüpeie.
Enou leshiyu lou souwe, Ngaopi teitei hare,
Puh vei thouyu kuyu leshi Enou paoshalou hoe.
Enou lesayu lou souwe, Leshiyu kaonayu
Hanou Apaisü külyare, Süthai-a bupu hie.

title: MAIHRÜLAI THOLO IMMANUEL
firstLine: Neye thowe, Immanuel, Eh peipü nakou Ne thoe
author: D. R. Van Sickle

lines: Neye thowe, Immanuel, Eh peipü nakou Ne thoe,
Maihrülai pa Ne chi zülo, mai hrülai Ne tholai;
Neye paoshowe, Etao Mapao, raki vamai nou lou souyu
Pai alao sou khana büwe, maihrülai nou sholo,
Sholo Immanuel.
Neye thowe, Immanuel khailupei yu Nehi bue,
Deiphao hi vemai nou Neye Veo peirü peinü moe;
Daorai nou khailu louyu mai nou Ne vebuh ve sülouyuki,
Halouhoyu lou soupalai, maihrülai nou,
Sholo, sholo, Immanuel.
Neye thowe Immanuel hrishuyu Eletao Veo,
Ngaobamai jünou veiloure, Newo teisa khouko bue;
Mah, athai, meizai bupu laimoe, Saitan vei khouko souhare,
Ne zhih sü teisa shobulai maihrülai nou,
Sholo, sholo, Immanuel.

chorus: Sho (Eh nou leshiyu Veo tholo) Immanuel, Immanuel;
(tho Immanuel!) Sho (Eh nou leshiyu Veo tholo)
Immanuel! Immanuel paoshoyu alia adu nasü,
Tsüvei khouko teitei nou Neveie, teisa nou bulai,
Sho (Eh nou leshi Veo tholo) Immanuel, Immanuel;
Sho (Ehnou leshi Veo tholo) Immanuel, Immanuel,
Veo pei hinou Veowo sü, Mapao, Immanuel.

title: SHULO, SHULO, HE! ARAKO
englishTitle: Awake, Awake! O Heart Of Mine
firstLine: Shulo, shulo he! Arako, Raki bu Mapao sho
author: F.J. Crosby

lines: Shulo, shulo he! Arako, Raki bu Mapao sho;
Phateile busa lou soulo, Khaipeiyu lou soulo;
Puh nou Avei mah hai pfüpeie,
Krosva hinou thaipeie;
Puh zhe vanou Eye hrüloue, Eye khü mashee peie.
A Mapao nou E khailupeie, Teithetsü vupapeie,
Puh nou E khailu peiyu paoh, Aphao khasha louhoe;
Puh nou zhuvea peiyu vanou, Akhosü ngaoloure,
Puh nou leshi shoyu donou, Puh vebuh hi veloe.
Puh vei leshi vah hai rakimai-a süchelou hoe,
Puh vei thoushoyu leshi hai, teisa nou halaimoe;
Khupa shoyu Puh vei leshi, teideiphao hi phoupeie;
Teisa halou hoyu Ramai vei leshisü sholo.

chorus: Shulo, shulo, He! Arako, Raki bu Mapao sou sholo;
Teile busa sü lou soulo; Khaipeiyu lou soulo.
tune: Awake, Awake! O Heart Of Mine

title: CHURCH SOUSHU BUH
firstLine: Church soushu buh ali baie, süsü Mapao Jisue
author: S.J. Stone

lines: Church soushu buh ali baie, süsü Mapao Jisue,
Church hai Mapao vei bashae dzü ea chipao vanou;
Jisu nou ve Church phouloue, Puh vei souloulai tea,
Puh zhenou hrüpa loure ea Church donou thaipeie.
Tahrü kukua dolouma, hrülai sü alibaie,
Church ye khaipei louresü Mapao alikhei baie;
Sheeyu zhih alikhei baie, sheeyu touso touzhoe,
Maihrü lainou khobuyu Mapao sü alibaie.
Veayu sounou hinou mainou ngaobayu hinou,
Soutao sou hea-a kholo, teisa kaona ngaolai;
Savayu teithe laiyu zhia buyusü ngaolai,
Akhai teitheki kolouyu Church sayu ngaolai.
Asü nou ali souyu Ramai koa Church libaie,
Lülou maime ye koa, khupa sou-a vedzü yu;
Sheeshoyu A Mapao, eletaoye zhuvea peio,
Putao büa kaonasho-a neye koa hrü bailai.

title: BAHSHA
firstLine: Nghinou zhi-a ngaoche louho

lines: Nghinou zhi-a ngaoche louho,
Rateiva bu na hrülaisü;
Taidu sü moa hea khei chaomoa,
La kuku vah sou-a buwe;
Teinghei sünou chaoyu ha-a,
Teideiphao sühao-a tawe
Teithetsü vasü vapei-a,
Soupei Mapao khouko ngaowe.
Teingheinou loutayu thaisü;
Teideiphao hai maitei laiho?
Khou vasüno varu pei-a,
Deiphao maisü sousa peiwe;
Deiphao souvei shoyu kohai,
Pao-a likhei chaomoa tawe;
Deiphao mai kohai choulou-a,
Soupei Mapao sü sholai khe.
Vapeiyu khou teinghei sünou,
Dousho-a lahtayu thaisü;
Zhaoyu teivuh hrülai sünou,
Kohai paodou khai-a vapeie;
Veishoyu lüyu vasünou,
Bah tao-a lousou sholaikhe;
Hali Jihovah nou soupeie,
Teisa Puhye sü sholaikhe.

title: HA VEI DZÜLA NE VEPEIO
englishTitle: Come, Thou Fount Of Every Blessing
firstLine: Ne zhuvea lou soure donou
author: Robert Robinson

lines: Ne zhuvea lou soure donou,
Havei dzüla Nevepeio,
Zhuvea reidzü teisa themoe,
Paosho-a lou sou sholo;
Eye doupeio loukho avei,
Raki mai nou souyu lou,
Kalvary deichihi E zhue,
Leshi khaipeiyu deichi.
Liloure kros E polaloue,
Ne soukha nou E vebai,
Enou louche, Nevei jüpa
Hinou kihi veloulai;
Ramai hinou douta buki,
Jisu nou Eye phou loue,
Zhoushi hinou Puh nou vupeie,
mutei shoyu zhe vanou.
O, daizhou zhuvea paoh pfüre,
E halia khapei louhoe,
Nevei, zhaivei sü nou Atsü,
Panou Nehi phukhai peio;
Ramai thao-a motalai büa,
Atsü hinou cho-a bue,
Atsü Ale Ne popeilo,
Raki hi save khaipeio.

tune: Come, Thou Fount Of Every Blessing

title: AHRI NGAOLOURE
firstLine: Ahri ngaoloure Jisu Aveie
author: F.J. Crosby

lines: Ahri ngaoloure Jisu Aveie,
Oh, Ramai leshi daizho zhou veisa;
Khailu louyu kika ngaoloure,
Puh zhenou Eye sousheepeire.
Puhye lülouzü vayu ngaolai,
Sa vashore sü zhingao-a bure;
Reiko nou rakivamai nou kou,
Zhuvea leshi paisü shabure.
Puhye lülouzü soyu ngaolai,
E Mapao hinou vasho-a bure;
Raki hi losü zhupo-a bue,
Puh leshi nou Ale phouloure.

title: KHAI-APEIO, EH SÜTHAI PEIO
firstLine: Khai-apeio, Ne eh süthai peio
author: D. Thrupp

lines: Khai-apeio, Ne eh süthai peio,
Ne nou kho peiyu jüpae;
Poudai vei buh nou Eh kipeio,
Etao donou souda peio,
Hangao louyu Mapao Jisu,
Nenou ehye hrüloure (2 times)
Nenou etao samai soupeio,
Etao ludusa khopeio;
Eletao mah hinou vupeio,
Eh mota yuki phoupeio,
Hangaolouyu Mapao Jisu,
Etao veachi keinou peio. (2 times)
Etao salaitea paokhaire, Mahmai li soubuyu ma;
Nevei zhuvea leshi vanou, Etao mah khüshee peilai,
Hangaolouyu, Mapao Jisu Etao nehi vezhilai (2 times)
Raia ne jüpa sü eh nou phoue, Rai-a nedo sü soulai;
Alikhei bu khaipei Mapao, Ne leshi Ale phoure,
Hangaolouyu, Mapao Jisu, Ne etao leshi peire. (2 times)

title: ZHOU TEITHE RATHO TEITHE
firstLine: Zhou teithe Ratho teithe
author: John Newton

lines: Zhou teithe Ratho teithe,
Jehovah teithe vuzüe;
Südonou asolou-wo,
Jihovahye tholaikhe;
Teithe avei haina hai
A Mapao sa-a sowe. (2 times)
A Mapao nou khopei we,
Eletaoye hapeilai;
Mapao nou Alekhesü
Souvasho sahrü peilai;
Deiphao vahsü thao-a nou
Mapao Jisu sü tholai. (2 times)
Puh vulia E thao khaimoe,
Jihovah E salai peie;
Südonou maihrülai nou
Mapaoye sü tholaikhe;
Jihovah likhei cho-a
Maihrülai Puh tholaikhe. (2 times)

title: MAPAOYE KUBULO
firstLine: Mapao ko-a bulo, Puhye phü bulo
author: W.D. Longstaff

lines: Mapao ko-a bulo, Puhye phü bulo,
Teisa Puh hi bulo, Puh chipao zülo;
Khrista mai sa soulo, vea laimai sou kha-o;
Tobai sümo-a nou, Puh ha sü phoulo.
Mapao ko-a bulo, teile haloure,
Mai ngaomo buh hinou, Jisu sa kulo;
Ne Jisu zhu louzü, ne Puh büloulai,
Mainou nezhai ngaoshu, Puh zhai büa ngaolai.
Mapao ko-a bulo, Puh pa ne kholo,
Ne hata souyuma, Puh hinou taso;
Ne vei-a shi-a Puh thaifü vuzülo,
Jisuye zhulou nou Puh chisü zülo.
Mapao ko-a bulo, Puh hinou solo,
Nele, netsü teitei Puh kharo soulo;
Puh Rako Mashi nou, ne süthai peilai.
Ne pa rakihi khe, Puh kuva soulai.

title: ARAKO VEI TEINGHEI
firstLine: Arako vei teinghei Mapao
author: John Keble

lines: Arako vei teinghei Mapao,
Neye sabuki teizhi moe;
Hashi panou E holouso,
Ahi nou Ne tala peiso.
Teithe mazho hasou lounou,
Kheihi ve zhiphi tea buwe,
E nehi velouyu thaiwo,
Teisa soyu E ngaoloulai.
Teithe mazho E salai peio,
Ne molouzü E hrülou hoe;
Koukhe phahia E salai peio,
Ne samolouzü thaire pie.
Nenah lülouho mai taoli,
Ne chipao jüpa loumoa bue;
Nenou sükhemai sou kha peio,
Puhmai panou mahpu taso.

title: KRAYU NOU KHAIPEI HOE
firstLine: Kra-a bue khaipei hoe
author: R.L.

lines: Kra-a bue khaipei hoe,
Nghidzü khai kho küyuma;
E ngaopiyu halouhoe,
Ahrümai vei mah veishi,
Krayu nou khaipei hoe.
Vah nou E khaipei hoe,
Veishoyu Avah sünou;
Sheeshoyu Atsüdo nou,
Arako soushee louhoe,
Vahnou E khaipei hoe.
Lü vanou khaipeilai,
Mapaoye E louchelai,
Puh vah khe E louchelai,
Puh soukha nou hrülou süe,
Lü vanou khaipeilai.

title: HASÜ TEIRÜ BÜA KOUPEILAI
englishTitle: There Shall Be Shower Of Blessing
firstLine: “Hasü teirü büa koupeilai”
author: El. Nathan

lines: “Hasü teirü büa koupeilai”,
Haisü leshi vei chipaoe,
Lesa shoyu teile velai,
Mapao nou seive peilai.
“Hasü teirü büa koupeilai”,
Soukai souhri pupeilai;
Deichi deikho buh hrülai hi,
Leshi hasü rükou peio.
“Hasü teirü büa koupeilai,”
Mapao Ahi seikou peio,
Ekhemaiye sou makai peio,
Ne chipao züre donou.
“Hasü teirü büa koupeilai”,
Oh! zhou teithe nou koupeio,
Chu nou Jisu nehi kho-we,
Mapao Ahi seikou peio.

chorus: Ha rükou peiwo, Ekhemai pei ha koupeio.
Leshi nou rükouyu ha sü, Eh jüpa shoa nou khowe.
tune: There Shall Be Shower Of Blessing

title: ARAKO POKUPEIE
firstLine: Khupa shoyu Avei Mapao hai Jisu-e
author: F.J. Crosby

lines: Khupa shoyu Avei Mapao hai Jisu-e,
Khupa sho-a E khailupeie;
Puh shou khe nou Arako hai pokupeie,
Halou hoyu dzü Puh hi bue.
Khupa shoyu Avei Mapao hai Jisue,
Puh nou akou hai southea peie;
Puh soukha hai Enou teisa ngaobulai,
Teisa khouko Puhnou peiveie.
Phousha louhoyu ha Puh nou Ahi peie,
Puh rako nou Ahi phou bue;
Raki kheyuki Mapaoye sousholai,
Sühinou ve Puhye daolai.

chorus: Puh shou khe nou Arako hai pokupeie,
Ahrü pokupeie, Puh leshi shou khe nou,
Puh bah nou E khosa laipeie,
Puh bah nou E khosa laipeie.

title: ZHOU ARAKO VALI NGAOE
firstLine: Zhou Arako vali ngaoloue, Teinghi jünou vaveie
author: E.E. Hewitt

lines: Zhou Arako vali ngaoloue, Teinghi jünou vaveie,
Va shoyu Jisu vasünou, Chuo Avei va soure;
Zhou Arako lou ali choue, Veo hi soushoyu lou;
Jisu nou lousü kei-a bue, E nou soulouho loue.
Zhou Arako vasho-a bue, Mapao ngheive donou;
Alehi kaonayu lou soue, Zhuvea poupa sü pah-e.
Zhou Arako sasho bure, Puh vah ngaolou vanou
Puh nou E ha peiyu donou Raki khevuzülai.

title: KHAIPEIYU, KAONA, KHOUKO
firstLine: Mapao zhih hinou le salo, Teisa Puhye sholo
author: EL. Nathan

lines: Mapao zhih hinou le salo, Teisa Puhye sholo;
Puh chipaohi chemoyu hae, Mapao tsüdusho bue.
Mu ali-a pomoa Puhnou Avei mahmo khaipeie
Süthemoa nou kaonayu-a Eh khemai hisü peie.
Leshi, zhuvea louyu veishi, Mapao Jisu hi bue;
Le kaonayu sü Mapaonou, Eh khemai hi thoupeie.
Deiphao ashi athao jünou, Eh khemai veiloure;
Mapao Ne kilai khemai nou Asayu ngaoloure.

title: BAIBEL KEI TSÜLO
firstLine: Haku khe thaokhaima Baibel pobulo
author: M.J. Smith

lines: Haku khe thaokhaima Baibel pobulo,
Mutei shoyu Puh chi khesü zülo,
Sünanou zhia buyu rako soukaipeie,
Hriloure chipaokhe Baibel hi bue.
Muteishoyu Baibel chitaosü zülo
Baibel nou teisa hriyu rako peie;
Baibel chi büa veiyu ko kukhe lia hae,
Arako ne Baibel hasü phoulo.
Mo-a laimai Baibel nou du ngaopeiwe;
Nahlemaiye süthai salai peiwe;
Mah hinou vea bumai le sousa peiwe,
Baibel veikae, süsü tsümai sühpoe.

chorus: Baibel nou ne raki du ngao peilai.

title: MAPAO NOU SÜTHAI PEIWE
firstLine: Mapao nou E süthai peiwe, E nou dai khopu loulai?
author: F.J. Crosby

lines: Mapao nou E süthai peiwe,
E nou dai khopu loulai?
Ahrü Puh nou khopei donou,
Puh hi E letsü laiwu?
Raki hi kaona, savayu,
Lüva nou Puh sahrülai
E nou süe, tarali vema
Jisu nou souvei peilai, (2 times)
Mapao nou E süthai peiwe
Aphi kapa hi khopeie;
E nou veayu ki soukha peie,
Hriyu raokhao nou vaipeie;
E zhoushi shoyu daoyuma,
Arako nou reiyuma,
Chuhdu dzüla hinou küloue
Sayu dzüla sü E ngaoe. (2 times)
Mapao nou E süthai peiwe,
Phou buyu Puh vei leshi;
Teisa soyu Ahi paopeie,
Raki A Puo buh hinou;
Arako nou thailai moyu,
Shou pfü-a zhaota loulai;
Khai koute Avei lou soulai,
Jisu nou E süthai peie. (2 times)

title: HAIRE EH SOUZÜ VAH-E
firstLine: Veayu mai souvayu, maile sousayu
author: F.J. Crosby

lines: Veayu mai souvayu, maile sousayu,
Süsü E souyu phae, Süsü etao vah,
Vaohi nou taho hayu maiye phouyu,
Asasho puletao kihi savelai.
Lero ali sou-a vah souzho laikhe,
Kaoyu mai phao shupeio, Jisu zhih hinou;
Vea laimaiye sü taho samai soupeio,
Süsü Mapao nou jüpayu vah nasüe.
Mapaoye lü-a nou nghoujü takoulo,
Paokhaitou buu nasü eh zhupo takoue;
Sabanü vei thouloua kivei hinou bua,
Mapao nou kho bue, teisa shore buh hi.

title: JISU LIKHEI
firstLine: Teihao nou E holouyuma, Elikhei tabuyuma
author: Hattie M. Conrey

lines: Teihao nou E holouyuma, Elikhei tabuyuma
Jisu nou E salai louzü, Sayu nou paohao louhoe
Jisu hai Avei soulouzü, Süjü nou muteiyu hae,
Puh nou teinghei büa vapeilai,
Puh hai Bethlehem teivue.
E nou deiphaohi hrübuki, Leveayu nou Ahi daoe;
Rako hriloure tsü dosü, Mapao nou Eye peilai;
Jisuye samai soulouzü, Puh leshi sü E ngaolai;
Puh hai zhaivei deikho poupae,
Zhaiveiyu Sharon poupae.
Tarayu Asa khemai sü, Nai teitheli ve daolai;
Deiphao hi ashi vakhemai, Thao-a nou raki velai;
Jisu likhei nou Asamai, Lou ali nou souzholai;
Jisuye tho-a lou soulai, Süthaisü asa sholai.
Enou nuh sühi kheyuki, Romü hinou labu-a;
Jisuye Enou lalouzü, Sana romü houpeilai;
Raki hi khe lou souyuki, Raki vamai E ngaolai;
Jisu zhih kua E lou soulai, Sasho-a E lou soulai.

title: EH VEO NGHOUJÜ LALAI
englishTitle: We Shall Stand Before The King
firstLine: E Veo nghoujü ve lalai
author: E.O.E.

lines: E Veo nghoujü ve lalai,
Raki mai sa lou soulai, Teitheli, ... teitheli,
Sana luduhi talai,
Teisa puhye sü sholai, Teitheli, ... teitheli.
Rakiva hu sü dalai,
Eh Veo nghoujü ve lalai, Teitheli... teitheli;
Sühi levea ngaolaimoe,
Puh zhih sü tho-a bulai, Teitheli... teitheli.
Arako Puhye tholo,
Ne Veo nghoujü ve lalai, Teitheli... teitheli;
Ne Puh phihi velalo,
Puh zhai büa ne takoulo, Teitheli... teitheli.

tune: We Shall Stand Before The King

title: PHIKA LIBAIE JISU HI
firstLine: Jisu hi vere phika libai, daisou vemoe?
author: F.J. Crosby

lines: Jisu hi vere phika libai, daisou vemoe?
Tave ne mah sü paolo, khailupei Mapao hi.
Jisu hi vere phika libai, Puh ye lülo,
Puh nou neye kho-a bue, nemah sü khaipeilai,
Mah hinou leshi hisü koure phika libai,
Nenou chuo daitsü chobue, phasü hayu laire.
Jisu hi vere donou ne daisou nou paomoe?
Mapao Nevei soulai tea Avei sü peikhaire,

chorus: Puh leshi hinou nenou tala tapu khaiso.

title: TEILE NOU TA-A BUKI
englishTitle: While The Days Are Going By
firstLine: Vealaimai le sousa peilai, teile nou ta-a buki
author: George Cooper

lines: Vealaimai le sousa peilai, teile nou ta-a buki,
Molaiyu rako taoli bue, teile nou ta-a buki;
Etao nou lesasho-a, veidu süna talouzü,
Etao vah souchelou süe, teile nou ta-a buki.
Hikei-a buyu teile hae, teile nou ta-a buki,
Ne zhusü shona büa valo, teile nou ta-a buki;
Oh deiphao buh hai hisü, veayu, krayu nou phoubue,
Soulapeio, kaotayu mai, teile nou ta-a buki.
Leshi rainou phukhai touyu, teile nou ta-a buki,
Alinou liye thaotalai, teile nou ta-a buki;
Ana vukhaiyu thoutai, teitheli paopa khailai,
Süki etao lesalai, teile nou ta-a buki.

chorus: Takoure teile sü, Takoure teile sü,
Etao vahvei souloulai teile nou ta-a buki.
tune: While The Days Are Going By

title: KHOPEIYU RAKO MASHEE
firstLine: Khopeiyu Rako Mashi, Khrista maiye ko-a bue
author: M.M.W.

lines: Khopeiyu Rako Mashi, Khrista maiye ko-a bue,
Veayu deiphao vei duhi, Ne bah nou süthai peiwo;
Veayu Rako nou shawe, Puh vei paisü choulou-a
“E nou ne süthai peilai, Athai fülo” tea paowe.
Ne checheyu Asamaie, Eye ne nou soukha peio,
Maiteiyu piyu buh hi, Eye thaokhai moa zhupeio;
Zhou ashi veyu phakia; leavea buyu phaki-a,
“Enou ne süthai peilai, Athaifülo” tea paowe.
Avah sou cheyu phaki, E thaitayu phaki-a,
Azhih hai rükhai touyu, Enou louche -a buwe;
Mapao-wo Jisu zhenou, Eletaoye khüshee peio,
“Enou ne süthai peilai, Athaifülo” tea paowe.

title: JISU KOH SÜPU NÜE
firstLine: Jisu veiko E süpunüe
author: E.E. Hewitt

lines: Jisu veiko E süpunüe,
Puh nou khaipeiyu ko khemai,
E donou thai peiyu kosü,
Mai khemai hi paongao peinüe.
Jisu vei mashee lelihai
Eye panou süpu louwo;
Rako Mashi Ne E doupeio,
Jisu ko pa E süpulo.
Mapao Jisu khouko vebuh
Sükhemai cholou E khupae;
Mapaoye koa teisa hrünüe,
Maiye panou Puh mai sounüe.
Jisu vebuh ko E sünüe,
Paosha louho kini Puhveie;
Puh vedei hai dusho pulai;
Kaonayu Veo soua Puh velai.

chorus: Jisu ko süpunüe, Jisu ko süpunüe;

title: ZHIH AVEI
firstLine: Jisu zhih hai ne poa bulo
author: Mrs. L. Baxter

lines: Jisu zhih hai ne poa bulo,
Levea mado bukhemai;
Sünou neye sou sapei lai,
Süna teisa koa talo.
Teisa nou Jisu zhih polo,
Zhih sünou nerü soulo;
Thaoshi nou ne sühaolou zü,
Sheeyu zhihsü kua kholo.
Oh! Jisu zhih hai daizhou veie,
Zhih hai chouloua Ale sae;
Puh nou Eye ve sayuki,
Lou sou poa puh sa zhaolai.
Jisu zhih nou nakou lou-a,
Mapao phinou khurülo;
Veopei Veo peirü Puh peilai;
Etao veihdu tachethai.

title: KEIO! ARAKO
firstLine: Keio Arako! Raki vamai nou lou soue
author: F.W. Faber

lines: Keio Arako! Raki vamai nou lou soue,
Deiphao teitei, zaipe veishi süve;
Daizhou veisa hangaolou mainou paoyu,
Hrüshee nahi mahmo bupu laimoe.
Dousho-a nou hudayu büa chouvere,
Jisu paisü buliki süvere;
Kousüyu rako thethe kaona ngaoloue,
Zhaokho-wo nou nevei vea souha peie.
Raki mailou choulou Eh nghoujü ta koue,
Veayu khemai velo Jisu nou kue;
Veahoyukia thaokhai moa neye labue,
Ko avei pai nou Eh ki save peie.

chorus: Rakivamai ne ko-a nou lou soulai,
Etao hi-a raki lou soungao peio;
Khei hi krayu hai , shona pa habailai,
Hrü phao lereiyu lesha ngao loure.

title: NE VEWE
firstLine: Ne vewe! Oh E khai-a peio, Ne vewe Oh, Amapao!
author: F.R. Havergal

lines: Ne vewe! Oh E khai-a peio, Ne vewe Oh, Amapao!
Ne zhih hinou mah paopalou-a etao sashoa lou soue;
Ne vewe! Savayu ava sü athai jü koloure,
Chu-o etao veihdu sü sapure Ne nghoujü hinou,
Ne vewe! khu dayu moe, teirü moe, alia nghidzü moe
Mahmo alia veayu moe, teinghei nou pa varu buwe;
Ne vewe! Mapao Jisu velaiyu daizho lesae,
Oh! daizhou khupa sousa Puh vea sü nou vupa peire.
Ne vewe! Etao khobue, veikhai moyu areih nasü,
Ne vere teile sümoe Etao lüvanou kho-a bue;
Ne vewe! Ne ve vuzü laitea Etao nou zhopao soue,
Etao nou Neye vedao louthai sava sho-a hrülai.

chorus: Ne vewe! Eh nou Neye Nevei ludu hinou ngaolai,
Ne vewe! Eh Ne ngaolai, sü teithe hi eh Ne railai;
Ne vewe! Jisu Ne vewe, Eh nou leshiyu Mapao,
Oh! Sashore Nenou khopeiyu ngaoloue Neye thowe.

title: LE KAONA SHOYU JISU
firstLine: Lekaona shoyu Jisu, Nah toukhemaiye zhupeio
author: Charles Wesley

lines: Lekaona shoyu Jisu, Nah toukhemaiye zhupeio
Lelou hoyu E zhupeio, E Nehi tave louwe.
Mapao E nehi vewe, Mapao ne eh ngaipeiso;
Nevei zhuvea vedei sü, Nahtou khe hisü peikhaio.
Ramai zhaotu E ne zhue, Ne Ahrü pao nada lai;
Ne hai le kaonashawe, Teile lihi ne-a nahmaie.
E ne zhai dou-a hrülai, Mai chizüyu Ahi peio;
Ne hai mai leshi süshoe, E ne büa le kaonalai.
Leshi-a buyu Jisu, Mai leshi süyu bahnou;
Khailupeio ne zhuvea nou, Ne Alekhe lou bu peio.

title: SAVAYU SÜ JISU HI PEIO
firstLine: Savayu sü Jisu hi peio
author: I.D.S.

lines: Savayu sü Jisu hi peio,
Jihovah nah Puotu süe,
Puh zhuvea nou etao khailoue,
Vah veishi souche peire.
Chaolai-a veayu teithe hi,
Avasü ngaolai tea choe;
Veayu veishi thailo bure,
Jisu hai etao khoukoe.
Puh nou veitou-a pokupeie,
Puh shoukhe nou pokhaipeie,
Sasho-a Puh leshi hi bue,
Arako Puh lou soulo.

title: MASHEEO SÜ MAPAOE
firstLine: Masheeo, masheeo, Masheeo sü Mapaoe
author: F.J. Crosby

lines: Masheeo, masheeo, Masheeo sü Mapaoe,
O! deiphao mai lousoua Puhye tholo;
Deichi dua Puhye ngaopeilo,
Deichi-a Puh nghoujü asalo,
Tsü veikayu, zhuvea nou khaihapu,
Duka Jihovah, hrülaipei Veo.
Puhye sholo, arasou shalo,
Zion khoyu pu, chipao vei paopeio;
Mah ea athai Puh nou souhalai,
Deiphao teitei Puh dusho paolai;
Puh sho, rakivamai Puhye zhulo,
Puh adusho nou zhao büa noulo.
Khaihayu Veo Puh zhih veilou theo
Puh nahkhemai nou sashoa Puh tholo;
Raki nou etao sazho phaki,
Etao peirü Puh hi poveki,
Sühi nou Puh zhai büa sashoa bulai,
Etao nou Puh ngaolai, lou soulai.

title: DOA, ZHOU-A TEISA
firstLine: Daizho zhou veishoyu chisü Baibel hi busa
author: Rev. A.B. Simpson

lines: Daizho zhou veishoyu chisü Baibel hi busa,
Do-a zhou-a teisa nou Jisu sü kheihao baie,
Puh nou mahmaiye leshie, sounou mai sou veipeie,
Do pfü laimai sousa peie, Puh zhih sü paosholo.
Jisunou mahmai hrülai kuwe, Puhhi velo,
Mahmai tao Puh hi velo, tave Mapao tholo;
Puh nou paodou peie, “Ta-wo, alia mah soupuso”,
Puhnou kuyu pai keilo he! Mah sou bu khemai.
Jisu nou Peter masü khaipeie, ne-a piso,
Puh nou Thomas hi paopeie, ne lekiyu buso;
Jisu Khrista nou Puh thaifümai hrülai leshie,
Chukoute ne kho-a bue, Puh hi tako vülo.

chorus: Do-a, zhou-a, teisa Jisu-wo rai büa bubaie,
Na veishi hakhailai, Jisuwo hakhai laimoe;
Puh zhih paosholo, Mapao Jisu zhih,
Nah veishi vuli ha khailai, Jisu halaimoe.

title: BAIBEL HAI CHECHE
englishTitle: I Know The Bible Is True
firstLine: Jihovah nou peiyu Baibel hai
author: G. Routh

lines: Jihovah nou peiyu Baibel hai,
Cheche chitea Enou süe;
Sühi rako hriloure chi bue,
Baibel hai cheche vuzüe.
Jisu Khrista ko khesü cheche,
Puh nayu, Puh hrüyu ko;
Puh thaia hrishu louyu ko cheche,
khaive laiyu ko cheche.
Cheche shoyu Baibel ko haire,
Mai kukhe hi paosü peio;
Puletao nou ko hai choulouzü,
Baibel cheche tea sülai.

chorus: Enou, süwe, Baibel hai cheche vuzüe;
tune: I Know The Bible Is True

title: A MAPAO NOU SÜTHAI YULO
firstLine: Mapao nou süthaiyu hilo
author: F.J. Crosby

lines: Mapao nou süthaiyu hilo,
Azüpa veishi ngao chelai;
Puh vei leshi hinou bu-a,
Eh Puhye ko-a talai,
A ludu zhi-a buyu ma,
Aphika vea-a buyuma;
Puh leshi nou E souva peie,
E puhye ko-a talai.
E deiphao tachoyu phaki,
Puh nou E kihi save lai;
Reipe hi bumai vedaolai,
E Puhye ko-a talai.

title: DAISOU NOU KHO-A BUE?
firstLine: Asana daisou khobue?
author: G.F.R.

lines: Asana daisou khobue?
Oh! Daisounou ne chao-a bue!
Ne Mapao nou peilaitea khobue,
Sheeshoyu Puh vei buh hinou.
Asana ne daio reih bue?
Chaoyu vanou ne dai ngaolai?
Jisu moa nou khaipeire maihae,
Jisu moa ludu kukhe hae.
Asana ne sümo wu?
Puh rako chu lounü-a bue,
Daisou nou Puhye aetou lou-a,
Ne mahmo kou pokou moa bue?

chorus: Daisou donou Puh hi chu vemoa bue?
Daisou donou Puh hi chu vemoa bue?

title: MAPAO PAOSHOLO...
firstLine: Mapaoye lou nou sousho-a Puh tholo
author: F.J. Crosby

lines: Mapaoye lou nou sousho-a Puh tholo,
Sashoa etao veachi paoki hi louki;
Etao du khopeiyu Mapao Puh sholo,
Khei hea etaoye kaona khopei-a bue.
Puh zhih adu hinou, Puh khouko sholo,
Puh bahsha deiphao hinou, Puhye sholo;
Etao nou Puhye veo peinou Veo tea süe,
Etao Puh shou khe nou kaona bailou süe.
Cheche hinou Mashee-o Puhye sholo,
Puh nou souyu vah khesü seira tapeio;
Puh nou thaipei vanou deiphao sü asae,
Venüyu maisü Puh hi ve asolo.

chorus: Teisa zhuvea nou phoubue, Puh ludu sa,
Puh likhei etao nou shoyu ngaozü baie.

title: NEHI NGHEIVEWE
firstLine: Teisa Avei soure sü Ne
author: F.J. Crosby

lines: Teisa Avei soure sü Ne,
Samai jünou mutei hie,
E nou tayu veihdu sasü,
Mapao E Ne koa talai.
Deiphao hi savayu nou moe,
Zhih avei li donou moe,
Sasho-a veayuma soulai,
Eye pa Ne koa talo.
Athai ludu hi palouso,
Kaoshi hinou E vupeio,
Süthaisü ahri romü hi,
Mapao E ne koa loulai.

title: SHEESHAYU DZÜLA
firstLine: Sheeshayu dzüla mah donou houpeie
author: Rev. Newman Hall, D.D.

lines: Sheeshayu dzüla mah donou houpeie,
Mah hinou leveamai ve khüshilo;
Veayu hinou Khai-apeiwo Jisu,
Eye khü peio, E vüra jü kaalai.
E vah southai nou soukhai soukhai ma,
E la khüsheeyu hai hako baire;
Leveayu hi Khai-apeiwo Jisu,
Eye khüpeio, E vüra jü kaalai.
Ne Atsüle soushee peio tea khowe,
Ne vei vanou Eye souva pupeio;
Teisa leshi hinou paoyu zülai,
Eye khüpeio, E vürajü kaalai.
Vüra jünou kaayu E jüpa kae,
Khrista nou dzülae, sülikhei jüpae;
A Mapao Jisu E nehi velai,
Eye khüpeio E vürajü kaalai.

title: PUH MUTEI SHOE
firstLine: Soushee louyu le hai Mapao vei rathokie
author: F.J. Crosby

lines: Soushee louyu le hai Mapao vei rathokie,
Sühi nou Eh Puh daoloue,
Oh, sashoe Etao Puh zhih nou vejü yuki,
Veachi paoyu teile hi.
Dushoyu ava hai Rakiva hinou koue,
Eh nou bo phouha buki,
Puh leshiyu sü Puh nahmai nou ngaoloulai;
Puh hi takou nghei louzü.
Puh nou süthai yulo, Etao thaifü yuki,
Etao le asasholai;
Lü vanou eh süe halou hoyu Puh bao nou,
Etao ye kho-a bupeie.
Zhuvea alia cheche hinou koa hrülaikhe,
Savayu halaimoyu,
Veo buh hinou Eletao vedaomo koute,
Kaona-a hrüzho laikhe.

chorus: Jisu hai mutei Puh lü lou mai donou,
Puh polou mai hrülaihi Puh mutei shoe;
Oh, etao Puh ha ngaolai Puh zhih nou
Vejüyuki Puh nou veachi kei peilai.

title: E NE DONOU VEACHI PAOWE
firstLine: Deiphao haihi A samai hayuma
author: S.O. Malley Clough

lines: Deiphao haihi A samai hayuma,
Eye leshiyu khailupei Mapao libue;
Chuwo Puh nou Eye leshi sho-a zhubue,
Oh A Mapao sü nevei-a soulou veie.
E A-Puo libue Puh nou E leshie,
Teisa halouho acheche sü Puh nou peie;
Raki teidei Puhnou E sakhelai,
Ana Puh nou ne-a sühi save peitheo.
Ahi reidzü büa kaona shoyu bue,
Sünasü deiphao hi samai linoa sümoe;
A Mapao likhei nou süna pei lousüe, oh!
Nehi-a peiremoe E-a sülounüe.
Jisu nou neye phoulouyu kosü,
Paopei khaio, A Mapao sü nevei soulou veie,
Putao donou Mapao hi veachi paopei-o,
Ne veachi hai Mapaonou keinou peilai.

chorus: Ne donou veachi paoe, Ne donou veachi paoe;
Ne donou veachi paoe, E ne donou paoe.

title: VEACHI PAOYU PHA VEISHOE
englishTitle: Tis The Blessed Hour Of Prayer
firstLine: Veachi paoyu pha veishoe, Leveayu phaki hi
author: F.J. Crosby

lines: Veachi paoyu pha veishoe, Leveayu phaki hi,
Eletao Mapao Jisu hi vejü-a bue
Etao Puh hi velouzü; Puh nou Eh kho peilai,
Levea yu mai salou lai, Puh phayu daizhou veie.
Veachi paoyu pha veishoe, Mapao hi veyuki;
Putao nou leshiyu pai Puh hinou choulai,
Puhnou veyu phakisü, E Puhye ve daolai;
Leveayu mai donou veie, Puh phayu daizhou veie.
Veachi paoyu pha veishoe, Eye thaoyu phaki;
Khailupei Puh nou vealai maiye souna peie,
Leshi shoyu Puh bah nou, Anghidzü southepeie,
Leveayu mai salou lai, Puh phayu daizhou veie.

chorus: Puh phayu teile daizho zhou veishoe,
Leveayu mai salou lai, Puh phayu daizhou veie.
tune: Tis The Blessed Hour Of Prayer

title: JISU EYE SÜTHAI PEIO
firstLine: Jisu Eye süthaipeio, Ngaopi hashi zaipeisü
author: Edward Hopper

lines: Jisu Eye süthaipeio,
Ngaopi hashi zaipeisü,
Dzüdu nou Anghoujü bue,
Ngaopiyu nou sühao bue;
Bahsei vei sü Nehi bue,
Jisu Eye süthai peio.
Pfü nou nah souzüyu büa,
Teikhai teirü sü khuloue;
Teikhai-a Nechi züre,
Dzüdu-a Nero soure,
Nenou ‘Baio’ tea pao vanou;
Jisu Eye süthai peio.
E zaipe hi kouyuki,
Ngaopi nou Ahi veki;
E Ne phi nou bailoulai,
Mapao nou Ahi paolai;
“Pikhaiso, E ne salai”,
Sübüa E süthai peilo.

title: E KOA BUPEIO
firstLine: E koa bupeio, teingheisü lou tare
author: H.F. Lyte

lines: E koa bupeio, teingheisü lou tare,
Tei-a zhitare, Mapao koa bupeio;
Maikukhe nou sou khaba thaota-a,
Vea laimai Mapao Ne Ekoa bupeio.
E mai hrühai phajütou donou baie,
Deiphao sayu vayu hata bailai;
Enou ngaoyu na veishi datalai,
Dalai moyu Mapao E koa bupeio.
Veomai pei Veo büa Ahi vepeiso,
Ana zhuvea leshi hinou vepeio;
Nenou nghidzü koua mah mai pai keipeie,
Veo, mahmai samai ne E koa bupeio.
Phabusa nou Eye ko-a bupeio,
Ne zhuvea vanou athao kolou süe;
E khopeire Ne büyu mailia hae,
Khei hea thaokhai moa Eye koa bupeio.
Ngaoba mai pimoe, Ne koa bulouzü,
Kou sü-a nghidzü kouyu ngaolai moe;
Athai kei, khüh vei koyu daiki bue?
Nenou kobulouzü E vei lousüe.

title: TEISA CHUHDU
firstLine: Teisa Chuhdu E kupeio, E pa Ne hinou bailo
author: A.M. Toplady

lines: Teisa Chuhdu E kupeio, E pa Ne hinou bailo;
Netu hinou kü kouyu, dzü alia Ne zhe sünou;
A mahmo hai khailupeio, Eye sü soumashee peio.
Abah nou souyu vahnou, Ne jüpa souche louhoe;
Hatali sou-a bu-a, Nghidzü teisa kükou-a;
Amah hai khüshi louhoe, Khailu peirepu sü Ne.
Abah hi halia pomoa, Ne Kros phi hinou vüwe;
Baitou-a Nehi vewe, Ne zhuvea E zhi-a bue;
Mapao Amah khüshee peio, Molouzü E thaishulai.
Ahrirai hai talouzü, Apfüphao hai thaitalai;
Süthai raki zhaokhelai, Neye sünou ve daolai;
Teisa Chuhdu, E kupeio, E pa Ne hinou bailo.

title: TEISA CHUHDU (II)
firstLine: Teisa Chuhdu E kupeio (lo)
author: A.M. Toplady

lines: Teisa Chuhdu E kupeio (lo),
E pa Ne hinou bailo (oh),
Netu hinou kü kouyu( zhe),
Dzü alia Ne zhe sünou (oh);
A mahmo hai khailupeio (Ne),
Eye sü soumashee peio (lo). (2 times)
Abah nou souyu vahnou (E),
Ne züpa souche louhoe (E),
Hatali sou-a bu-a (ma),
Nghidzü teisa kükou-a (bua);
Amah hai khüshi louhoe (E),
Khailu peirepu sü Ne (bai). (2 times)
Abah hi halia pomoa (nou),
Ne Kros phi hinou vüwe(E);
Baitou-a Nehi vewe(E),
Ne zhuvea E zhi-a bue (oh);
Mapao Amah khüshee peio (lo),
Molouzü E thaishulai(Ne). (2 times)
Ahrirai hai talouzü (oh),
Apfüphao hai thaitalai (oh);
Süthai raki zhaokhelai (E)
Neye sünou ve daolai (E)
Teisa Chuhdu, E kupeio (lo),
E pa Ne hinou bailo (oh). (2 times)

title: JISU SAMAI SOULOUYU
firstLine: Jisu samai soulou vanou, Amahsü khümashee peie
author: J. Scriven

lines: Jisu samai soulou vanou,
Amahsü khümashee peie,
Daizhou veie Puh hi veyu hai,
Mapao nou E kho nou peie;
Kaonayu ngaoloumo buyu,
Oh! Hakonou E veabaie;
Puh hi pfüve modonou baie,
Veachi paoa Puh hi velo.
Etao hi thao ashi ve-wu ?
Buh takia veayu daowu?
Etao lühai khaita laimoe;
Veachi paoa Puh hi pfüveo,
Checheyu samai sü Puh bai,
Thaonou kou pfükha peilai?
Jisu nou süe Etao veayu,
Veachi paoa Puh hi pfüveo.
Eletao kousü-a buwu?
Etao do pfü-a laiwu?
Mapao chu koute baiyu buh-e,
Veachi paoa Puh hi pfüveo,
Samai nou neye thao louzü,
Mapao hi tave paopeio;
Puh bahnou nerü soupei lai,
Sübüa ne sayu ngaolai.

title: TEISA E NEYE KOWE
firstLine: Teisa Neye kowe, zhuvea Mapao
author: Mrs. A.S. Hawks

lines: Teisa Neye kowe, zhuvea Mapao,
Nepai büa kaonayu, peire mai hae,
Teisa Neye kowe, Ahi bupeio,
Nenou koa bulouzü, athao vehoe.
Teisa Neye kowe, Sa-a vea-a,
Ne thara vemozü, hrühai hakoe.
Teisa Neye kowe, doupeio Netsü,
Nenou paokhai touyu, Ahi vepeio.
Teisa Neye kowe, Oh, Mashee-o!
Eye Nevei soupeio, Oh, Ramai nah.

title: E NEVEIE O! MAPAO
firstLine: E Nevei Mapao, E Ne pai chouloue
author: F.J. Crosby

lines: E Nevei Mapao, E Ne pai chouloue,
Ne leshi Ahi paopeie;
Alü hai chu jünou kupu loulai,
Pa Ne hi kounghei pulo.
Ne kuvah donou Eye soushee peio,
Nevei zhuvea khouko nou;
Arako panou Nehi zhuteilo,
Atsü hai Nevei soulo.
Oh! Teile lihi Enou vayu hai,
Ne veobuh hi buyu büe;
Enou khoukhü-a veachi paoyuki,
Mapao Ne samai souwe.
E Nevei leshi süvete louhoe,
Zaiduna kacho mosa;
Nevei sayu hai süvete louhoe,
Neye koa ve shomosa.

chorus: Mapao Eye save ngheipu khai khai peio,
Ne zhe kü kouyu buh hi.

title: EYE TALA PEISO
firstLine: Eye tala peiso Mapao, Apaisü keipeio
author: F.J. Crosby

lines: Eye tala peiso Mapao, Apaisü keipeio,
Maikukhe Ne nou kuyuki, Eye thao peiso.
Ne vei zhuvea veobuh hinou, Eye pa bailo,
Nakou khurü lou-a kho-we, Eye sou khapeio.
Neye likhei louche-a nou Ne zhusü phouwe,
Arako sounou souvei peio, zhuvea nou khaipeio.
Newo sayu vei dzünghou süe, daizhou muteisa;
Ne moa deiphaohi rah ku hae, Raki hia ne baie.

chorus: Mai kukhe Ne nou kuyuki, Eye thaopeiso.

title: EYE POPEI LAIWO
firstLine: Mapao Jisu Neye thowe, Soukha mozü E thaishulai
author: Eliza H. Hamilton

lines: Mapao Jisu Neye thowe,
Soukha mozü E thaishulai;
Khailupeiyu pove peiwo,
Eye popei laiwo.
Esü mahmo sousho bure,
E donou Ne zhe kükou peie;
A hrü hai Ne leli soupeio,
Eye popei laiwo.
Souda loure bo kukhe hae,
Nghidzü kouyu nou veika baie;
Ne zhih donou Eye khaipeio,
Eye popei laiwo.
Zhupeio Eye Ne phi hinou,
Zhupeio E hai ne kilai bai;
Vah soushu peio, vah souche peio,
Ana Eye popeio.

chorus: Eye popei laiwo, Eye popei laiwo;
E donou thaipeiyu Khrista, Eye popei laiwo.

title: MAPAO EYE CHOPEIO
firstLine: E nou athao ashi ve daoa Aphihi shu nou khüyuma
author: E.D. Mund

lines: E nou athao ashi ve daoa
Aphihi shu nou khüyuma;
Vashoyu tsü ali ngaoloue,
Mapao Eye chopeio.
Deiphao ashi nou E sühaoa,
Arako hai souvea yuma;
Enou veasho buyu phaki,
Mapao Eye chopeio.
Athai vetheo, athai tatheo,
Vayu dao-a veayu dao-a;
E sü teisa Ale sawe,
Mapao Eye chopeio.

chorus: E piyu hae Neye phülou zü,

title: POLA PEIO
firstLine: Kua buyu pai pola peio, venü yumai sü panou veo
author: M. Fraser

lines: Kua buyu pai pola peio, venü yumai sü panou veo,
Pola peio, pola peio,
Rei-a kho buyu mai hisü leshiyu ko pola peio,
Pola peio, pola peio.
Pola peio Mapao nou pei buyu le sousa peiyu pai,
Pola peio, pola peio,
Rako hilo nou lelouhoa buyu mai panou sülo,
Pola peio, pola peio.
Pola peio, ahri vanou nehi vere ha khemai sü,
Pola peio, pola peio;
Rako hilo nou kao-a laimai sü taho soukha peio,
Pola peio, pola peio.
Khuveilo thala sounou teimai teizhi tala laire,
Pola peio, pola peio,
Zhukhaio vavei shoyu raki hilonou teithe pare
Pola peio, pola peio.

chorus: Pola peio ku-a buyu, Jihovah chipao avei sü
Tahrüh hrülaihi Jihovah chipao süvete mosa;
Pasülo, pasülo, Jisu ko sü pasülo.

title: HALI HALA JISU DONOUE
firstLine: Hali hala Jisu donoue, Avei hrümai veishi nou
author: Mary D. James

lines: Hali hala Jisu donoue,
Avei hrümai veishi nou,
Avei tsü, chipao vah teitei,
Avei teithe veishi nou;
Hali hala Jisu donoue,
Avei teithe veishi nou. (2 times)
Abah sü puh vah pa soulo,
Aphi puh du pa talo,
Angheithou pa Jisu zhulo,
Amü Puhye pa sholo;
Hali hala Jisu donoue,
Amü Puhye pa sholo. (2 times)
E Jisu ye zhulouyu thai,
E hakukhe ngaomore,
Arako zhiho mekou büe,
Jisu dathayu ngaoloue;
Puhye dathayu ngaolou-a
Chuo E Puh vei souloure. (2 times)
Oh! daizhou koute khupasa!
Vemai peinou Veo Jisu,
Eye leshi-a kupeire,
Puh shoukhe nou E bailai;
Hali hala Jisu donoue,
Chuo Puh shoukhe nou bailai. (2 times)

title: JISU HI PAOLAI
firstLine: Jisu hi paolai, Avei veayu tao
author: E.A.H.

lines: Jisu hi paolai, Avei veayu tao,
Mah kousü hai E la pfü louhoe,
E levea buki, Puh soukha peilai,
Puh nou leshi peie, Puh nou khopeie.
Jisuhi paolai, Avei veahoyu,
Puh hai mai zhuvea süyu samaie;
Puh hi kholouzü, Puh nou vupeilai,
Avei veayu hai thashoa halai.
Athao veyuki, khaipei Mapao bue,
Avei mahkou pfükha lou süpu;
Jisu hi paolai, E Puh hi paolai,
Puh nou Avei veayu pfükhalai.

chorus: Jisu hi paolai, E Puh hi paolai,
Avei mah kou E la pfü louhoe,
Jisu hi paolai, E puh hi paolai,

title: E KROS HI VEWE
englishTitle: I Am Coming To The Cross
firstLine: E Jisu Kros phivewe, Nghi cha-a lelouho bue
author: W. McDonald

lines: E Jisu Kros phivewe,
Nghi cha-a lelouho bue,
E nou choyu hakobai,
Jisu nou khaipei lousüe.
A mahmo paosha louhoe,
Arako kousü-a bue,
Jisu nou Ahi paowe,
“Ne mahmo sü khaipeilai.”.
Deiphaohi Avei hrülai,
Pfüphao-a, Arako-a
Pothou-a nehi peilai,
Mapaowo nedo soulo.
Jisu nou Alekhelü,
veloupeia souva peire,
Chemoyu tao souche peie,

chorus: Ne Kros phi hinou ve thoe,
tune: I Am Coming To The Cross

title: DAIBÜA CHACHI LOULAI
firstLine: Shona nou vuthou khaiyu thoutai
author: E.S. Oakey

lines: Shona nou vuthou khaiyu thoutai,
Heakou nou vuthou khaiyu thoutai;
Koukhenou vuthou khaiyu thoutai,
Kheiko nou vuthou khaiyu thoutai.
Ludu pehi vuthouyu thoutai,
Chuhphao vuthou thailaiyu thoutai;
Shuhro hi vuthou hare thoutai,
Deiveiyu hi vuthouyu thoutai.
Levea-a vuthou khaiyu thoutai,
Nghidzü kou-a vuthouyu thoutai
Rou vamai vuzhi-a vuthou-we,
Sasho-a chachi loure donou.

chorus: Vei khai moa, chachi vuzü lai.

title: E SAMAI ALI NGAOLOURE
firstLine: E samai ali ngaoloure, Puhnou E leshi showe
author: Rev. J.G. Small

lines: E samai ali ngaoloure,
Puhnou E leshi showe;
Puh nou Eye leshi rainou,
Save Puh hi phukhaitie;
Ale hinou Puh leshiwe,
Hata nou soukho lou hoe;
E sü Puh veie, Puh sü Aveie,
Ahai teisa samai baie.
E samai ali ngaoloure,
Puh zhe kükoue E donou;
Puh nou hriyu the peibai moa,
Puh hrü teitei ahi peie;
Avei touyu na alia hae,
Na veishi puhvei soulai;
Ale, ahrü, khouko teitei,
Puhvei, teisa Puhvei baie.
E samai ali ngaoloure,
Khouko veishi Puh hi bue;
Adu sü Puh nou khopeilai,
Eye raki savelai;
Avah khemai souche mosa,
Puh va nou E vapeilai;
Chuo Puh kho-a Puh vah soulai,
Süthai teisa nou solai.

title: TEIKHAI HI BAILOURE BUH
englishTitle: A Shelter In The Time Of Storm
firstLine: Chuhdu Mapao hinou baiwe, Teikhai teirüshi veyuki
author: V.J.C.

lines: Chuhdu Mapao hinou baiwe,
Teikhai teirüshi veyuki,
Kaozhou shiyu vema pimoe,
Teikhai teirüshi veyuki
Heakou teikhue, kheihi romüe,
Teikhai teirüshi veyuki,
Ngaoba mainou soupi louhoe,
Teikhai teirüshi veyuki.
Ngaopi zaidzü nou sühaoma,
Teikhai teirüshi veyuki,
Etao baibuh thaokhai laimoe,
Teikhai teirüshi veyuki.
Oh Rachuhdu, oh baiyu buh,
Teikhai teirüshi veyuki,
Nenou Etao soukha peiwo,
Teikhai teirüshi veyuki.

chorus: Oh Jisu hai chuh due, veahoyu buh hi,
Veayu buh hi, veayu buh hi;
Oh Jisu hai chuh due, veahoyu buh hi,
tune: A Shelter In The Time Of Storm

title: JISUYE LÜYU HAI VEISHOE
englishTitle: Tis So Sweet To Trust In Jesus
firstLine: Jisuye lüyu hai veishoe, Puh chi hai züa bulo
author: Mrs. Louisa M.R. Stead

lines: Jisuye lüyu hai veishoe,
Puh chi hai züa bulo;
Puh chipao hinou sobulo,
Sübüa Mapao nou paowe.
Jisuye lüyu daizhou veie,
Puh vei zhe likhei louche;
Lüyu vanou Eye phouloue,
Puh zhenou E sou veipeie.
E lesae Ne lülou vanou,
Muteiyu samai Jisu;
Nenou salai peiyu E süe,
Khai koute Eye zhopeio.

tune: Tis So Sweet To Trust In Jesus

title: JISU AVEIE
firstLine: Deiphao sayu halai, Jisu Aveie
author: Mrs. J.C. Bonar

lines: Deiphao sayu halai, Jisu Aveie,
Leshiyu rai delai, Jisu Aveie;
Maiyu deiphaovahi E soloure buh hae,
Jisu likhei ha peie, Jisu Aveie.
Arako halouhoe, Jisu Aveie,
Teisa Puh hi bulai, Jisu Aveie;
Halaiyu deiphaona, phajütou donou bai,
Ajüpa na halai, Jisu Aveie.
Khei mekou habailai, Jisu Aveie,
Teiva haina halai, Jisu Aveie;
Ajüpa nou souyu hakobaie, tea thaore,
Jisu jüpa soulai Jisu Aveie.
Apfüphao hai thaolai, Jisu Aveie;
Teisa ahri vepeio, Jisu Aveie;
Leshi zhuvea vepeio, teisa soyu vepeio,
Mapao Jisu vepeio, Jisu Aveie.

title: KHRISTA HAI AVEIE
firstLine: Ashi nou Ahi vephaki, E nou Mapao zhih kuwe
author: H. Bonar, D.D.

lines: Ashi nou Ahi vephaki,
E nou Mapao zhih kuwe;
Süki E Puh soukha ngaowe,
Khrista hai Avei hrülaie.
Khei phahi E leveayuki,
Anghidzü kouyu phaki;
Süki E shameayu lousoue,
Khrista hai Avei hrülaie.
Ahrü hai hrü cheyu phaki,
Athai teile velouzü;
Enou hrishuyu lou soulai,
“Khrista hai Avei hrülaie”.

title: KHAIHAYU PUHBAH HI VÜYUHAI
firstLine: Khaihayu Puhbah hi vü-a buyu
author: Rev. E.A. Hoffman

lines: Khaihayu Puhbah hi vü-a buyu,
Daizhozhou asayu meime sa;
Daizhou rako veie, daizhou kaonasa,
Khaihayu Puh bah hi vüyu hai,
Raki luduhi tayu daizhovei
Khaihayu Puh bah hi vüyuhai;
Teisa du süna vavei sho-a bue,
Khaihayu Puh bah hi vüyu hai.
E pire daibue, E ngaopiyu hae,
Khaihayu Puh bah hi vüyu hai;
Mapao vei kaonayu sü Ahi bue,
Khaihayu Puh bah hi vülouzü.

title: DANIEL ME
firstLine: Jihovah chipao zü-a, soutaosou lalo
author: P.P.B.

lines: Jihovah chipao zü-a, soutaosou lalo;
Daniel me khemai bü-a soutaosou nou lalo.
Khuvei loumoyu vanou, maitaoli hare;
Jihovah vah sounü mai, Daniel me hi loulo;
Deiphao hi poutuo veimai, maitaoli hare;
Daniel me nghoujü hinou, kao-a nou dutare.
Kovei sahra polalo; veiloure donou;
Saitan vei menou, Daniel Me hi reih sou-a bue.

chorus: Daniel büa khuveilo, Ne halia piso;
Nele checheyu nasü, Maiye pa sülo.

title: ETAO LÜLOUCHE-A TAWE
firstLine: Etaolülou che-a tawe, Poupah khesü daizhozhou veie
author: F.J. Crosby

lines: Etaolülou che-a tawe,
Poupah khesü daizhozhou veie;
Ludu sasü kainü veishoe,
Rakoye sa-tayu buh hi.
Etao lülouche-a tawe,
Etao tayu Puh do soulai;
Etao buh hi tei zhiyuki,
Puh nou save Puh hi khaipeie.
Etao lülouche-a tawe,
Eh Puh hinou vü-a soloue;
Etao Mapao lüpu louzü,
Puh vei leshi Eh ngaopulai.

title: LÜ HAI VEILOUYU NAE
firstLine: Khrista reihmai tashulouwo, Reih buhsü soudalo
author: John H. Yates

lines: Khrista reihmai tashulouwo, Reih buhsü soudalo;
Kheipha sü loumo buki nou, Soutaosou vah soulo;
Ngaoba reihmai thai hu koulo, Khouko sü popalo,
Lüva nou veiloue Eh nou süe, Deiphao jü veiloulai.
Leshiyu sü Puh vei sahrae, Khoche sü Puh chipaoe;
Sheeyu mai duhi etao tae, Veilouyu pai shusoue,
Putao lü vanou teikhai büa, Deikho hi hüvere,
Lü vanou athai jü veiloue, Haisü etao vei rüe.
Ngaobamai jü veilouyu puh, Sakaa sü bapeilai;
Rakivamai nghoujü hinou, Puh zhih sü paopeilai,
Süthai vayu raki hinou, Etao vashoa bulai,
Eh teizhi jünou veiloulai, Jisu vei zhih hinou.

chorus: Lü vanou kolousüe, lü vanou kolousüe;
Oh, deiphao haire lülouyu vanou kolousüe.

title: KAONALO, KAONALO
firstLine: Mapao teikhai teirüshi ve Zaidu hi dzü houpare
author: Mary B. Baker

lines: Mapao teikhai teirüshi ve Zaidu hi dzü houpare,
Teizhi teihao nou maiteiloure, Bailoure buhsü hare;
Eh hakare zhulaimowu? Daibüa ne zhilou we?
Shokhai mo-a teikhai nou hüve -a
Zhaihi pa khüh soulaiwu?
Mapao, Arako vealere, Zhou E nehi kho-a bue,
Alethou sü souvea showure,
Oh! khaipeio tea E kho-we;
Mah vei zaidzü nou chih lelou-a, Arako leilaire,
E halaire halaire Oh ! Mapao, Nenou thasho ve vupeio.
Mapao, ngaopiyu latare, Haveishi kaona vere,
Kaona zaipeihi teinghei vare, Raki sü ngheisho vere;
Oh! Khai-apeio khopeilai-o E likhei thaopeiso,
Asashoa E soloure buh zaipe, Hinou souloua sobulai.

chorus: Hali hala sü Achi zülai, kaonalo, kaonalo,
Pule tao hrülai Achi zülai, kaona shalo.”

title: KHRISTAMAI LEIKEI TAWO
firstLine: Khrista mai leikei tawo, kaoshiyu bue

lines: Khrista mai leikei tawo, kaoshiyu bue,
Tapa talouyuki pi-a talo;
Holo hailo hashi bue, thaore bue,
Neye panou mah soupuyu phoua bue.
Khrista mai leikei tawo,(3 times) kaoshiyu bue.
Khristamai leikei tawo, teikhai hrohi,
Teikou teizhi nou neye soupi-a;
Thasho teihao teikhai sü tabailai,
Süthaisü Mapao koa teisa solai;
Khristamai sa talo, (3 times) teikhai hrohi.
Khristamai veachi paolo, kaoshulai,
Mapaoye chiphayu ne ngaikhaiso;
Veachi nou ne rüsou-a talouzü,
Veayu dao-a ne vei-a taloulai;
Khristamai veachi pao (3 times) ne kaoshulai.
Khristamai ne lü khaitayu souso,
Zaidu tacho louthai soyu ngaolai;
Süki chiku-apeio nou ne sholai,
“Taloulo Avei kilai” tea paolai
Khristamai lü khaiso (3 times) soyu ngaolai.

title: VEISHOA BUE
firstLine: Kaonayu nou zaidzü bü Ahi vema
author: H.G. Spafford

lines: Kaonayu nou zaidzü bü Ahi vema,
Veayu nou zai houyu büa ma;
Hatali vema Nenou E pasüloue,
Arako hai veisho-a bubaie.
Saitan nou Eye soushilai tea vema,
Mapao nou Eye soukhapeie;
Akhouko hayu Khrista nou sülou-a,
Arako donou Puh zhe kükoue.
Choshalou hoyu Enou souyu mahmo,
Alia thaokhai moa khailupei;
Kros hi pokhaire, E mah pfüpu more,
Mapaoye paosholo Arako.
Mapao Ne velaiyu Enou kho-a bue,
Rakilo zhaokheyu khoa bue;
Rakimai bekho, Oh Mapao vei lapai,
Daizhou vei Arako hai solai.

title: JIHOVAH CHIPAO HI LABULAI
firstLine: Veo Khrista nou paokhaiyu chihi la-a
author: R.K.C.

lines: Veo Khrista nou paokhaiyu chihi la-a,
Teisa halouho Puhshoyu lou soulai;
Maihrülai peibu Puhye lousou sholai,
Jihovah chipao hi labulai.
Veikhai moyu chipao hinou labulai,
Piyu teikhai teirüshi nou veyuki;
Hri-a buyu chipao nou poa E dulai,
Jihovah chipao hi labulai.
Mapao Khrista chipao hinou labulai,
Puhvei teisa leshihi nou phu khaitoue,
Teisanou rako khoche poa reih dulai,
Jihovah chipaohi labulai.
Puh chihi nou lalou zü E kao laimoe,
Rako nou teisa paoyu chi sü keilai;
Teisa nou A Mapao hinou sobulai,
Jihovah chipao hi labulai.

chorus: Mapao nou paokhai touyu chihi labulai,
Eh labue Mapao vei chi hisü nou.

title: TEITHETSÜ JISU LÜLO
firstLine: Teithe tsü Jisu lülo, Veayu kia puhye lülo
author: E. Page

lines: Teithe tsü Jisu lülo, Veayu kia puhye lülo;
Ne lühai khai hoyuki, Jisu lülouzü chebaie.
Rako Mashi nou vapeie, Maiteiyu Ale khehi;
Kaolouhoe Puh salaisa, Jisu lülouzü chebaie.
Ne salouzü lou soulo, Ne vealouzü veachipao;
Puh kulo, kaoshi louzü, Jisu lülouzü chebaie.
Puh lülo hrü khaikoute, Puh lülo athai koute;
Romühi loumo koute, Jisu lülouzü chebaie.

title: LÜLO, ZÜLO
firstLine: Mapao koa tayu ki, Puh chizü-a buki
author: Rev. J.H. Sammis

lines: Mapao koa tayu ki, Puh chizü-a buki;
A ludu daizhou varu-a bue;
Puh jüpa soubuki, Puh eh ye koa bupeie,
Lülou maihrülaiye koa bupeie.
Teizhi nou zü louhoe, Teihao-a sülai moe;
Puh leshi nou hutakhai bailai,
Letsüyu, piyu hae; Dopfü-a kralai moe,
Lüloumai hrülaiye koa bupeie.
Kou süyu pfülai moe, Veahoyu ngaolai moe;
Etao veamuh Puhnou khapeilai,
Hakayu ngaolai moe, Athai-a daolai moe,
Lüloumaiye teisa hapeilai.
Süthai vasho-a nou, Puh phinou ve bulai,
Sühi nou Puhye ko-a hrülai,
Puh nou paoyu soulai;Puh nou seizü talai,
Pilaimoe, Puh nou paoyu zülai.

chorus: Lülo, zülo, ludu kukhe lia hae;
Jisu hinou sayu hai, lüyu lia züyu baie.

title: JIHOVAH BAH VUZÜNOU RÜE
firstLine: Belshazar Veo nüh hisü, maithethe vejü lou-a
author: Knowles Shaw

lines: Belshazar Veo nüh hisü, maithethe vejü lou-a,
Sana hupai che polou-a, Zhaoh posho-a nou buwe;
Khei mathe sü Veo kipei sühi nou vashoa buki,
Bahli nou thaikou bouhisü, larü chah rükhai peire.
Hukha pfüyu Daniel nou, Veo nghoujü nou lalou-a;
Mah souyu veosü zhulou-a, Rükhaitou lasü chongaoe;
Bou hi rükhaitou lasü, Mai hrülai nou veayu lae;
Zhou thainou veodei sü halai,
Tea nou bouhi rükhaitoue.
Soutaosou lü-a bu-a, cheche vah souyu donou
Judea hi Daniel puh hisü, Pokukhaitou tsü süngaoe;
Rakonou salaipei-a, Hukha hinou palou-a
Bou hi rükhaitouyu lasü, Mai hrülai hisü ngaopeie.

title: EH PAI-PAOMAI LÜ
firstLine: Eh paipao lühai sheeyu lüe
author: F.W. Faber

lines: Eh paipao lühai sheeyu lüe,
Hukha, khoheu mei ngaophoumoe;
Chipao süna choulouyuki,
Etao le dai zhou asalai.
Eh paipao lü hai sheeyu lüe,
Lü sünanou E reih zülai;
Maikhemaiye do soupeire,
Süna E teisa po-a bulai.
Eh paipao lü hai sheeyu lüe,
Mai hrülai ye eh leshi lai;
Ne leshi ko maihi paolai,
Chilako vei nou paodoulai.

chorus: Eh paipao lü hai sheeyu lüe,

title: CHUHDU KHRISTA
firstLine: E nou lüyu hai Jisu zhe
author: Rev. E. Mote

lines: E nou lüyu hai Jisu zhe
Alia Puh vei cheche nabai,
Deiphao zhihvei E louchemoe,
Jisu zhih hinou vübulai.
Azhi nou sühaolou buki,
Puh ava nou Eye vapei;
Teikhai teirüshi vebuki,
E Puh phi hinou bailoulaie.
Mahmo hrohi sünou Eye,
Mapao Khrista nou khailupeie;
Puh chipao Puh zhe vasünou,
E louche-a hriyu ngaoloue.
Puh nou shabe houpoa veki,
E-a Puhye koa tabailai;
Puh cheche nou E banou-a,
E Puh vebuh hi ve lalai.

title: E NEYE LOUCHEWE
englishTitle: My Faith Looks Up To Thee
firstLine: E neye louchewe, Kalvari hi zhaotu
author: Rev. Ray Palmer

lines: E neye louchewe, Kalvari hi zhaotu;
Mapao Jisu, E nou khoyu keipeio,
Amahmo khailupeio,
Zhou nou E pa Nevei maili soulo.
Nevei zhuvea sünou, Ahi khouko thoupeio;
Lesou sapeio, Ne E donou thaipeie,
Enou Neye leshie,
Avei leshi hai teisa pa valo.
Teizhi hi tayuki, veayu Ahi veki,
Ne E khopeio, Teizhi sü Ne vapeio,
A nghidzü southe peio;
Eye pa Ne hinou tala taso.
Hri-a buyu phakia, Thaitayu phaki-a
Eye khaipeio, Leshinou E hapeio
Piyu sü potapeio;
Eye khaipeilou-a rako popeio.

tune: My Faith Looks Up To Thee

title: PUH LIKHEI LÜLO
firstLine: Mah hinou vea-a bukhemai, Jisu hi veloulo
author: J.H.S.

lines: Mah hinou vea-a bukhemai, Jisu hi veloulo;
Ne Puhye lütaolouzü, Puh nou ne soyu peilai.
Jisu zhe kükou peivanou, Ne Puh ha ngaoloulai;
Chu ne puh zhe hinou khüshee louzü vüra bülai.
Jisu hai acheche ludue, ne save sopeilai;
Chao-a buso Puh louchelo, ne ha sü ngaoloulai.
Velo, velo sheeyu mehi, vayu buh hi talai;
Raki teidei hi vebulai, teisa vasho bulai.

chorus: Puh lütaolo, Puh lütaolo, Puh likhei lülo;
Ne khai peilai, chu khai peilai.

title: PUH E KHOPUE
firstLine: E-wo sümoe, nghoujü dai bue
author: Charlotte G. Homer

lines: E-wo sümoe, nghoujü dai bue,
Ramai leshi hinou hrü bue,
Puh leshi hai E-nou louche,
Puhnou kihi save peilai.
Ewo sümoe, duki Puhnou,
Avei Kros hai pota laisa;
Ana E süe, Kros thaoyuki,
Veo peirü hai Enou ngaolai.
Ahrü ludu hai khu shishoe,
Kacho laiyu reihai thoushoe;
Ana E süe, rei kalouthai,
Raki Aki hisü velai.
Rai-a tayu leshiyu mai,
Sühi nou teisa koa hrülai;
Puh zhuvea louhai sou zholai,
Puhye zhuhao nou daoyuki.

chorus: Puh E khopue, Puh nou ludue,
Oh! E nou süe, Puh E khopue.

title: ZHUVEA NOU NEYE KHAIPEIE
firstLine: Khailupei Mapaovei leshiyu vah veishi

lines: Khailupei Mapaovei leshiyu vah veishi,
Mah pfü-a bumaiye khaipeire donou soudabue.
Leshi zhuvea vah hai Mapao hinou ngaoloue,
Kros vahinou popa southeapeie mainah Poutuosü.
Puhye lülouyumai khailulouyu ngaolai,
Amapao vah hi sünou E Puh nahsü souloure.

title: THOULAILAI
firstLine: Teisanou Mapaovei leshi hinou thousho-a talai

lines: Teisanou Mapaovei leshi hinou thousho-a talai,
Nevei zhuveayu hai pa süloure tsüdo Ahi peio.
Thousho-a panou Eye hai hribulo Rako Mashi
Ahrü haisü Jisu hinou pa bulo E thaowu so.
Teisanou Eye hai thoushoyu ne tsüdo avei peio.
Akhai koute nehi pa laloure lethousü peikhaio.
Cheche hilo lü-a buloure donou pa thou talo,
Nevei tsüdo süloure donou kaonayu Ahi peio.

title: FÜTALAI
firstLine: Hataki veyuma E Mapao thaifü lai
author: Rev. W.O. Cushing

lines: Hataki veyuma E Mapao thaifü lai,
Puhnou raipeiyu ludu hisü E talai;
Hataki-a Puhnou veyu buhsü E velai,
Veo peirü sü ngaolou mosa E talai.
Hataki veyuma E Mapao thaifülai,
Ahi teikhai teirüshi vedaoyu phaki;
Mapao sata peilou zü E pikhai laimoe.
Puh hi bulouzü rakoshi daolai moe.
Hataki veyuma E Mapao thai fülai,
Puh Eye salai louzü Arako veilou süe;
Mapaonou ludu avei hilo save peilai,
Süthaisü Jihovah buh hisü velai.

title: E DAOH RAIKOH PAONÜ SHOE
englishTitle: I Love To Tell The Story
firstLine: E kosü na paonü shoe, Ngaomoyu nakhe ko
author: Catherine Hankey

lines: E kosü na paonü shoe, Ngaomoyu nakhe ko,
Jisu vei kathe ko khe, Jisu vei leshi ko,
E ko süna paonü shoe, E süe kohai cheche,
Enou jüpayu ngaoloue, Chikukhe jüpa moe.
E kosüna paonü shoe, Khupa shoyu ko sü,
Sana nou soukhai touyu Na jünou veisho hie.
E ko süna paonü shoe, Puh nou E donou thai,
Südonou E nou nehi, Chu kohai pao ngaowe.
E ko süna paonü shoe, Paothai paopu nüwe,
E nou paopuyu sanou, Kohai veikhai khai bai,
E ko süna paonü shoe, Sükhai momai donou,
Khailupeiyu chipao hai Ramai chipao vuzüe.
E ko süna paonü shoe, Süveiyu mai hi-a
Hou-reizü bumai donou, Sülou-a sasholai,
Puh vei zhaivei ngaoyuki, E lou asheena soue,
Daonou Enou leshiyu, Koveisü hainare.

chorus: E kosü na paonü shoe, Avei chibei sü soulai,
Dao raiki ko sü paolai, Jisu vei leshi ko.
tune: I Love To Tell The Story

title: NE JISU DONOU BUH BU HAE?
englishTitle: Have You Any Room For Jesus
firstLine: Ne Jisu donou buh buhae?
author: El Nathan (arr.)

lines: Ne Jisu donou buh buhae?
Puh ne mah kou Pfüpei nae.
Puh loulai tea khou-a buki,
Mahmai ne Puh paloulo.
Deiphao hi mah soumai buh bue,
Ana, Khrista sü southare.
Puh nou lou bure buh sü hae,
Ne leshi donou puh thaie.
Jisu donou teile bu hae?
Zhuvea nou neye kupue,
O zhou aetou peiyu teithe,
Dosho ne kupu laimoe.
Buh, teile chu Jisu hi peio,
Zhuvea teithe habailai;
Thashoa ne lühai kaotalai,
Jisu nou kupu laimoe.

tune: Have You Any Room For Jesus

title: MAPAO NOU KUBUE
firstLine: Mapao nou neye ku-a bue
author: J.B.

lines: Mapao nou neye ku-a bue,
Mah vahye leshi bubailaiwu?
Khou teile nou somoa tabue,
Ne rako zhi buh bai laiwu?
Ne Puh thai fütalai mowu?
Puh paisü ne keinou nü mowu?
Le nasho nou neye kubue
Mapao nou chu-a kubu-we.
Leshi-a nou chu-a kuwe,
Mah maitaore, levea bulaiwu?
Leshi zhuvea nou kupu-we,
Nelah nou veasho bu baire.
Aetou moyu vah sou khaiso,
Soutao sounou ne leda lourao,
Deiphao vei vah thao khai wu-a,
Puh chipao nele pa loulo.

chorus: Mapao nou kubue,(Mapao nou ku bue)(2 tms)
Chu ku-a nou bue,(chu ku-a nou bue)(2 times)

title: TEIVA SÜ PAVALOULO
firstLine: Ne ngaoba mai nou veiloulai tea piwu?
author: Ada Blenkhorn

lines: Ne ngaoba mai nou veiloulai tea piwu?
Ne hrü, ne tsüle hisü teizhi buwu?
Kikhu sü houlo, teizhiyu hatalai,
Teiva sü pa valoulo.
Ne leshi vanou ne lü hai khaitawu?
Nevei veachi Rahmai nou keipei mowu?
Kikhu sü houlo, teizhiyu hatalai,
Teiva sü pa valoulo.
Raki ludu hi sashoa talaimowu?
Heakou hi teizhi hae tiyu sümowu?
Kikhu sü houlo, teizhiyu hatalai,
Teiva sü pa valoulo.

chorus: Teivasü pa valoulo, teiva sü pa valoulo,

title: PUH NOU DAISOUE?
firstLine: Khupa shoyu chisü keinoulo
author: J.M. Gray

lines: Khupa shoyu chisü keinoulo,
Hakayu Etao donoue,
Veishoyu Raki vanou kouloua,
Khupasou Etao khaipeie.
Rakivamai nou khailupeimoe,
Veomai hrülai pei Veo noue;
Kros pei hinou dathayu nasü,
Rahmai Nah Poutuo vuzüe.
Paoyu chisü pa cheche vuzüe,
Soutaosou tsü-a bulo;
Raki hinou neye donou tea,
Jisu nou lapei-a bue.
Khaipeiyu Puh ye aetou homoe?
Ne Puh chi zülai homoe?
Puhye louche louyu khemai sü,
Halouho ahri peilai.

chorus: Puh nou dai soue? Chuo daiki bue?

title: TEISA TSÜPULAIMOYU KO
englishTitle: The Story That Never Goes Old
firstLine: Daorai ko Alehi daizhou leshisa
author: John H. Yates

lines: Daorai ko Alehi daizhou leshisa,
Teisa nou ko sü ashu baie;
Teisa sheeyu mai nou paoyu chipao süe,
Leshi chekhaoyu chipao süe.
Mahnou Ale vea buki ko sü chove-e
E lekiyu hinou hrü bue;
Rakimai büa asayu ko süve-e,
Eye veilouyu sü peire.
Saitan nou ngheiveyu ki ko sü chove-e,
Aphi ludu veasho buki;
Ajü nou kuyu chuhdu ko sü paopeie.
Vashoyu buh hi savepeie.

chorus: Leshi ko sünou raki save ngheipeie,
tune: The Story That Never Goes Old

title: MAPAO NOU KUWE
firstLine: Zhukhaio Mapao nou chu ku-a bue
author: Julia Sterling

lines: Zhukhaio Mapao nou chu ku-a bue,
Chachi peire donou,
Douhi rousü mei-a nou bure,
Ana vah soumai hae.
Takhaio mah hinou halaiyu mai,
Khaipa loure donou;
Mahmo rainou phukhai touyu mai
Nebah nou phei papeio.
Takhaio veayu maiye ko-a nou,
Leshia sousa peikhaio,
Puh hai halou hoyu raokhao süe,
Asa putao daolai.
Takhaio chachire pha haloure,
Teinghei sü loulaire,
Puhye daore teile ngheivere,
Vah soure teile hae.

title: E NOU MUTEIYU KO PAOLAI
englishTitle: I Will Tell The Precious Story
firstLine: E nou muteiyu ko paolai, Khupa leshi shapao lai
author: Dr. J.J. Maxfield

lines: E nou muteiyu ko paolai, Khupa leshi shapao lai;
Khouko bua khailupeiyu Puh, Puh veobuh hisü bulai,
Puh hai vuli deiphao hi ve, Akhai ha ahri pfü ve;
Chuwo Puh khai-apeio soure,
Puh khoukobu Vewo süe.
Puh nghoujü veyu pha hisü,
Mah nou sa thaikhai yuki,
Etao nou raokhao kholouzü,
Puh nou chuh nou peilaiwu?
Moe, Puh eh veachi keipeilai,
Puh nou etao veayu süe,
Puh nou Ajüpa sü peilai,
Alaosou pei vuzülai.
Ne hisü veayu vere vei, Cholou-a ngaopi buwu?
Nehi veayu ve daobuwu? Ne likhei pfülou howu?
Ne veayu hisü louwuso, Ne kousü Puh hi thaothouo,
Ne vasü teisa pa valo, Lünou ki save peilai.

tune: I Will Tell The Precious Story

title: DAORAI KO AHI PAOPEIO
firstLine: Daorai ko Ahi paopeio, Raki nou ngaomona
author: Miss Hankey

lines: Daorai ko Ahi paopeio, Raki nou ngaomona;
Jisu alia Puh duso, Jisu vei leshi ko;
Nahtou maili hi büa, ko sü lapa paopeio;
E lülou hoyu donou, khouko hae soulou hoe.
Daoraiko Ahi paopeio, Esüloure donou,
Khupa sou khaipeiyu ko, mahmo souvei peiyu,
Kosü Ahi paopupeio E ngaimore donou
Shona hi buyu zidzü, Heakou hi bupumoe.
Dao raichoki ko paokhaio, zhuvea paila veinou,
E büa mahmo soumaiye Jisu nou khaipei ko
Kohaisü teithe tsünou Ahi ve paongao peio,
E veasho-a buphaki ko hainou souvapeie.

title: E KHUPA CHIPAO LOU SOULAI
englishTitle: I Will Sing The Wondrous Story
firstLine: E khupa chipao lousoulai
author: F.H. Rawley (arr.)

lines: E khupa chipao lousoulai,
Eye donou Khrista thaie,
Puh buh veishi thaokhai-a nou,
Kalvari nou ve thaipeie.
Ludu motayu zhaotu büa,
E-a bo mola tare;
Zhaotuye phoulouyu zhaibüa,
Jisu nou Eye phouloue.
E sounou sou-a bu phaki,
Jisu nou E souvei peie;
Piyu veayu buh hi sünou
Jisu nou E vupa peie.
Puh nou E khosa tapeilai,
Reidu tacho lou mosa;
Süthai Puh nou E sa popa
Khuleshi mai daopeilai.

tune: I Will Sing The Wondrous Story

title: NE ZHUVEA CHIPAO VEISÜ
firstLine: Ne zhuvea chipao veisü Ale louloure
author: Rev. A.T. Pierson

lines: Ne zhuvea chipao veisü Ale louloure,
Deiphao mai leshi donou Nahpoutou seipeie.
Nghou sü pola shupeie, sounou sü veiloure,
Sübüa Jisu Kros zhulou mai khailu loulai.
Arako sü mah hinou thainono bure,
Nah, ne zhuvea leshi chipao vanou hriloue.
Mapao E lülouhoyu Ne nou soukhapeio,
Nahmai büa Ne chipao louche loure donou.

title: JISU VEI KHUPA ZHUVEA
firstLine: Jisu vei khupa zhuvea, Amah jünou duhie
author: H.L.

lines: Jisu vei khupa zhuvea, Amah jünou duhie,
Amü nou paosha lou hoe, Puh vei leshi kohai,
Akousü polai peire, Arako do soupeie,
Jisu vei khupa zhuvea Ahi koulou peie.
Jisu vei leshiyu hai mai hrülai pei koupeie
Amahmo sü khailupeie, Eye ve sousheepeie;
Amah soushee chelou-a leshi nou souhri peie,
Jisu vei leshiyu hai Ahi kouloupeie.
Jisu vei leshiyu hai Ahi nou talamoe
Puh vei khouko vasü nou Eye Puh nah soupeie
Kaonayu nou sabupei, halaimo rakinou,
Jisu vei leshiyu hai Ahi kouloupeie.

chorus: Amü nou paoshalou hoyu khupayu Puh leshi,
Thoushoyu zai duna jünou Puh leshi thouhie;
Khupa shoyu Puh vei leshi kohai akhai ha-e,
Muh peilai moyu Jisu zhih hisü paosho laikhe.

title: PUTAO LOU ASHU SOUWE
firstLine: Kushoyu raki nou khailou mailou soue
author: Julia H. Johnston

lines: Kushoyu raki nou khailou mailou soue,
Putao pei pfü nakou-a Veoye thowe;
Deiphaovei veayu piyu sü hakhaire,
Sheeyu maiye koa sayu ashee lou soue.
Khupa leshiyu lousü E souchere,
Kainüvei sana bvüsü nühou houre;
Mahmai donou thaipeiyu Mapao vanou,
Eletao Veo bü-a teisa nou hrülai.
Mah khüshee loumai likhei raki khelai.
Zhuvea ngaolou mainou lousü sou bailai,
Mapaowo akhemai mah sü khüshee peio,
Raki zhaokhe laiyu lou chu E soulai.

title: KHUPA SHOYU KO
firstLine: E nou nehi khupayu ko paopu peilai
author: F.J. Crosby

lines: E nou nehi khupayu ko paopu peilai,
Khailupeire Jisu vei ko;
Kros vanou maihrülai khailu peiyupue,
Athai jünou Puhnou koloue.
Enou nehi khupayu ko paopu peilai,
Lüloumai hrülai khaipei ko;
Rako nou neye chunou soukha peilai,
Zhuveayu chisü ngaoloulai.
Enou nehi khupayu ko paopu peilai,
Alethouhi muhtei shore;
Deiphao mai nou peilou hoyu ne peilai,
Süjünou asayu lia hae.

chorus: Kosü keipu peio, leshiyu veiko süe,
Puh nou ahri bo Arako hi houpeie,

title: DEIPHAO HI AVA HAI JISUE
firstLine: Deiphao veishi mahmo hinou hakhaire
author: P.P.B.

lines: Deiphao veishi mahmo hinou hakhaire,
Deiphao hi ava hai Jisue;
Teingheinou vayu büa Puh vanou vapeie,
Deiphao hi ava hai Jisue.
Jisu salai khemai nou teizhi ngaohoe,
Deiphao hi ava hai Jisue;
Etao ava hi tae Puh thaifü buki,
Deiphao hi ava hai Jisue.
Teizhi hinou buyu nghicha laikhemai,
Deiphao hi ava hai Jisue;
Taho ne khüsheelo ava sü ngaolai,
Deiphao hi ava hai Jisue.

title: KHRISTA NOU MAHMAI KHAIPEIE
firstLine: Khrista nou mahmo khemai khaipeilai tiyu kohai
author: Arr. from Neumeister

lines: Khrista nou mahmo khemai khaipeilai tiyu kohai,
Jihovah chipao avei maihrülai hi paopei khaio.
Velo, ne pa soloulai, Puh chikhe ne lütaolo;
Mahmosü khailupeilai, Jisunou neye kuwe.
Chuo, Ale soushee loure, Mapao hinou la-a bue;
Puh nou Amahmo khai peie, Puh jüpa sü E soulai.
Khrista nou mahmo khaipeie, Puh nou Eye sü popeie;
Puh zhenou khüshee peire, Eye sa raki khelai.

title: JISU NOU KHAIPEIWE
firstLine: Eh nou choue sayu chipao, Jisu nou khaipeiyu
author: Prescilla J. Owens

lines: Eh nou choue sayu chipao, Jisu nou khaipeiyu,
Deiphao buh veishi paodouo, Jisu nou khaipeiyu;
Chipaovei hai maihrülai, deichi deirao veishi hi,
Paodou khaio Mapaovei ko, Jisu nou khaipeiyu.
Zaipei hi-a paotakhaio, Jisu nou khaipeiyu,
Mahmai hrülai hi paopeio, Jisu nou khaipeiyu;
Deichipei, Zaidu peihi chipaovei douve tepeio
Maihrülai nou lesalo, Jisu nou khaipeilai
Vah sou-a lousou bulo, Jisu nou khaipeiyu,
Puh nou thaipeiyu vanou, halouho hri ngaoloue
Veayuki lousü soulo, puh zhuvea zhi-a bulo
Kolouyu lousü soulo, Jisu nou khai peilai.
Paichi-a shapao peikhaio, Jisu nou khaipeiyu,
Mai hrülai nou asalo, Jisu nou khaipeiwe,
Deiphao bumai hrülaihi khailupei ko shapao khaio,
Kolouyu lousü soulo, Jisu nou khaipeiwe.

title: KHUPAYU KO
firstLine: Lousü Ahi sou ngaopupeio
author: P.P.B.

lines: Lousü Ahi sou ngaopupeio,
Hriloure khupako,
E panou Puh zhaivei ngaolou,
Hriloure chipaosü;
Hriloure chipao sü, Ahi dou pupei-o.
Khrista nou mai hrülaihi peie,
Hriloure khupa ko
Mahmai keilo, Puh lapaisü;
Hriloure chipaosü;
Maihrü lai hisü peie,
Raki khere donou.
Kaona sho-a paodou peikhaio,
Hriloure khupa ko;
Maikhe mai mah sü khaipeiwe,
Hriloure chipao nou,
Jisu khailu pei pue,
Teisanou soushee peie.

title: ALAOSOU KHAIPEI LOUSÜE
firstLine: Mai atali nou Jisuye polouzü
author: Rev. E.A. Hoffman

lines: Mai atali nou Jisuye polouzü,
Mai atali nou Puhye louche louzü;
Sa-a khaipeiyu, hriyusü ngaoloulai,
Puh hai alaosou khaipei lousü nasüe.
Mai atali nou Mapao chi zülouzü,
Mah khüshee peiyu Puh zhe louche louzü
Teisa halouho hriyu sü ngaoloulai,
Puh ne khaipeilai, ne khaipei nü-a bue.
Mai atali nou Puh le hai dalouzü,
Puh lehi Mapao buh souda peilouzü;
Cheche vuzü nou khailu louyu ngaolai,
Jisu nou chunou khaipeilai tea khobue.

chorus: Puh vei zhuvea hai ( puh zhuvea hai)
Muteiyu Puh zhe (puh vei zhe nou)
Puh hai alao sou (puh hai alao sou)

title: SÜHI BUH BUE
firstLine: Sühi buh bue, Mapao Jisu vei buh hi
author: DR. H. Bonar

lines: Sühi buh bue, Mapao Jisu vei buh hi,
Pava shoa-a nou neye ku-a bue.
Teile hare, teinghei sü louta laire,
Kheipha veloure, va teile hare.
Vasho-a bue, buh sühi tave loulo,
Raki vamai nou, neye ku-a bue.
Leshiyu painou, kusho-a ne kuwe,
Nübuh hi velo, tea neye kuwe.
Kikhu louzü, veayu nevei soushulai,
Ne nou krabuma, buhsü ngaolou hoe.

chorus: Buh bue, buh bue, tave loulo chunou.

title: DAISOU NOU CHU VEMOE?
firstLine: Ekhemai nou khobuki
author: El. Nathan

lines: Ekhemai nou khobuki,
Ne rako nou phoubuki,
Puonou ne kuyu phaki,
Jisu hi venü mowu?
Nenou tala shoa bure,
Ne chao-a bupu khaiso,
Mapao hinou talaso,
Zhou teithe Puhye polo.
Leveayu maiye donou,
Deiphao kaona ngaolou hoe,
Khrista lüa, Puh hi velo
Kaonayu ne ngao loulai.

title: HU SHU ZHEEBAH
firstLine: Ne hrühi licho buyu vetemowu?
author: B.B.Mc.

lines: Ne hrühi licho buyu vetemowu?
Hushu zhee hi ne bah deikhaio;
Ne vah souyu donou veasho-a buwu?
Hushu zheehi nebah deikhaio.
Teizhi hi ne likhei nou ta-a buwu
Hushu zheehi ne bah deikhaio;
Khrista nou sousa peilai, puh louchelo,
Hushu zheehi ne bah deikhaio.
Ne hrishuyu Mapao thaifüta laiwu?
Hushu zheehi ne bah deikhaio;
Ne puh vei chipao hinou hrübu laiwu?
Hushu zheehi ne bah deikhaio.
Ne rako mahkou pfü-a kaota laiwu?
Hushu zheehi ne bah deikhaio;
Nele kikhu houpeio, Mapao paloulo,
Hushu zheehi ne bah deikhaio.

title: TAVEO OH! TAVEO
firstLine: Tavelo, Khrista nou kuwe
author: I.H.M.

lines: Tavelo, Khrista nou kuwe,
Mah ludu hi bupuso,
Neye phuyu raisü philo,
Raki hilo sü zhulo.
Tavelo, Khrista nou jüpae,
Puh vei leshi sü paopeio;
Puh zhuvea ne jüpa mowu?
Puh hi nou tala laiwu?
Tavelo ne chaopu khaiso,
Aetou peiyu chu teile,
Jisu hinou ne thou shilo,
Puh nghoujü hi tavelo.

title: JISU TAKOUWE
firstLine: Levea laimai soyu ngaolai
author: E.E. Hewitt

lines: Levea laimai soyu ngaolai,
Jisu takou bure, velo,
Khayu ngaore buh hi,
Puh chipao lou chelo.
Kousü laimai takou lourao,
Jisu takou bure,
Nevei veachi Puh nou keipeie,
Puh neye lailai moe.
Tave reizü laimai paolo,
Jisu takou bure,
Ahri raokhao nou vaipeilai,
Alia ne khaloulai.
Lepe bumai Puh hi taveo,
Jisu takou bure,
Kaona buyu Puh hi zhulo,
Raki hi teiva süe.

title: EYE ZHULO
firstLine: “Eye zhulo, ne khailoulai,” zhulo maihrülai nou
author: W.P. Mackay

lines: “Eye zhulo, ne khailoulai,” zhulo maihrülai nou,
Zhulo, toungi touha tsüle, zhulo, mahmai hrülai.
“Eye zhulo, ne khailoulai,” zhulo pikhaitouso,
Zhulo, nesü ha-a bure, zhulo, zhou ku-a bue.
“Eye zhulo, ne khailoulai”, zhulo piyu phaki,
Zhulo ne mahmo hisünou, zhulo ne nghidzü koua.
“Eye zhulo, ne khailoulai,” zhulo cheyu vah hi,
Zhulo, mainah Poutou hisü, zhulo ne mah hare.

chorus: Puhye zhulo, ne khailoulai, O, veahoyu rako;
Jisuye zhulo, ngaoloure hinou, Puhye zhulo.

title: MAITALI NOUA KULOUZÜ
firstLine: Oh, asayu chipao keio, buhliki paovewe
author: Julia Sterling

lines: Oh, asayu chipao keio, buhliki paovewe,
Puhnou thaipei vanou chekhou-a khailupeire;
Jihovah vei chipao hai cheche maihrülai hi,
Louchea Puhye zhulou mai, Jisu vei zhih kulo.
Azhi hi buyu rako, Mah ludu hi tawe,
Zhukhaio zhuvea vei ava, Jihovah zhaotu-ye;
Chu-o netsü-le teitei nou Puh ye louchelo,
Puh zhih kulou bumai, hrülai teisa halai moe.
Mainou souvea laimai, kousüh pfü-a bukhemai,
Puh nou neye kho-a bue, nekou pfükha laitea;
Maihrülai ngaozüyu muteiyu pha puhnou peie,
Puh zhih kulou maisü, louche-a Puhye zhulo.

chorus: Maita linou kuzü, Jisu zhih kulou zü,
Maita linoua Puh zhih kulouzü khaipeilai;
Maita linou kuzü, Jisu zhih kulouzü,
Maita lia Mapao zhih kulouzü khaipeilai.

title: VELO, VEISHI SOUDARE
englishTitle: Come, For All Things Are Ready
firstLine: Velo, veishi soudare! Leshiyu ralyahi
author: L.H. Edmunds

lines: Velo, veishi soudare! Leshiyu ralyahi,
Haisü sa-a kuyu baie, Raki hi Mapao nou;
Haisü zhenou khükhaitoue, Kalvari vei zhenou,
Khupayu dzüla hinou rako soushee loulai.
Velo veishi soudare! Rako tousho zhipeie,
Khailupeiyu pai polo, ahri raokhao polo;
Toureha, lülou hoyu mahmo mai tavelo,
Hou-a reiyu maitao sü Mapao nou phou-a bue.
Velo veishi soudare! Vüra büa kaayu zhao,
Nakukhe jünou veipue, Rako Mashi büa bue;
Jisu vei zhai avei nou neye hore donou,
Sabanü süna likhei nou kholo, ne peilai.

chorus: Jisuhi chekhou-a bue, süloua daizhou sawe,
Etao mah zheho büa bua, vüra büa kaalai.
tune: Come, For All Things Are Ready

title: OH, KHAI-APEIO
firstLine: Velo Mapao hi Puh leshi pai keio
author: J. Sterling

lines: Velo Mapao hi Puh leshi pai keio,
Acheche (sa)mai ne ngaolouhoe;
Puh nou ne khowe Puhye louche lo,
Pai nasha tea Puh ne kue.
Chu-wo savare chipao sü vere,
Jisu hai (A)hri Cheche, Ludue;
Velo dzüla hi mai hrülai buh bue,
Jisu ne veyu khowe.
Rako nou nashoa neletao hi paoe,
Ne Mapao (vei) zhuvea laiwu so,
Sashoa Puh shelo, Puh pa tala so,
Puhye phoulou mai salai.

chorus: Puh nou khai peilai khobuki thakhaio;
Puh nou kho-a bue, levea pukhaiso,

title: EYE ZHULO ALIA KHAILO
englishTitle: Look Unto Me And Be Ye Saved
firstLine: Eye zhulo, ne khaipeilai! Oh! Puh nou paoyu keio
author: El. Nathan

lines: Eye zhulo, ne khaipeilai! Oh! Puh nou paoyu keio,
Khailu louyu sa-a peilai, Deiphao teitei shapeio.
“Eye zhulo,” Kros pei hisü, Kousü-a veayu mai;
Ne mahsü ava pokhaire, Louchelou sousheelo,
“Eye zhulo,” ne Mapao sü, athao veyu phaki,
Saitan ye khuloure donou zhuvea sü sa peilai.
“Eye zhulo,” la ne yuhso kukhe soukhare hae;
Kaonayu ngaoloure donou, E likheiye zhulo.

tune: Look Unto Me And Be Ye Saved

title: NE EA E DONOUE
firstLine: Jisu nou pai nasha-a neye kuwe
author: W.L.T.

lines: Jisu nou pai nasha-a neye kuwe,
Ne ea E donou kuwe;
Jisu nou soutao sou-a kho-a zhuwe,
Ne ea E donou zhuwe.
Jisu nou kubuki daisou nou vemoe?
Ne ea E donou paowe,
Daisou nou etao Puh vei zhuvea sümoe?
Zhuvea ne ea E donoue.
Chuwo phateile hai zhaota –a bure,
Ahi nehi nou zhaotae,
Hashi nou ne Eye sou halai tea bue,
Ne ea E donou vewe.
Oh, khupa leshi ne peilai tea paopeie
Ne, Eye donou paopeie,
Eh nou mahsou-a Puhnou zhuvea peire,
Ne, Eye donou khaipeie.

chorus: Lenou shoa, pai veishoa neye kubuwe

title: DZÜLA HI TAVELO
firstLine: Nemah kou pfüa dzüla hi veo
author: F.J. Crosby

lines: Nemah kou pfüa dzüla hi veo,
Veayu kou ne pfü velo;
Pfüve dzü khe hi povuwo,
Sühi asoyu ngaolai.
Ne dzüla hisü tavelo,
Jisu nou ne kho-a bue;
Nemah khe hora buyu ma,
Vüra bü-a kaloulai.
Haisü Mapao nou paoyu chie,
Maitalia hrü dalouzü,
Mapaoye lü louche louzü,
Puh hinou hriyu ngaolai.
Dzüla hi tave souveilo,
Mapao lapai sü keilo;
Mahmai nou dakhai veyuki,
Raki vamai asalai.

chorus: Ne daisou nou chao-a rako souhae?

title: THAOWU RAO
firstLine: Velo, mahmai velo tea kuwe,Jisu phi velo
author: F.J. Crosby

lines: Velo, mahmai velo tea kuwe,Jisu phi velo;
Velo leda lou-a thaowu rao,Jisu phihi thao.
Velo, asoloure sü phoulo, Jisu phi velo;
Ne levea-a nou hrüyu phaki, Jisu phihi thao.
Velo, ne lü vanou veiloulai, Jisu phi velo;
Velo veahoyu ne rako sü, Jisu phi velo.
Velo, Mapao hisü ne buh bue, Jisu phi velo;
Ne kou süyu teitei thaowurao, chu thaoha wurao.

title: AHI VELOU MAISÜ
firstLine: Keinoulo Mapao nou neye kubue
author: E.E. Hewitt

lines: Keinoulo Mapao nou neye kubue,
Raki vamai pai jünou vei hie,
Pai nasho-a Puh nou neye kuwe.
Maihrülai velo tea kue.
Levea-a nou kousü pfülai khemai,
Sasho-a khailoure sü ngaolai;
Kou pfü kharepu nehi nou labue,
Ne kou pfükha peilousüe.
Tavelo hriloure dzüla hisü,
Reizüa bumai panou khaloulai;
Nenou li-a buyu jünou kou-a,
Puh nou thoupu peilaitie.

chorus: E nou hulai khai lai moe.

title: VENÜYU MAISÜ
firstLine: Jisu chi sülouyu khemai hrülai nou
author: P.P.B.

lines: Jisu chi sülouyu khemai hrülai nou,
Deiphao mai veishi hi ko hai paongaopeio;
Maitali ngaoyu ma ko veisü paopeio,
Venüyu maisü velo.
Venüyu khemai sü panou ve mazhio,
Kikhu houkhaitou bukinou tavelo;
Jisu likhei cheche hriloure ludue,
Venüyu maisü velo.
Paokhaitou chipao sü vete molou hoe,
Venüyu maisü teisa shamea bulo;
Venüyu maisü teisa hri ngaoloulai,
Venüyu maisü velo.

chorus: Rakibu Puo nou leshia molaimai kue,

title: JIHOVAH NOU KUWE
firstLine: Jihovah nou chukoute kue
author: Tersteegen

lines: Jihovah nou chukoute kue,
E Mapao pai keilou moa nou;
Teile souha pulai hiwu?
Arako zhi bulai hiwu?
Jihovah nou chu koute kue,
E Puh ngaophou moa bulaiwu?
Chu koute Eye ku-a bue,
Tashu loumoa bulai hiwu?
Jihovah nou chu koute kue,
Puh houthou peimoa bulaiwu?
Chu koute Puh nou kho-a bue;
E Puh Rako souvea laiwu?

chorus: Jihovah nou chukoute ku-a bue, keilo;
Jihovah nou chu koute kuwe, keilo.

title: JISU NOU KUWE
firstLine: Jisu nou pai nasha-a ne kuwe
author: F.J. Crosby

lines: Jisu nou pai nasha-a ne kuwe,
Zhou ne kuwe, zhou ne kuwe;
Dai donou ne Puh leshi hi bumoa,
Doukhai doukhai ta-a bue.
Jisu nou vealai mai solo tea kue,
Zhou ne kuwe, zhou ne kuwe;
Puh hi nekou pfüvelo soloulai,
Puh nou ne hulai laimoe.
Jisu nou khowe Puh hi chu velo,
Zhou ne khowe, zhou ne khowe;
Ne mah kou pfüve Puh hi thaolourao,
Velo, ne chaopu khaiso.
Jisu nou layu paisü ne keilo,
Puh pai keilo, Puh pai keilo;
Puh zhih hinou lüloumai saloulai,
Shulo, thara tavelo.

chorus: Zhou ne kuwe, zhou ne kuwe,
