Jisu nou leshi kuwe; zhou neye ku-a bue.

title: CHIPAO AVEI HU
firstLine: Chipao avei hu dawe, deiphao kainghou adaihi
author: S.W.M.

lines: Chipao avei hu dawe, deiphao kainghou adaihi,
Masa-a khaipeiyu kosü, Neye Eye donou peie;
“Jihovah nou leshia, Puh nah poutouye seipeie,
Puhye lülo maihrülai nou, teisa ahri ngaoloulai.”
Chipao veinou Etao kue, souda khaiyu nüh buh hi,
Malaiyu sü soupei khaiso, leshi sho-a ku buyu;
“E hriloure raokhaoe,Ve toulo houzü laimai;
Netaonou mahmo souyuma,
Netao mahmo khaipeilai.”
Chipao avei hu dawe, holo hailo süvere;
Khaipeilaiyu ko povewe, thaipeiyu Mapao vanou;
“Asasho loure ko, mai hrülai hisü paove;
Netao donou Mapao napeie,
Mapao Jisu Vewo sü.”

chorus: Chipao vei hu dawe, deiphao kainghou adaihi
Chipao vei masa peie, Neye Eye donou tea.

title: LESHIYU PAINOU KUWE
firstLine: Mo-a laiyu ne dakhai velou rao
author: F.J. Crosby

lines: Mo-a laiyu ne dakhai velou rao,
Zhuwo zhaokhopu nou zhou ne kuwe;
Khaipeilai tea phoue, Soushee peilai tea,
Thasho Puh daolo, Ne chaopu khaiso.
Chukoutea khobue, ne pa hanü moe,
Puh vehi nou ne dousho tayuma;
Puh zhenou, neye khailu papeire,
Paoshalou hoe, Puh vei khupa leshi.
Puh vei chipao keio, Puh zhuvea licho,
Nemah donou Kros vanou ve thaipeie;
Mah khailupei-a ahri sü peire,
Halou hoyu rako sü nehi peie.
Duraina hi veo, cheche duhi veo,
Jisu vanou veo, Puh nou kikhu süe;
Puh hai zhaokho pue, puh nou ku-a bue,
Tave loulourao, ne chao pukhaiso.

title: CHAOLAI NAYE KUWE
firstLine: Chaolaiyu nahtouye Jisu nou leshia kubue
author: C.H.G.

lines: Chaolaiyu nahtouye Jisu nou leshia kubue,
Keilo oh! keilo chu neye ku-a bue,
Ne Puh nghoujü nou dousho tama zhou khaivelo,
Keilo leshi pai, chu-a kue.
Puo nou zhuvea leshi hinou chu koute kuwe,
Keilo oh! keilo chu neye ku-a bue,
Oh! Rako nou leshia paokha buki khaivelo,
Keilo leshi pai, chu-a kue.
Velo, ne Puo kihi touso alaosou-a bue,
Keilo oh! keilo chu neye ku-a bue,
Zhukhaio! vaizhore touso souda-a ne khobue,
Keilo leshi pai, chu-a kue.
Chaolainah sübü-a rarou-a buyu khemai,
Ne mahmo hisü nou nele dalourao,
Mapao vei zhuveahi ne thasho tave loulo,
Keilo leshi pai, chu-a kue.

chorus: Neye ku-a bue, Chaolai nah dakhai velo;
Jisu nou kubue, Thasho ne dakhai velo.

title: VAH SOULAIKHE
firstLine: Jisu vah soulaikhe, eletao Puh kilai
author: F.J. Crosby

lines: Jisu vah soulaikhe, eletao Puh kilai,
Mapao nou tayu ludu majü talaikhe;
Mapao hisü nou eh khouko khopulou-a,
Eh nou soulousü vahsü eitea soulaikhe.
Jisu vah soulaikhe, reizüa laimai vailo,
Hriloure dzüla hi save peilou laikhe;
Kros süna vanou eh khouko sü soulou lai,
“Masa khaipeilai” touyu chihai shapaopeio.
Vasou lo, vah soulo, vasoure busü bue,
Teizhihi Saitan vei vedei sü kaobailai;
Sühinou Jihovah zhisü paosho loulai,
Khaipeiyu haire sakhaibai tea lousoulai.

title: MAPAO HI VELO
firstLine: Mapao hi veo, ne chaopu khaiso
author: G.F.R.

lines: Mapao hi veo, ne chaopu khaiso,
Puh chipao nou ludu ngaopeilai;
Puh etao hrohinou la-a bue,
Tavelo tea kuwe.
Oh! nahtou khemai Puh paikeilo,
Nele teitei nou asa lourao;
Zhou Mapaoye etao daolaikhe,
Tavelo chaokhaiso,
Zhou Puh nou etaoye ko-a bue,
Puh chikha hai ne zütao louwo;
Pai nasha-a kuyu keinoulo,
“Anah khemai velo!”.

title: AHI VELO
firstLine: “Ahi velo” tea Jisu nou kuwe
author: Nathaniel Norton

lines: “Ahi velo” tea Jisu nou kuwe,
Hriyu Mapao nou nele sousa peie;
Levea laimai, kou masü pfükhemai,
“Ahi velo,” E ne pasoloulai.
Veasho-a nou hrübu khemai hrülai,
Ahi velo tea Mapao nou kuwe;
Ne lekiyu, leveayu sü halai,
“Ahi velo,” Kaonayu ne ngaolai.
Mah hinou thainono lekhai bumai,
Ne lashu Jihovah ye lülourao;
Ngaopi-a buyu sü khaisou laire,
“Ahi velo,” E ne ahri peilai.
Kaonayu hrü athai bupu laimoe,
Mapao nou ne pa teisa nou solai;
Deiphao hinou sayu zhingao-a bue,
Raki hinou Puhnou etao kho bue.

chorus: E ne pa solai; E ne pa solai,

title: MAHMAI TAVELO
firstLine: Jisu nou kubuki, mahmai tavelo
author: W.E. Witter

lines: Jisu nou kubuki, mahmai tavelo,
Ne donou veachi paobuki tavelo;
Chu Puhye poyu phae, mahmai tavelo,
Chu Puhye süyu phae, mahmai tavelo.
Nevei kou süshowu? mahmai tavelo,
Jisu nou pfükhalai, mahmai tavelo;
Jisu nou lailaimoe, mahmai tavelo;
Jisu nou popeilai, mahmai tavelo.
Puh nou kuyu keilo, mahmai tavelo,
Veo, Puh hasü polo, mahmai tavelo;
Jisu nou kubuki, mahmai tavelo,
Ne donou veachi paobuki tavelo.
Dousho talayu khemai, taveloulo,
Nele chemoyu veishi thaoa, tavelo;
Chukoute ne khobue, khaipeire donou;
Masa nou neye khaipeilai, tavelo.

title: JISU NOU EYE LESHIE
firstLine: Jisu nou Eye leshie, Baibel hinou paokhaitoue
author: Anna Warner

lines: Jisu nou Eye leshie,
Baibel hinou paokhaitoue,
Nahmai hrülai sü Puh veie,
Puh hai khouko bu Mapaoe.
Jisu nou Eye leshie,
Rakiva kikhu houpeie;
Puh nou Amah khüshee peie,
Puh vei nahmai pa loulo.
Jisu nou Eye leshie,
Puh nou E salai peilai;
E deiphao hinou thai-a
Puh nou raki sakhelai.

chorus: Jisu E leshie, Ovai E leshie,
Jisu E leshie, Baibel hinou paowe.

title: JIHOVAH KHU LESHI
firstLine: Jihovah khu leshi haisü
author: C. Wesley

lines: Jihovah khu leshi haisü,
Deiphao hilo seikou peio;
Ne leshi sü nou Eletao,
Le khe hi phou peio tea khoe;
Leshi peiyu Mapao Jisu,
Ne leshi chemoyu hae;
Nevei khailu peiyu ko-a
Etao hi vepeio tea khoe.
Levea buyu maikhemai hi,
Ne rako sü koulou peio;
Etao nevei kaa thaolou lai,
Nevei sobuh pa ngaolai;
Taveo, Ne etao pophapeio,
Ne zhuvea eh pa ngaolo,
Chu-o etao Nehi khaive,
Nehi nou tapu laimoe.
Nevei sheetouyu bahsha büa,
Etao-a zhaivei loulai,
Etao khailu peiyu ngaolai;
Nenou sheesha tea peire;
Adusho hinou paoshoyu,
Etao buh ngaolou mosa;
Etao peirü Nehi khailai,
Nevei leshi paosholai.

title: LESHI NOU E PHOULOUE
englishTitle: Oh! The Love That Sought Me
firstLine: Enou mahsou bu phaki, Puh nou Eye phouloue
author: W. Spencer Walton

lines: Enou mahsou bu phaki,
Puh nou Eye phouloue;
Puh nou Eye salou-a zhaomehi save peie;
Rakimai nou lousou phaki,
Rakinou husü da-a bue;
E thaiyuno buphahi,
Puh nou E ve ngaoloue;
Puh pai nasho Ahi paoe, ‘Enou ne ngaoloure,’
Puh paijü veiyu lia sümoe,
Puh pai nou Ale sou sapeie.
Puhbah hi hushu veapeie,
E donou zhe kükoue;
Puh peihi hushu peirü, ngaobamai nou rüpeie,
Puh nou Eye leshi vanou
Haizhozhou veasho-a thaipeie.

tune: Oh! The Love That Sought Me

title: LESHI HISÜ BUE
firstLine: Muteishoyu rakitsü, deiphao hi phouloure
author: D.W. Whittle

lines: Muteishoyu rakitsü, deiphao hi phouloure,
Ramai vei leshi hai, Jisu hinou ve ngaoloue.
Jihovah chipao nou Etao hisü pongaopeie,
Rükhai touyu chipao hai Jisu vanou vepeie.
Lü-a louche vanou Jihovah leshi ngaoloue,
Amahmo khailouyu Kalvari sü louchewe.
Rako Mashi nou ve rakivei zhopao soupeie,
Ramai chipao vanou Jisu vei leshi süloue.

title: JISU EYE LESHIPU
firstLine: Jisu Eye leshipu, E pa nehi nou bailo
author: C. Wesley

lines: Jisu Eye leshipu,
E pa nehi nou bailo;
Reidzü nou duyu phaki,
Teikhai teirüshi yuki,
Pokupeio Khailupeipu,
Deiphao ashi hamosa;
Rakiva save thoupeio,
Arako sü popeilo.
Bailoure buh kukhe hae,
Arako Nehi nou bue;
E ye hai Nenou thaoso,
Teithetsü E soukhapeio;
E neye lülouchea bue,
E Ne soukha sü ngaolai;
Soulousüvei khouko hae,
Ne shoukhe nou pa bailo.
Enou liyu hrülai sü,
Nehi nou ve ngaoloulai;
Kaolaiyu hi soulapeie,
Nghicha, sounou souvei peie;
Ne zhihsü sheesho- a bue,
Amah kousü pfü-a bue;
Zhuvea peiyu teitei sü,
Mapao Ne bah hinou bue.

title: LESHI NOU E SÜSHU LAPEIE
firstLine: Mahmo nou Eye sa-a hashi hisü loure
author: James Rowe & F.S. Turney

lines: Mahmo nou Eye sa-a hashi hisü loure,
E hashi hinou tapa lousü mo-a bure;
Süphaki Mapao Jisu nou Apai choulou-a,
Eye süthaipa Puh hi save khaire.
Rako hriloure ludu sü Jisu likheibaie,
Mapao Jisu nou zhuvea donou E popaloue;
Rakoshi dao-a bumai, Jisu hisü velo;
Mapao Jisunou neye soukha peilai.
Arako vea-a buyu, Jisu nou souva peie,
Hali hala soulousü, Mapao Jisu hi bue;
Zhaidu peihi-a Puh nou soulou sü khouko bue,
Puh hi velouyu maisü asasho bue.

chorus: Jisu vanou Eye sü popa loure;
Jisu vanou Eye sü popa loure.

title: LESHI NOU VAYUKI
firstLine: Jisu leshi nou Alekhele valouzü
author: Mrs. Frank A. Breck

lines: Jisu leshi nou Alekhele valouzü,
Veayu sü halai leshi nou vapeiyuki;
Leshi nou etaoye sü, Veachi paoyu doupeilai,
Leshi nou vayuki teizhi pulai moe.
Leshi nou vayu ki, deiphao sü zhai veilai,
Alekhe hi sasholai Puh leshi ngaoloua;
Athao jünou kolouthai, Rakosü kaona bulai,
Puh leshi nou Alesü veipu palai.
Leshi nou vayuki, etao veipu palai,
Puh leshi hinou, checheyu samai soulai,
Deiphao tacho louyu thai, Eh raki hilo khelai,
Puh leshi va sü nou, teinghei-a komoe.

chorus: Sayu hai kaonayu maihi po ngaopeilai.

title: OH! PUH E DAIZHOU LESHIE
firstLine: Mutei shoyu samaili bue, Oh! Puh E leshie
author: Rev. Johnson Oatman, Jun.

lines: Mutei shoyu samaili bue,
Oh! Puh E leshie
Puhnou leshiyu akhai hae,
Oh! Puh E leshie.
Puh daidonou deiphao vesa!
Oh! Puh E leshie;
Puh nou Alekhe hi bupeie,
Oh! Puh E leshie.
Athai hinou Puh nou khaipeie,
Oh! Puh E leshie;
Amü nou Puh kalo paolai,
Oh! Puh E leshie.
Puh nou kili souda khaitoue,
Oh! Puh E leshie;
E Puh teisa ve sahrülai,
Oh! Puh E leshie.

chorus: Oh! Puh E leshie, Oh! Puh E leshie,

title: ZHUKHAIO DAIZHOU LESHIE
firstLine: Zhukhaio, Jihovah leshihai, Daizhozhou dushosa!
author: M.S.S.

lines: Zhukhaio, Jihovah leshihai,
Daizhozhou dushosa!
Mahmo hinou khailu popa,
Jihovah nah soupeie.
Mutei zhe kükou pei vanou,
Puh hi save ngheiloue;
Jisu louche louyu vanou;
Jihovah nah souloue.
E raki hi kheyu kisü,
Daizhozhou asalai;
Etao Mapao ve ngaoyuki,
Etao Puh zhu railai.
Ve ngaolai tea louche vanou,
Etao sheepu loulai,
Etao hrishu Mapao railai,
Etao Puh zhu ngaolai.

title: MÜNOU PAOSHA LOU HOE
firstLine: Jisu E donou leshiyu, Kros vanou veashoa thaipeire
author: J.E.H.

lines: Jisu E donou leshiyu,
Kros vanou veashoa thaipeire;
Eye khailupa peiyu hai,
Mü nou paosha louhoe.
Veashoyu sü Puhnou pfüpeie,
Oh! shu peirü Puh nou rüpfüe,
E teisa hriloure donou,
Münou paosha louhoe.
Puh hi buyu Avei kaona,
Ramai nghoujü nou pao khapeie,
Puh vei muteiyu zhe nasü,
Mü nou paosha louhoe.
Puh ngheiyuki asayu ngaoe,
Pimoe soloure Puhnou peie,
Puh hi buyu areih nasü,
Münou paosha louhoe.

chorus: Jisu nou E leshiyu mü nou paosha louhoe.

title: JISU EYE LESHIE
firstLine: Rakibu Apuo nou Eye leshie
author: P.P.B.

lines: Rakibu Apuo nou Eye leshie,
Süsü cheche larü hinou süloue,
Khupa tali Baibel hinou ngaolou,
Hrülai jünou Jisu Eye leshie.
Enou Puh nghoujü nou tala-a ma,
Puh nou leshie buh taki E vema
Jisu nou E leshiyu tsülou-a,
E Puh hinou tala khaima khaive.
Oh! lou ali E nou sou-a bulai,
Veo dupusü E nou ve ngaolouthai;
Lou süna sü teisa Alou soulai,
Oh daizhou khupae Jisu E leshie.
Jisu nou Eye leshie Enou süe,
Puh leshi nou Arako sü khailoue;
Ovai Puh leshi vanou ve thaipeie,
Cheche vuzüe Jisu Eye leshie.

chorus: Puh E leshie, Puh E leshie,

title: OH! MUTEIYU JISU LESHI
firstLine: Oh! Muteiyu Jisu leshi, Daizhozhou Eh donou veie
author: E. Richmond

lines: Oh! Muteiyu Jisu leshi,
Daizhozhou Eh donou veie;
Süshoyu kousü southea peie,
Leveayu sousa peire;
Daibüa veayu souvei peisa,
Eh nou piyu hulai peie;
Daibüa teizhi hi vapeisa,
Ludu sa teiva peiwe.
Muteiyu Jisu kovei hai,
Mai hrü laihi paongaopeio;
Mai tara Puh chi zülouzü,
Sümainou hrisü ngaolai;
Mahmo hashi soubuyumai,
Ne zhai doushi thao-a nou;
Jisu Khrista hi tavelo,
Puh nou kaonayu peilai.
Jisu leshi sü E ngaolai,
Enou Puh vah soulouzü;
Puh bahnou Eye vupeilai,
Puh buyu E sülou lai;
Süthai Puh nou hasü peilai,
Puh nou E süthai peilai.
Rako nüloure soukha peio;
Ava hi süthai papeio.

title: RAMAI VEI LESHI
firstLine: Deiphaomai nou süyu jünou la-a
author: H.L.

lines: Deiphaomai nou süyu jünou la-a
Teideiphao kai nghou dai jünou la-a
Khupa sou dusho-a buyu nasü,
Khaiha Ramai vei leshie.
Amah jünou dupu sho-a buyu,
Mutei shoyu nou popa peiyu hai,
Akhaiha nou vea-hea peiyu nasü,
Khaiha Ramai vei leshie.
Thoushoyu jünou thou pusho buyu,
Kushoyu hi buyu jünou kuyu;
Tahrü veishi nou paosha louhoyu,
Khaiha Ramai vei leshie.

chorus: Alto: Sheeshoyu leshi hai münou pao vete lou hoe,
Hata kia pao hao lou hoe
Tenor & Bass: Sheeshoyu leshi ovai akhai hae,
Alto: Lüche nou buyu deichi jünou kupusho hie,
Thoushoyu zai thou jünou thou hie,
T.& B: Deichi ku jünou kupu sho hie,
Thoushoyu zai thou jünou (thou hie),thou sho hie,
Alto: Leshi vanou hukha hi buyu mai dosou peie;
Puh vei leshi hai teisa nou akhai hae.

title: EH MAH JÜNOU ZHUVEA NOU DUHIE
firstLine: Mapao vei khupa zhuvea leshi
author: Julia H. Johnson

lines: Mapao vei khupa zhuvea leshi,
Eh mah jünou zhuvea nou duhie;
Holo bu Kalvari vahi nou,
Zhaotu zhe kükou peiyu buh süe.
Zai nghouyu büa mah nou vealere,
Cholou hoyu rako halaire;
Dukouyu zhuvea kukhe hare,
Soloure buh Kros hinou ngaopeie.
Paosha louho khupa zhuvea sü,
Lülou maihi, sa-a seive peie;
Ne puh zhu ngaonü-a khobu-wu?
Ne chunou Puh zhuvea sü polo.

title: JIHOVAH LESHINAE
firstLine: Jihovah leshinou vapeie, Enou tayu buh hisü
author: Sir J. Bowring

lines: Jihovah leshinou vapeie,
Enou tayu buh hisü;
Maiyu ludu veishi hisü,
Puh leshi vanou vapeiwe.
Teisanou teile datawe,
Mai thaitae, maihrü hatae;
Ana Puh zhuvea halaimoe,
Jihovah hai leshinasüe.
Teile shishoyu veyuma,
Puh louzü taku laimoe;
Maiyu hi Puh va nou vapeie,
Jihovah hai leshinasüe.

chorus: Jihovah hai leshi nae. (repeat if desired)

title: RAMAI VEI KAONA LESHI
englishTitle: Sweet Peace, The Gift Of God’s Love
firstLine: Sayu ali Alehive Sashoyu lou E soupulai
author: P.B.

lines: Sayu ali Alehive
Sashoyu lou E soupulai,
Enou soupu khai khai bulai,
Ramai vei kaona leshi.
Khrista vanou kaona ngaoloue,
Puh thai vanou Apao khapeie;
Puh hinou moa kukhe lia hae,
Ramai vei kaona leshi.
Mapao ve peirü rüyuki,
Puh vei kaonayu E ngaolai;
Puh hi nou Etao ha ngaolai,
Ramai vei kaona leshi.
E Jisu hinou kaona bue,
Puh hi E ngheikou yu phaki,
Haku khemoe, kaona ngaoloue,
Ramai vei kaona leshi.

tune: Sweet Peace, The Gift Of God’s Love

title: PUH NOU E BÜYU MAHMAI JÜPAE
englishTitle: He Wants A Poor Sinner Like Me
firstLine: E nou khupa shoyu ko ali choue
author: Maud Frazer

lines: E nou khupa shoyu ko ali choue,
Mainah poutuo vei dushoyu khouko,
Enou mah souyu ma Puh nou Eye phouloue,
Puh E büyu mahmai jüpae.
Enou Puhye Kros hinou ngaoyuki,
Puh bah hu shuh veayu kho chouyuki;
Puh zhe kükou yuki, E süe Puh vei leshi ,
Puh E büyu mahmai leshie.
Ovai, Puh mahmai dopfümai leshie,
Mai saloure donou Puh bah khapeie;
E Puh nghoujü hinou talapu laimore,
Puh E büyu mahmai jüpae.
Ovai, Puh bah nou Eye salounüe,
Puh vei leshiyu nou Eye kholoue;
Teisa Puh nou Eye Puh hi panou bunüe,
Puh E büyu mahmai jüpae.

chorus: Puh E büyu mah mai jüpae,
Oh! khupayu Puh vei leshi Khrista zhe
Puh E büyu mah mai jüpae.
tune: He Wants A Poor Sinner Like Me

title: KIPEI HI
firstLine: Elia kipei hisü taloue, Zidzünou poupa hopfüa buki
author: C.A.M.

lines: Elia kipei hisü taloue,
Zidzünou poupa hopfüa buki;
Sühinou lapai ali Enou choue,
Ramainah nou paongaopeie.
Lereiyu Puhpai choulou-a,
Raohoutao lou souyu thaokhaire,
Puhnou Ahi paoyu leshi lapai,
Ale hinou teisa choue.
Puh koa kipei hinou bulai,
Khei teizhinou Eye sühaoma;
Puhnou E tabaio tea paoyu lapai,
Ale hinou chou-a bue.

title: ANA KHRISTA LIKHEI BAIE
firstLine: O! Khrista Ne hinou Arako bue,Ne likhei hi
author: Arr. B.E.

lines: O! Khrista Ne hinou Arako bue,Ne likhei hi,
E kaonayu phasho phoubue,
Chu koute hi ngaomoe.
E soloure ea savayu, Phou bue, Nehi nou moa;
Mapao hinou hota yuma, Puh leshi Ahi bue.
Teichayu khou nou dzü polai,
Tea soue, polou shire;
E nou külai tea souyuki,
Mai konü soubaire.
Pfüphao donou levea krawe,
Neye donou kramoe;
Ngaolouho zhuvea ngaoyuki,
Ne leshi ngaoloure.

title: BUH TAHIA, A MAPAO
firstLine: Buh tahia A Mapao Eye süthai peio
author: E.C. Ellsworth

lines: Buh tahia A Mapao Eye süthai peio,
Ne bah likhei pa keilo, Ne buyu E süe,
Shuh nou Aphi khüyuma, E Ne thai fülai
Buh tahia A Mapao Nenou süthaipeio.
Buh tahia, A Mapao, Eye zhupeilo,
Ne khouko nou souva peio, mah hi pa louso,
Aludu vea hoyuma, E pikhai laimoe,
Buh tahia, A Mapao Ne nou sabupeio.
Buh tahia, A Mapao, E nou veachi paoe,
Ludu atai hi khaipeio, Epa mota so;
Mah nou Eye kuyuma, moe tea paoloulai,
Mapao Ne nou khopeio, Aludu sasü.

chorus: E Ne thai fülai, E Ne thai fülai,

title: KHAILU PEIYU DONOU
firstLine: Amah khailu peiyu lousü E nou sounü showe
author: E.O.E.

lines: Amah khailu peiyu lousü E nou sounü showe,
Khailu peiyu Mapao vanou Eye sü khailupeie.
Maimah khailupeiyu Mapao sü E chuo ngaoloure,
Mapao jüpayu vah soulouzü E buusü ngaolai.
Mapao vasü ale khele lou-a E jüpa bue,
Lekiyu piyu veishi hakhaire, khailulou thai.
Ale sayu nou E paoshahoe, khailulou donou,
Puh zhe vanou Eye, khailupei-a soushee peire.

chorus: Khailu peiyu donou, khailu peiyu donou,

title: ENOU SÜE ENOU LOUCHEYU PU
firstLine: Jihovah nou E leshiyu, Enou süve temoe
author: El. Nathan

lines: Jihovah nou E leshiyu,
Enou süve temoe;
Enou havei souloumo-a,
Puhnou Eye sü kue.
Rako nou mahmai khopeiyu,
Enou süve temoe;
Mapao Jisu lütao louzü
Kaona Ahi bulai.
Mapao vere teile sümoe,
Daipha kinou velai?
E thaiyu thainou velaiho,
Hribu kinou laisa?

title: TEIVA SÜNOU ARAKO VAPEIE
firstLine: Jisu Ahi vemo koute Esü teizhi hi bue
author: J.W. Van De Venter

lines: Jisu Ahi vemo koute Esü teizhi hi bue,
Puh vei leshi teiva nou Ahi teizhi hulai peie.
Teihao sünou reiko-khekou chao sühao louyuma,
Deiphao teitei zhitei yuma Jisu va Ahi bue.
Puh vei avah hi tayuki, vayu, sayu ngaoloue,
E nghoujülo takou lou-a, deiphao thailo khaire.
Enou heiphao tao tachopa deikho avei hi tae,
Puh vei leshi teiva hinou sanathou cha chiloue.
Thalasou E nou Mapaoye zhu vuzü nou ngaolai,
Teisa nou Puh vei vashoyu zhusü ngao-a bulai.

chorus: Teiva sü nou Arako vapeie, (ovai zhou)
Puh vei leshi teiva sü Alekhe bue.

title: NE SAKHIBEI PFÜLOU SÜWU?
firstLine: Ne sakhibei teikhai hi pfülou süo?
author: Prescilla J. Owens

lines: Ne sakhibei teikhai hi pfülou süo?
Teihao chaovea teikhai teirü veki;
Zaidzü nou chisho-a rai paiyuki,
Ne sakhibei pfü lou sü ho moe?
Teikhaishi vema rai dekhai laimoe,
Mapao bah vuzü nou raipai-a bue;
Teikhai teirüshi nou houve yuma,
Etao sakhao dzükhe lei laimoe.
Varuyu zaipe sana nuh hisü,
Nenou shona hinou zhubu homoe?
Teikhai teirü latayu thai nesü
Rakihi ve bulousü homoe?

chorus: Zai dzü nou chi shoa houpa yuki,
Lüsha louho chuh hi khi khaitoue.

title: KHAI APEIO NGAOLOUTHAI
firstLine: Ahrü hai tyaku shoa zhingaoe, Khai-apeio ngaolouthai
author: E.E. Hewitt

lines: Ahrü hai tyaku shoa zhingaoe,
Khai-apeio ngaolouthai,
Puh zhuvea kross hinou zhingaoe,
Eye leshi khai-apeio
Puh leshi nou Eye phouloue
E khai-apeio ngaoloue,
Khailu louyu Puh nou peiwe,
Avei Mapao khai-apeio
Teihao nou chaovelouyu ma,
Khai-apeio ngaolouthai
Teisa Eye khailu-apeio
Puhnou Eye koa bupeie.
Puh bah nou Eye satapeie,
Khai-apeio ngaolouthai,
Puh nou Eye süthai laipeie,
Oh! A Mapaoye ngaolai.

title: E KHRISTA PAOH PFÜRE
firstLine: E choue, Mapao nou paoe, “Ne khouko alia hae”
author: E.M. Hall

lines: E choue, Mapao nou paoe, “Ne khouko alia hae”
Lülou hoyu nahtou, khouko Ahi ngaolai,
Mapao E Ne ngaoloue, Ne khouko likhei nou,
Mah cha souha lousüe, khouyu le souno peie.
Ne jüpa souloure, Ahi veiyu lia hae;
Avei sabanüsü, Zhaotu zhenou khüloue.
Puh vebu nghoujühi, E ve layu phaki,
Avei vah veishisü, Jisu phi povelai.
Raki vebu hinou, Veishoa ve layuki,
Avei peirü nasü, Jisu phihi thaolai.

chorus: Jisu nou khapeie, E Puh paoh pfüre,

title: E PUH PAI SÜE
firstLine: E A Mapao ngaomo yuma, Phabusa Puh nou E paopeie
author: Rev. J. Oatman, Jun

lines: E A Mapao ngaomo yuma,
Phabusa Puh nou E paopeie;
E nou Puhye Avei souloue,
Oh Mapao sho, E Puh pai süe
Enou Puh zhai ngaomo yuma,
Teikhai hronou E Puh pai choue;
Puh nou teikhai shi souna peie,
Teinghei pare, kaona khaire.
Puh nou Ahi cheche nou paoe,
Sava sholoure ko khesü;
Puh nou Ahi leshi ko paoe,
Raki vei ko Ahi paopeie.

chorus: E Puhpai choue, Mapao vei pai,
Puh pai nou Ale sou sapeie;
Puh nou Ahi chipha yuki,(chiphayu ki)
E Puh pai süe. (E Puh pai süe).

title: PUH HI CHEKHO BUE
firstLine: Zhuvea leshi sünou phoutao pfüa buyu Khrista
author: E.C. Green

lines: Zhuvea leshi sünou phoutao pfüa buyu Khrista,
Manna sü Puh hibue, Pokuyu buh Puh hi bue;
Chavei yu Puh hi bue, Ahri sü Puh hinou bue,
Khai peiyu Puh hi bue, Puh hi züvei pulai moe.
Puh hinou E so bue, E nou paongaokhai louhoe,
Halia moyu hinou, Ale sü souvea bu-a;
Kalo paoshoyu koa Puh vei zhuvea kaona sü,
Teithe tsü E ngaoloue, A tsüle kaona khai peie.
E Neye ngaoyuki, Zhuhao nou ve daoyuki,
Ne zhuhai ngaolouzü, Sünanou veipu kalai;
Süthai E lou soulai, Veishi sü E ngaoloure,
Puhye paosho peikhaio, Puh nou Eye khailupeie.

chorus: Puh hi, (Puh hi) Puh hi (Puh hi)
Puh kuvah souhi chekhoyu ha ngaolai;
Puh hi, (Puh hi) Puh hi, (Puh hi)

title: EH KEILAI NE PAOPU PEIO
englishTitle: Let Us Hear You Tell It
firstLine: O! Mapao nou khaipeiyu ko ne paowu?
author: J.M.W.

lines: O! Mapao nou khaipeiyu ko ne paowu?
Eletao nou keilai ne paopu peikhaio;
Puh nou thaipeiyu Kros hi ne veyu ko,
Eletao nou keilai ne paopu peikhaio,
Ne chuwo Puh ava hinou tawu?
Nevei mah teitei khüshee homoe?
Puh nou nevei teisa savayu nawu?
Eletao nou keilai ne paopu peikhaio.
Ludu hi veaho buki Mapao buwu?
Eletao nou keilai ne paopu pei khaio;
Jisu nou neye soutaosou sapeiwu?
Eletao nou keilai ne paopu peikhaio,
Puh zhai büyu samai ne ngaolou hoe,
Ne veabuki soukha peilousüe,
Deiphao mainou sülai Puh ne dai soupeie,
Eletao nou keilai ne paopu peikhaio.
Ne nou züyu reih buh hinou veiloure,
Eletao nou keilai ne paopu peikhaio;
Süna nou maikhe maiye soukha peilai,
Eletao nou keilai ne paopu peikhaio,
Chuwo etao rashiye zü-a bue,
Thalasou Khrista nou Veo soulai,
Mapao reihmai ne rako ali nülouo,
Eletao nou keilai ne paopu peikhaio.

chorus: Eh keilai, Ne paopu peikhaio, paopu peio,
Süna nou neye soukha lai, Eletao nou keilai
tune: Let Us Hear You Tell It

title: PUH NOU PEIYU KROS
firstLine: Puhnou peiyu Kros hai süshowe, Ana Puh leshi sühie
author: B.B.

lines: Puhnou peiyu Kros hai süshowe, Ana Puh leshi sühie,
Piyu nou E sühaoyu phakia, Puh Ahi nou tala khaimoe.
Aludu hi buyu shu khesü, Veo peirü jünou dumoe;
E nou kü-a buyu pai sünou, Gethsemane paijü khamoe.
Puh vei leshi vasü va-a bue, Vealaimai duhi vapeie,
Deiphao Avei vah hai cheloure, E nou rakilo zhi-a bue.
Puh jüpa souyu hai E sashoe, Puh nghoujü hi tabuki;
Avei teitei sü Puh hi pove, Sülikhei nou E sa bubaie.

chorus: Kros nou Puh zhuvea jünou dumoe,
Teikhai nou Puh zhu poku louhoe;
Jisu nou E salaiyu E süloua sasho-a bue,

title: E NOU NEYE NGAILAI MOE
firstLine: E nou neye mangaiwu laimoe tea paoe
author: C.H.G.(arr)

lines: E nou neye mangaiwu laimoe tea paoe,
Hatalinou Arako hulai lou hoe;
Deikho hisü khei teizhi-a buyu ma,
Sü tacho palouzü varu poa bulai.
Enou Jisu kalo daibü-a paolai?
Halaimoyu Puh vei leshi nou khopeie;
Puhnou Eye khaipei ko maihi paolai,
Puh chi zübu louzü, putao khailoulai.
Paopeiyu chi louche, E Ne ngailaimoe,
Nghoujülo takoulai sayu lou sou-a;
Mainou ngaoba-a, samai nou E thao-a,
Jisu E koa bulai, E sayu ngaolai.
E sana kikhu hi ve lah louyuki,
Avei veahoyu hrülai lata khailai;
Asasa “kilai veiwo taloulo”tea,
Eye sülouyu daizhou veisho laisa.

chorus: E nou Neye thao wu khai laimoe,
E nou ne Mapaoe E ne zhupeilai.

title: E MAHMAI ALIE
firstLine: Ahi halia hae, tihtea buyu hai
author: James M. Gray

lines: Ahi halia hae, tihtea buyu hai
Zhuvea nou ngaoloue louchelou vanou;
Khaophu souyu-a E thaowure,
E mah soumai alie, khaipeire.
Vuli Ahrü hai, mah hinou hrü bue,
A phika Ramai hinou doutare;
Jisu nou phouloue, E asashoe,
E mah soumai alie, khaipeire.
Nghidzü-a koumoe, E havei lia hae,
Zhuvea nou khaipeie, E thaire hinou;
Mah nou Ahi paoe, Ramai ngaopie,
Ana mahmai Eye, khaipeire.
Mahmai ali soua, sayu nou phoubue,
Mapao leshi vanou Puh ko paolai;
Paopu khaikhailai, E süloure,
E mah soumai alie, khaipeire.

chorus: Haisü A kowe, Ramai adusü souo,

title: E RAKO VEILI NGAOLOU SÜWU?
englishTitle: And Can It Be That I Should Gain
firstLine: Khailu-apeio vei zhe hinou, E zhou avei sü ngaoloulai
author: Charles Wesley

lines: Khailu-apeio vei zhe hinou,
E zhou avei sü ngaoloulai,
Puh nou thaipeie Amah donou
E nou Puh thai koute souveae.
Raki hi Puh vebuh thao peie
Puh vei zhuvea daizhou dusa,
Leshi vanou sakhaia vaipeie
Adam tyao sholea donou thaie.
Chuo chikuyu E pilai moe,
E Mapao veie, Puh sü aveie,
Puh hisü nou E hri-a bue,
Sheeshoyu sahnü banou bue.

tune: And Can It Be That I Should Gain

title: BETHANY HI PUH VE-E
firstLine: Leshi bue, chekhaoe, Ale sasho we
author: P.P. Bliss

lines: Leshi bue, chekhaoe, Ale sasho we,
Bethany hi Puh veyuki,
Ahri chipao nou Ale daiwure,
Bethany hi Puh veyuki.
Sayu bue, sashoe, nüsü soudare,
Bethany hi Puh veyuki,
Raki Puh pai nou thaimai souhripeie,
Bethany hi Puh veyuki.
Kaona shoyu bue, Ahrü kaonare,
Bethany hi Puh veyuki,
Rako nou kaona veishoyu lou souwe,
Bethany hi Puh veyuki,
Khouyu lü vanou kilo ngheivere,
Bethany hi Puh veyuki,
Kros ye leshi-a peirü zhingaore,
Bethany hi Puh veyuki.

chorus: Kikhu houtu peio, chupa Puh loulouo,
Puh leshi hai teisa rai büe!
Kikhu houtu peio, chupa Puh loulouo,

title: E KHAI-APEIO
firstLine: E khai-apeio lou sü soulai
author: P.P. Bliss

lines: E khai-apeio lou sü soulai,
Puh vei khupayu leshi;
Zhushi kros vanou veasho thaie,
Eye lado soulo tea.
Enou khupayu ko paolai,
Hare hinou khaipei ko;
Puh vei akhaiha leshiyu,
Pfüzho nou peia khailupeie.
E Khailu-apeio sü sholai;
Puh veilouyu ko paolai;
Veilouyu hai Puh nou peiwe,
Mah, thai, meizai jü koloue.

title: ALIA HAE
firstLine: Jisu bü-a samai kukhe mai hae
author: Rev. Johnson Oatman, Jr.

lines: Jisu bü-a samai kukhe mai hae,
Mailia hae…mailia hae;
Jisu molouzü mah khaipei mai hae,
Mailia hae… mailia hae.
Jisu büa sheeshoyu samai lia hae,
Mailia hae… mailia hae,
Puh büa nou nataiyu mai lia hae,
Mailia hae… mailia hae.
Puh büa Ehye ko tayu mailia hae,
Mailia hae… mailia hae,
Jisu büa Eye sousa peimai hae,
Mailia hae… mailia hae.
Puh nou peiyu büa mailia peilouhoe,
Peilou hoe, peilou hoe
Jisu büa Raki bu peilou maihae,
Mailia hae, mailia hae.

chorus: Puh nou Amahmo sü khai peie;
Jisu büyu samai kukhe mai hae,

title: E KHAILOURE
firstLine: E khailoure, Oh! Mapao shoe!
author: J. Sterling

lines: E khailoure, Oh! Mapao shoe!
Mahmo sü khaipeire;
Halouhoyu buh sü ngaoloue,
E donou Puh thai-peie.
E Kalvari Kros hi zhu bue,
Hriloure dzühou nou;
Ale khüshee lou-a lou soue,
Puh shoe, E khailoure.
Mupei-a nou E hrüloure,
Mapao khouko vanou;
Puh zhe nou Amah khüshee peie,
Teisanou soushee peie.

chorus: E sayu lou soulai; E khailoure,

title: PUH HAI AVEIE, E PUH VEIE
englishTitle: He Is Mine, I am His
firstLine: Hangaolouyu Mapao hai daizhozhou vei shosa
author: Grace Elizabeth Cobb

lines: Hangaolouyu Mapao hai daizhozhou vei shosa,
Puh Aveie…E Puh veie;
Raki vamai pai jünou Puh painou veishohie,
Puh Aveie…E Puh veie.
Puh maiye zhuvea leshiyu lounou E soulai,
Puh Aveie…E Puhveie;
Shona teitheyu phahi ngaoyu, bü-a ngaolai,
Puh Aveie…E Puh veie.
E ludu shilo hi takhai-a ma pilaimoe,
Puh Aveie…E Puhveie;
Puh nou Eye teisanou thaokhaimoa salaipeie,
Puh Aveie…E Puhveie.

chorus: E buh taraki veyuma Puhnou salaipeie,
Puh bahnou E ye hai süthaisa pei-a nou tae;
Puh hai Asamai veipu sütea Eno süwe;
Rakivamai pai jünou Puh painou veishohie,
tune: He Is Mine, I am His

title: AHRI DZÜHOU
firstLine: Hraoyu mahsou buh hinou E rei sho-a bue
author: J.W.P.

lines: Hraoyu mahsou buh hinou E rei sho-a bue,
Sü hinou E halia reikha ngao moe;
Ana E teithe li Khrista kros hi veloue,
Buh sühi sü hriyu dzü pousho bue.
Ramai deichi hi hriyu dzü daizhou küveie,
Ludu veishi hi Eye sousa peie;
Zhuvea ha sü Enou tayu duhisü bue,
E teisa “Halleluyah” tea sholai.
Mahmai ne zhou Kalvari hi velai mowu?
Sühi thousho dushoa dzühouli küe;
Chuo Mapao nou sakhai-a dzü külou tea kue,
Reiyu rako sühi reikha ngaolai.

chorus: E ahri dzühou hinou dzü kü-a bue
Chuo Ale sae, Arako rei khaloue,
E ahri dzühou hinou dzükü-a bue,
O, khupa shoe daizhou veiyu dzüla.

title: MAPAO YE KOA TALO
firstLine: Mapaoye koa talo, tara hi ve-a
author: Ida S. Taylor

lines: Mapaoye koa talo, tara hi ve-a,
Ludu nou shiyu ma, Puhye ngheibulo;
Ngaobamainou veki, Zhoushi veyu ki,
Jisu sa talouzü ne peire lia hae.
Mapaoye koa talo, taraki ve-a,
Teimai teizhi buh hi Puh nou ngaopeilai;
Puh va nou ne ludusa va ngaopeilai,
Radeikeeye poupa kipei soupeilai.
Mapaoye satalo ne chaobuwuso,
Puh nou paoyu chisü ne züha lourao;
Puh nou neye kubuki tashu lourao
Jisu satayu hi ne vei vuzülai.

title: PUH NOU SÜTHAI BUH
firstLine: Enou choue Mapao nou kuyu
author: EW. Blandly

lines: Enou choue Mapao nou kuyu,
Enou choue Mapao nou kuyu,
Enou choue Mapao nou kuyu,
“Ne Kros pfüloua, Athaifü talo”.
Kipei hi Puh koa E talai, (3 times)
Enou Puh koa ludu sü talai.
Veayu duhi sa tayuma, (3 times)
Enou Puh koa ludu sü talai.
Puh vei zhuvea Eye peilai, (3 times)
E koa tapeio, tapeio, luduhi.

chorus: Puh nou süthai buh E talai
Puh nou süthai buh E talai.
Puh nou süthai buh E talai,
E nou Puh koa ludu sü talai.

title: PUH NOU E SÜTHAI PEIE
firstLine: Puh nou E süthai tapeiwe
author: J.H. Gilmor

lines: Puh nou E süthai tapeiwe,
Puh chipao Ale sounapeie;
E buh taraki veyuma,
Puh nou Aludu süthaipeie.
Ale vea-a bu phaki-a,
Ale sa-a bu phaki-a;
Dzü nou soukaona peiyu büa,
Puh bah nou E süthai tapeie.
Mapao E Neye bah sülai;
Süthaisü E asa sholai;
Vei-a shi-a E khalou lai;
Mapao nou süthaipei vanou.
Deiphao Avah soucheyu thai,
Ne zhuvea nou veilouyu thai,
Athai koute E tulaimoe,
Ne nou E süthaipei vanou.

chorus: Puh bah vuzü nou süthai peie.
Puh bah nou E süthai tapeie.

title: SÜTHAIPEIO MAPAO JIHOVAH
firstLine: Süthaipeio Mapao Jihovah, Ne tave E zhupeilo
author: W. Williams

lines: Süthaipeio Mapao Jihovah,
Ne tave E zhupeilo;
E lülou hoe, ’na Ne khou chie,
Eye nevei soupeilo;
Raki raokhao nou Eye sü,
Kipeilo rako touso. (2 times)
Sana dzüla sü houpei khaio,
Darü dzüla houpei khaio;
Mei alia teihao sü panou,
Avei dusa süthai peio,
Khailu- apeio, Ne nou Arü
Soupeilo, bailoure buh. (2 times)
E deiphao tacho louyu thai,
Piyu hraoyu hakhailai;
Dzü duhi nou pocho papeio
Kainan teidei hi khaipeio,
Kalo pao-a Mapaoye sü,
Sou sholai, Mapao dusho. (2 times)

title: KALO SAVELAI
firstLine: Paokhaitou tao veishoe, zhu vea chipaoe
author: W.A.O.

lines: Paokhaitou tao veishoe, zhu vea chipaoe,
Chouyu ko khe hrohi nou Puh ko leshi pue,
Sheeshoyu Khrista le mah lia ngaomoe,
Dusho soungao peiyupue, E donou ngaopeie.
Jisu nou peiyu lesha hai veishoe,
Emai vei lesha tali jünou veikouhie,
Mahyu nae zhuvea peie, Puh cheche shoe,
Puh hai Eye donou zhaivei doupeiyupue.
‘Ahi velo’ tea kuyu paisü keio,
Vea-a kousüyu mai, ne soloure buh bue,
Paokhai tiyu lülo, cheche vuzüe,
Khai-apeio takou vülo, ne rako veilai.

chorus: E thaifü talai, Puh nou süthai hilo,

title: MAPAO E KHO-APEIO SÜE
firstLine: E nou leshiyu khopeimaili bue
author: Evan. Leonard Weaver

lines: E nou leshiyu khopeimaili bue,
Puh E khuyu münou paohao louhoe,
Kros vanou veasho thai, puh zhe kü papeie,
E sü teisa Puh leshi hi bulai.
Pouto veibuh hi Puh E sa hopeie,
Dzüla veihi Eye save thoupeie,
Puh khu leshi sünou, Eye salaipeie,
Puh salaisa E maikumai thaimoe.
Enou soure vah sou chewu thaisü,
Puh nou Eye sa kihi khetalai;
Vashoyu füdei sühi Eve hrülai,
Leshimai koa Puh phi nou ve hrülai.

chorus: Puh nou salai yu ludu shilai moe;
Jisu nou teisa E khosa laiwe.

title: SOUKHA PEIYU JIHOVAH
englishTitle: O God, Our Help In Ages Past
firstLine: Raicho ki nou Eye soukha peiyu oh Jihovah
author: Isaac Matts

lines: Raicho ki nou Eye soukha peiyu oh Jihovah,
Nehai teikhai teirü ashihi E bailoure buh-e.
Ne vebuh hinou sheeyu mai taohai poku peiwe,
Nevei bah likhei nou, Eletaoye vupei lousüe,
Po theli hai nehi louzü naili koukhe raibaie,
Shona teinghi pamojü khei teileli raibü baie.

tune: O God, Our Help In Ages Past

title: JISU E ZHUPEI MOWU?
firstLine: E nou levea a buyu phaki, Jisu E zhupei mowu?
author: Rev. Frank E. Graeff

lines: E nou levea a buyu phaki,
Jisu E zhupei mowu?
Akou pfükha peimai ha-a buki,
Aludu doushoa tabuki.
Ludu teimaia ngaopi buphaki,
Jisu E zhupei mowu?
Heakou teiva teizhi nou haolouthai,
Puh nou ngheiteia zhupei mowu?
E thao ashi hi kaoyu phaki,
Jisu E zhupei mowu?
Ale veayu nou paolouho buki;
Kheimathe nghidzü kouyu ma.
Leshi phajü tarayu phaki,
Jisu E zhupei mowu?
E levea Alüthou pebu phaki,
Puh nou Eye sü ngaomowu?

chorus: Ovai, Puh nou E zhu peiwe,
Mapao nou khopeie E nou süwe.

title: JISU SALOUZÜ
firstLine: Jisu salouzü buh tahia velou süe
author: Jessie H. Brown

lines: Jisu salouzü buh tahia velou süe,
Buh tahia Puh nou Eye süthai tapeie,
Puh ye samo louzü sayu ngaolou hoe,
Buh tahia Jisu salouzü E peimoe.
Buh tahi vema Apasü halaimoe,
Asa khemai nou thao-a Jisu aveie;
Zhou shiyu phaki Puh nou E salaipeie,
Jisu salouzü E hali-a pimoe
Jisu salouzü thaiyu thai-a pimoe,
Deiphao hashi nou Eye sühao buma;
Jisu salouzü butakia vabulai,
Hatali vema Jisu salai peilai.

title: CHECHENOU, CHECHENOU
firstLine: Oh Mapao nou Eye donou thaipeie
author: J. McG.

lines: Oh Mapao nou Eye donou thaipeie,
Mahmo hinou Eye popapeire;
Jisu lülouyu mai hrülai nou,
Teisa hriyu ngaolai.
Amahmo veishi Puhnou pfü peire,
Apao khesü Puhnou khapei khaire;
Mapaoye lülouyu mai hrülai nou,
Teisa hriyu ngaolai.
Lülouho buma, E Puhye louche
Mah souyuma, E Puh chipao louche;
Jihovah nahtu khemai hrülai nou,
Teisa hriyu ngaolai.

title: PUHNOU EYE POKU PEILAI
firstLine: Khei khei sou Puh hinou Eye pokupeilai
author: F.J. Crosby

lines: Khei khei sou Puh hinou Eye pokupeilai,
Deiphao veayu hoyu vei kousüh hinou,
Puh vei zhuvea nou holoua kao na-a soloue,
A Mapao nou Eye vupeilai.
Kheikheisou Puh hi nou Eye poku peilai,
Puh vei dusho ava Puh nou ngaopeilai;
Puh vei ava nou Eye hopeiyu phaki,
Oh, Ale hi zhao tanüa bulai.
Kheikheisou Puh hinou Eye poku peilai,
Kheikhei souyu Puh vei khaiha leshahi;
Khailu-apeiwo ko-a chiphazho buwe,
Daizhou asalai raki vahi.

chorus: Veayu, thao ashi nou Ahi vepu louhoe,

title: DEIKHO HI POUPAH
firstLine: Jisu hai Asamai lie, Puh Ahisü veishoe
author: C.W. Fry

lines: Jisu hai Asamai lie, Puh Ahisü veishoe,
Puh hai mai thethe jünou Avei nasüe;
Deikho hi poupah nasü, puh hinou ve ngaoloue,
Puh vah nou hatali Enou soulou süe.
E nou veayu veishi sü, Puh nou pfükha peilai,
Thao ashi vekia Puh hai chuhkho dupue;
Enou na hrülai thao-a, deiphao vahkhe thao-a,
Chuwo Puh khouko nou Eye salai peie.
Puh E alia thaolaimoe, chukoute thaopeimoe,
E nou lülou-a Puh jüpa souyuki,
Mapao nou Eye vupeie, E halia pilaimoe;
Puh nou Eye sü touso na teitei peie.

chorus: Levea, zhoushi buki-a, Puh Asamai veilie,
Veishi Puh bah hi thaothou tea paopeie;
Puh hai mai thethe jünou avei nasüe.(2 times)

title: E ALE KHRA BAILAI
firstLine: Arako deiphao kihi nou, Daidonou le khramosa?
author: El. Nathan

lines: Arako deiphao kihi nou,
Daidonou le khramosa?
Teisanou ne daikho-a bue?
Dai donou nele khra moe?
Arako Alethou hinou
Deiphao zhai hinou khao soue,
Ne dai donou souzü peimoe?
Dai donou nele khramoe?
Arako Mapao hi peithouo,
Zhukhai-wo kros hi thaiyu,
Deiphao tsü hinou talalo,
Nele khrayu ngao loulai.
Arako nou khopu-a bue,
Mah hinou chaolai-a bue,
E nou aetoue Jisu vei kros,
Nele khrayu ngao loulai.

chorus: E Ale khra bailai, E Ale khrabailai,
Puh zhu rai nou hrishu louthai,
E Ale khra bailai, E Ale khra bailai
Puh zhu rai nou hrishulou thai.

title: KHAILU APEIO SÜTHAIPEIO
firstLine: Khailupeio, E süthai peio
author: F.M.D.

lines: Khailupeio, E süthai peio,
A ludu sa süthai peio;
Ne nou E khopei louzü,
Enou halia pilaimoe.
Ne Arako ye khopeio,
Ahrü hai vea-a buki;
Nenou khopeiyu donou,
E khailuyu ngaoloure.
Mapao E khovete peio,
Veayu hrü hrüche lou-a;
Ne buh hisü veloulai,
Sühisü krayu ngaohoe.

title: VEO TEIDEI THOUTAI VUYU?
englishTitle: Sowing The Seed Of The Kingdom
firstLine: Anahna ne Veo teidei vei thoutai vuwu
author: F.A.F.

lines: Anahna ne Veo teidei vei thoutai vuwu,
Shona phateile hinou?
Anahna ne Veo teidei vei thoutai vuwu,
Heatei chiyu phahisü nou?
Anahna ne Veo teidei vei thoutai vuwu,
Khei teithe phahi sünou?
Anahna ne Veo teidei vei thoutai vuwu,
Ne chachire teile hinou?
Anahna ne Veo teidei vei thoutai vuwu,
Dei aveilo hisü nou?
Anahna ne chachire buh hisü tave,
Zhou teithe nou soukhai laiwu?

chorus: Souda bulo chathou pove jüre donou.
tune: Sowing The Seed Of The Kingdom

title: TAVELO MAPAO VEI CHURCH HI
englishTitle: The Church In The Wild Wood
firstLine: Leshi sho-a zhuvei sho buyu nuh hi

lines: Leshi sho-a zhuvei sho buyu nuh hi,
Mapao vei church ki ali bue,
Haijü nou leshiyu alia hae,
Eh nou leshi-e leshi showe.
Leshi shoa veishoyu Mapao vei Church hi,
Leshi poupa-a pa-a bue;
Lesa shoyu lousü sou-a bue,
Leveayu hai lia ngaopu laimoe.
Hrishuyu shona sayu nou dai paolai,
Leshi shoyu huda-a bue;
Leshi shoyu pai nou ku-a bue,
Tavelo leshi shoyu Church hi.
Teideiphao hai tachoyu pha teile hi,
Teiva nuh hi vere donou;
Leshi shoyu Church haihi sünou,
E phika palou-a tashulai.

chorus: Leshi shoyu Church buh hi sü.
tune: The Church In The Wild Wood

title: MUTEIYU THOU VUWE
firstLine: Muteiyu thou vuwe, shona teithe payu phaki
author: W.A.O.

lines: Muteiyu thou vuwe, shona teithe payu phaki,
Muteiyu thou vuwe, heakou teilehi;
Muteiyu thou vuwe, nahlemai lethouhi vuthouo,
Muteiyu thou vuwe, eitea heamea-a
Muteiyu thou vuwe, teinghei ngaikouyu phaki hi,
Muteiyu thou vuwe, teizhire phaki;
Muteiyu thou vuwe, lekiyu, khamoyu lia hae,
Ramai hi thaothoure, Puh ye louche-a.
Muteiyu thou vuwe, jüpashoa checheyu vah sü,
Muteiyu thou vuwe, sana thoutai nou;
Muteiyu thou vuwe, bah hinou po-a thaokhai moa,
Ramai hi veachi paoe teilevei peio tea.

chorus: Muteiyu thou vuwe, muteiyu thou vuwe,
Leshi bah nou buh veishi hisü vuthou peio;
Muteiyu thou vuwe, leshi ki hinou.

title: MAIPHAO KAIALI HILO
firstLine: Khrista sü lou thai nou asayu hai ngaoloue
author: K.S.

lines: Khrista sü lou thai nou asayu hai ngaoloue,
Deiphao hashi khenou
Avei asayu hai sou kho lou hoe,
Chu vei khaphao haihi leshiyu khaitare,
Teile hayu laire,
Vasho vei kukhe hi nou chao laiso.
Halaiyu ne pfüphao rako vah soubulo,
Ahri chipao kokhe,
Deiphao kainghou daihi pao vete peio.

chorus: Khristaye ko-a nou, maiphao kaiali hilo,
Lero likhei sou-a, Puh ko sü paolaikhe,
Khaisou teithe veki Puh buh vere donou.

title: CHACHI PEIREMAI DAIKI BUE?
firstLine: Oh daiki nou rou vamai chachi we?
author: E.E. Rexford

lines: Oh daiki nou rou vamai chachi we?
Mahvei douhi nou thouvei pojüwu?
Chachiyu kai nou chachi vuzülai,
Chachi lou mosa mailia solai moe.
Ludu hi la-a bumai phou saveo,
Poushi buyuma, routhou be-a bue,
Ludu hi phouyu mai alia ngaomoe;
Ana mai hrülaiye kihi pojüo.
Holo hailo dou veishi mei pare,
Chuo deiphao teitei chachire kho bue,
Rou vamai chita baie vah alao bue,
Chao-a bulouzü raita khai bailai.
Südonou nahkhemai kai poloua veo,
Routhouvei taosü pove jülou rao;
Chachiyu Mapao vemosa vah souo,
Süthaisü asayu koa ngaozholai.

chorus: Savayu chachi buh hi venü mowu?

title: MAPAO NOU PAOYULAO
firstLine: Deikhohi dzü leirei-a küyu buh hi
author: F.J. Crosby

lines: Deikhohi dzü leirei-a küyu buh hi,
Jisu nou süthai pei hilo E talai;
Zhoushiyu zaipei hilo tea paoyuma,
Halaiyu mai donou E Puh ko paolai.
Deichi deirao, kaobü ngaopiyu buh hi,
Chaolaiyu zhaotu khemaiye phou-a bue;
Teikhai teirüshi nou Ahi veyuma,
Mapao nou süthai peiyu thaio E talai.
Buh taki Puhnou süthai peilo velai,
Sayu ho veayu sa E Puh ro soulai;
Mapao nou ngaowe hriloure ludu sü,
Heako büa varuyu ki hilo velai.

chorus: Mapao nou paoyu lo E sasho-a talai;
Mapao Jisu nou paoyu lo, asasho-a talai;

title: CHIPAO VEI SEIPEIO
firstLine: Avasü thashoa seipei khaio
author: F.J. Crosby

lines: Avasü thashoa seipei khaio,
Buh liki seive peikhaio,
Khaipeiyu chipao seipei khaio,
Khai-apeio Puh zhih hinou.
Avasü rako halaiyu,
Azhi buh hi seitapeio,
Khaitirao teiva halaire,
Teile sü thasho tare.
Ava seipeio Mapao nou paoe,
Sheeyu Puh vei chipao khe,
“Ne takhaio Ako veihai pao,
Khai koute E zhopeilai”.

title: JISU PUH REIHMAI SA-A
firstLine: Keio! Paili nou kuwe, Thaonou zhou talai?
author: Alfred S. Dyer

lines: Keio! Paili nou kuwe, Thaonou zhou talai?
Avah soure puhsü, moe! Tea paolai moe;
Asahra poyu Puh, Reih hi takoulai;
Ngaoba reih sü dulai, Puh donou lalai.
Ramai khouko zhilai, Reih kolou mosa;
Saitan reihmai laire, Reihna tutoulo;
Sheeyu hrüna donou, Chechena donou;
Rako reih donou baie, Tsüle li soulo.
Keio! Reihmai thethe pai, Lou soupoa laire;
Süthaipeio Puh showe, Etao Veo showe;
Buh liki nou laire, Sheeyu reih donou;
Reihmai paisü keilo, Reih hi takoure.

chorus: Sahra poa Jisu nou, Rai-a takoure;
Ngaoba mai jü ko loue, Deiphaojü veiloue.

title: KHAIPEILAI TEA PHOUE
firstLine: Zhaotou khowo nou phoue, deichi peivanou
author: P.P.B.

lines: Zhaotou khowo nou phoue, deichi peivanou,
Hayu zhaotou nasü saloulai tea.
Zhaotou paopu nou lenou sho-a phouwe,
Teizhi teimai hronou pashoa phouwe.
Leshiyu Mapao nou chipao sü seipeie,
Puh thai hinou hrishue, hayu ngaoloue.

title: VEOVEI KUVAH
firstLine: E-wo shesü mailie, vakou teidei nou hrüe
author: Dr. E.T. Cassel

lines: E-wo shesü mailie, vakou teidei nou hrüe,
Akiwo dousho bue, sana teideihi bue,
Zai thailo teidei vei, süh ata maili soua,
Vewo kuvah donou E ve.
A donou thaipeiyu, Puh kosü E paolai,
Puhnou kaonayu peie, mah khouko souhare;
Kohai sü E paolai Ramainou souyu vah,
Haisü Veovei kuvah nasüe.
Haisü vewo chikhae, maikhemai hrülainou,
Mah hinou ledaloua, thao hinou tutalai;
Puh chi zülou maisü, Puh koa teisa velai,
Haisü Veovei kuvah nasüe.
Aki haire Sharon deizhejü veishohie,
Teisa vasho hrülai, Puh vedei teiteisü;
A Mapao nou paowe, thaimai-a hrilousüe;
Haisü Veovei kuvah nasüe.

title: RAKO ASHU NGAOLOU MAI
firstLine: Mapaowo vah souyu khemai rakoveie
author: E.E. Hewitt

lines: Mapaowo vah souyu khemai rakoveie,
Mutei shoyu sana etao povelai;
Maihrü hamosa chipao sü paobulai,
Mapao nou ne paosholai.
Kihi buyu khemai sü ne mavapeio,
Jisu nou hrüyu büa ne-a hrüngao-a;
Haremai raki hilo sada khailo,
Mapao nou ne paosholai.
Buh liki sü koveihai pao mangaopeio,
Bomo-a laimai sü save bo ngaopeio;
Zhaokhowo asayu etao ngao zholai;
Mapao nou ne paosholai.
Chipao veisü buh liki hi daothou peio,
Chipaovei po-a leshi vah soure bue;
Mahmai Mapao hi saveyu etao vah-e,
Mapao nou ne paosholai.

chorus: Asayu peirü sü Puhye rü peilai,

title: CHIPAO VEISÜ PAVALO
firstLine: Ne vasü soutao sou-a pola louwo
author: J. Oatman, Jn.

lines: Ne vasü soutao sou-a pola louwo,
Azhihi bumai sü panou vangaolo,
Ne kikhu sü hou-a panou va ngaokhaio,
Chipao veisü pavalo.
Deiphao levea-a hrüyu mai alao bue,
Azhi hinou palou sümoa buyu mai;
Rakoshi daomore donou doupei khaio,
Chipao veisü pavalo.
Nevasü sükhe nou pobe khaiwuso,
Ava khaibuh hinou popa pavalo;
Teizhi hi bumai ha ngaoloure donou,
Chipao veisü pavalo.

chorus: Ne veiva vavei buki nou vah soukhaio,

title: SOUKHA PEIO
firstLine: Nehia chobu laiwu, Vah soure buh bue
author: J.B. Mackay

lines: Nehia chobu laiwu, Vah soure buh bue,
Mapao kipei hisü ne donou vah bue;
Lülouyu kilaimai soua takou lalo,
Mapao nou kubuki, Taho soukha peio.
Ne la pailai mowu? Ne lou soulourao,
Tave nepai nerao nou Puh ye sholo;
Deiphao veishi taho paodou chemosa,
Paichisho shapo-a Taho soukha peio.
Ne veachi paoyu sü, Zhuvea pei mowu?
Sühao laimai khaivere donou kholo;
Veachi pao vanou Puh sü mota laimoe,
Zhou ne puh khailourao, Taho soukha peio.

title: KHOBUYU MAINOU
firstLine: He douhi nou chachi buyu mai, Ne lesü khaitaso
author: G.M.J.

lines: He douhi nou chachi buyu mai,
Ne lesü khaitaso,
Dou paopuye ne khobulo,
Puh nou eh khouko peilai.
Daisou nou levea-a thaikhaisa,
Nelesü vea khaiso,
Hriyu Mapaoye lülou-a,
Nelüsü khai tawoso.
Salo Puh nou etao salaipeie;
Athai hi koute-a;
Takoulo lethou veilou-a,
Puh zhuvea sü ne peilai.

title: HALAIYUMAI KHAIPEIO
firstLine: Halaiyumai khaipeio, thaire mai zhupeio
author: F.J. Crosby

lines: Halaiyumai khaipeio, thaire mai zhupeio,
Sükhemai mah hinou süthai palo;
Mahmai donou kralo, kaoyu phaolapeio,
Jisu nou khaipeiyu ko paongaopeio.
Puh chizü mo bumai, Puh nou chua khowe,
Leda loumaiye khailu peilai tea;
Soutaosou nou doupeie, putaoye kulo,
Louche louzü Puh nou khaipei bailai.
Deiphao mai lethoupei, rashi nou buyu,
Rako khemai sü souhri palou rao;
Leshi bah nou deiloua sou lashu lourao,
Thailaiyu rako khemai hri loulai.
Halaiyu mai khaipeio, haisü ne vah baie,
Mapao nou nebah khouko thou peilai;
Veayu Kros pfülou nou rako khailu peio;
Jisu thaiyuko chaolaimai paopeio.

title: ZHUO! SANA DOUROU MEIRE
englishTitle: Lo! The Golden Fields Are Smilling
firstLine: Zhuo! sana dourou sü meire, Ne hee-a bubailaiwu?
author: F.J. Crosby

lines: Zhuo! sana dourou sü meire, Ne hee-a bubailaiwu?
Cha chire bue, vah soumai hae, Mapao nou neye kuwe;
Taho vahsou teile hare, Ne lesü zhou houpeiwo,
Puh nou neye kukhai khai we, Mapao E bue, tea paolo.
Sousayu pou sü ne polo, Sünou ne sousa peilai,
Veashoyu chachi maiye koa, Ne sayu zha ngao zholo;
Taho kousümai soukha peio, Puh sü veasho-a bure,
Taho puh koa ne khoukhülo, Puhye koa veachi paolo.
Jisu donou rako phoulo, Ne leshi nou koloulai,
Zhuvea kikhu hi savepeio, Kikhu hi loure paopeio;
Jisu donou rako phoulo, Khouko buki vahsoulo,
Nenou te-a vah souyu buu, Thaikhai ne sayu ngaolai.
Shu vahsouo, Mapao nou ne kue, Talo hee-a chaokhaiso,
Muteiyu teile souhaso, Mapao nou neye kowe;
Neye donou puh thaipeire, Ne rako pa hrilaitea,
Ne kuvah puhnou kho-a bue, Ne moe tea paolou süwu?

chorus: Keio! Chachi mainou varusho lou souwe
tune: Lo! The Golden Fields Are Smilling

title: SAVEPEIO
firstLine: Keio! zhaokhopu pai E nou choue
author: Alexcenah Thomas

lines: Keio! zhaokhopu pai E nou choue,
Maiteiyu deikee hilo nou;
Chaolaiyu zhaokhemai kuwe,
Zhaome hinou dousho tare.
Thaonou taho soukha peilai?
Chaolaiyu zhaotu phouyu hi;
Thaonou hayutao savelai?
Teikao hi bu zhaotu khesü.
Deikee hinou putao paichoue,
Kushoyu deichi pei hinou;
Mapao nou nehi paoyu keio,
“A zhao khemai sü phou velo”.

title: ABAH SAKHAI E TALAIWU?
englishTitle: Must I go An Empty Handed?
firstLine: Abah hi halia pomo nou, Sa-a Mapao daolaiwu?
author: C.C. Luther

lines: Abah hi halia pomo nou,
Sa-a Mapao daolaiwu?
Teithe lia Puh vah soumo nou
E puh hi vebai laiwu?
E athai nasü pilaimoe,
Mapao nou E Khaipeire;
Masa Mapao ve daore hai,
E cholou Anghidzü pae.
Po taoli mah hinou hrüe,
Süsü E chuo tsüve loure;
E Mapao vah soulouyu thaio,
E sashoa Puh do soulai.
Shulo, nasheelou mai tashu,
Teiva buki vah soulo;
Athai phanou veyu shulai,
Zhou taho rako phoulo.

chorus: Puh hi rako lia save moa,
tune: Must I go An Empty Handed?

title: NE TAKHAIO, DEIPHAO VEISHI
englishTitle: Go Ye Into All The World
firstLine: Doushoyu buh teizhi hi hrüyu maibue
author: G.M.J.

lines: Doushoyu buh teizhi hi hrüyu maibue,
Rako thethe sü teisa halaire;
Thaonou taho khailupei ko doupeilai?
Jisu ye zhulo ne veayu choso.
Zhuwo deiphao kikhu houkhai tea kubue,
Mapao reihmai tashu sühi loulo;
Kailo, Khristamai khosü ali souloua,
Ko avei paoa mahrai sü phei papeio.
Daisou thailai, Jihovah nou ku-a bue,
Ne daidonou thailai? Puh zhi kulo;
Thaimore donou Jisu nou thaipeire,
Khailupeiyu hriyu kosü paodouo.
Mapao vei teilesü ngheitei-a bure,
Mapao sho-a koloure lou soulo;
Khailou mainou asayu lou soubulai,
Shalo, Hallelujah, Mapao Veo süe.

chorus: Ne taho deiphao veishi hi chipaovei
tune: Go Ye Into All The World

title: LÜLOUMAI VEJÜYU LOU
firstLine: Shulo, shulo Mapao nou E khemaiye kue
author: F.J. Crosby

lines: Shulo, shulo Mapao nou E khemaiye kue,
Shulo, shulo Mapao chisü zülo;
Takou, takou jubilee lousü sou po-a,
Etao Mapao khrista chipao sü poa takou.
Lülou moyu mainou vasü phou-a krayu,
Paisü zaidu peihisü chouvere;
Tharao, tharao cheche chipao seira tapeio,
Houzü veabumai ki veishi hi ve paodou.
Zhulo, zhulo paokhaitouyu teile ngheire,
Maihrülai nou Mapao Veosü tholai;
Bulikihi kaonayu asayu bulai,
Deiphao teitei Hallelujah tea asalai.

chorus: Shona teivuh nou Apei hisü vapei-a bue;
Asalo, teisa bure mai pai keilo,
Cheche reihmai lisou-a; eh Jisu likhi zhulai,
Hallelujah tea sha poa eh takoulai.

title: JISU ETAO KUWE
firstLine: Jisu nou etaoye kuwe, Hashi jü talalo tea
author: Mrs. C.F. Alexander

lines: Jisu nou etaoye kuwe,
Hashi jü talalo tea;
Teithe tsü Puh paivei nou paoe,
Khrista mai Athai fülo.
Jisu nou etaoye kuwe,
Deiphao kini thaowu tea;
Kini jü Jisu nou veipue,
Khristamai Puh leshilo.
Va-a buki, vea-a buki,
Vah sou-a, so-a bu-a,
Puh chukoute ku-a paowe,
“Khristamai E leshilo”.
Jisu nou etaoye kuwe,
Mapao eh pa Ne pai keio;
Etaoye pa Ne chi zülo,
Hali jü ne leshilai.

title: RAIKÜ-A KÜ
firstLine: Zhaotu raikü akü taosü ve hi bue
author: Elizabeth C. Clephane

lines: Zhaotu raikü akü taosü ve hi bue,
Hashi ali-a dao moa bue;
Ana ali nasü bomo-a tare,
Zhaotu ve hinou dou-a tare;
Deichi hinou houzüyu hea-a bure,
Zhaotu khopu hinou dousho-a tare,
Zhaotu khopu hinou douso-a tare.
Mapao haihi zhaotu raikü-akü bue,
Haitaohai chilewu Mapao?
Ana zhaotu khopu nou haibü-a paoe,
“Avei zhaotu ali motare”,
Ludusü khusho, shishoshe touyuma,
E taho Azhaotuye sü phoulaihie;
E taho Azhaotuye sü phoulaihie.
Ludu ashi, khu-shao hinou tayuma,
Chuhdu, lya, dushi daoyuma;
Rakiva nou pai ali haibüa shakoue,
“Asalo, zhaotu sü ngaoloure”,
Rakivamai nou pai chihsho-a shawe,
“Asalo, Mapao nou zhaotu savere”
“Asalo, Mapao nou zhaotu savere “.

title: E ASAWE VEO KUVAH HI
englishTitle: I am Happy In The Service Of The King
firstLine: Veo vei kuvah souyu hi E sashowe
author: A.H. Ackley

lines: Veo vei kuvah souyu hi E sashowe,
E sashowe oh! asashoe;
Hali nou peilou hoyu kaona sübue,
Veo vei kuvah souyu hi.
Veo vei kuva souyu hi E sashowe,
E sashowe oh! asashoe;
Teinai teirü hi-a E lousou lousüe,
Veo vei kuvah souyu hi.
Veo vei kuvah souyu hi E sashowe,
E sashowe oh! asashoe;
Puh bahnou süthai hilo E aetou lai,
Veo vei kuvah souyu hi.
Veo vei kuvah souyu hi E sashowe,
E sashowe oh! asashoe;
Ahi buyu na E puh hi povelai,
Veo vei kuvah souyu hi.

tune: I am Happy In The Service Of The King

title: LAITHOUO
firstLine: Ne khei zaipe nou hako nou buwu?
author: J.B. Mackay

lines: Ne khei zaipe nou hako nou buwu?
Zaipeihi takou laithou khaio;
Zaithou hi losü ne khah be laithou,
Zaipeihi tapaloua laithou;
Sühi neye peire donou khobue,
Sakhaiyu zaihi nou palo;
Dzühouyu buh hi sü vahsou buso,
Mapao nou paowe laithouo.
Ne rako zaihe-a veayu daowu?
Zaipehi tapa phathou khaio;
Khrista lülo, Puh nou khouko peilai ,
Zaipeihi tapa phathou khaio;
Mapao hisü alao sou-a buwe,
Ne jüpa sü tave polo;
Puh hi tave ne jüpa kholourao,
Puhnou ne kho noupeilai.
Jisunou zhou vealaimai taoye paoe,
Ne sakhao zaihi phathou khaio;
Puh leshi pai keilo, neye peilai,
Zaipeihi takou phathou khaio;
Ne mah buhsü thao-a tapa lourao,
Sühi ne hriyu ngaolaimoe;
Chuo Jisu hilosü zhu-a bulo,
Puh leshi hi thaothou khaio.

title: JESU NOU VAPEIE
firstLine: Jisu nou vapeie, leireiyu va nou
author: Emily H. Miller

lines: Jisu nou vapeie, leireiyu va nou,
Teizhi hi vayu meibvü ali bü-a;
Deiphao azhi haihi vapeilai,
Ne nebuh hi valo, E-a valai.
Puh donou Eye valo tea paowe,
E nou vayu buh hisü Puhnou ngaowe;
Puh nou raki hinou E phebue,
Ne nebuh hi valo, E-a valai.
Deiphao buliki vapeio tea paowe,
Deiphao hi teizhi tyali sühao buwe,
Mahmo veayu buh hi E valai,
Ne nebuh hi valo, E-a valai.
Ekhemai hrülai nou kabüa valai?
E zhai veilounou, Puh ko maihi paolai;
Jisuwo mailia pa shi nümoe,
Ne nebuh hi valo, E-a valai.

title: ETAO KHRISTA MAIME
firstLine: Asayu lou nou sou sholo
author: Lyman G. Cuvler

lines: Asayu lou nou sou sholo,
E khemai le teitei nou peio,
E khemaiye süthaipei-wo,
E Veo peirü ngaolou mosa.
Ekhemai vejüyu phaki,
Leshiyu Asakhemai koa;
Etao veachi paozhoyu hai,
Puh hinou zhuvea sü ngaoloue.
Nahkhemai vei samai sü Ne,
E khemai ludu süthaipeio;
Nebah vuzü nou süthaipeio,
Khristamai me kho salaipeio.

chorus: Asasho lalaikhe, le likhei soulou nou;
Hayu maisü phoulai, veayu sü heazho-a;

title: ROMÜ KHO TOULO
firstLine: A sakhemai raki vanou
author: P.P.B.

lines: A sakhemai raki vanou,
Sah zhayu zhukhaio;
Reih maime adusü laire,
Ko loure ngheire.
Zhou, khouko bu Saitan nou,
Süthai sa takoure;
Khouko bumai kaotare,
Khuvei mai halaire.
Pozhayu sahra zhukhaio,
Shabe houyu keilo;
Etao Mapao zhih hinou,
Etao nou veiloulai.

chorus: Romü khotoulo, E vewe tea Jisu nou paoe;
Ne leshi vasünou veilou süe tea paopeikhaio.

title: TASHU VAHSOULO
firstLine: Khrista maitao tashulo, Mai veabuki solaiwu?
author: Frances Hill

lines: Khrista maitao tashulo,
Mai veabuki solaiwu?
Bah lekhai moa bulaiwu?
Mapao chi zülai mowu?
Khailupei Puh leshiwu?
Puh ye lübulai mowu?
Puh donou nele lalouwu?
Puh chi eh zülai mowu?
Etao Puh lülou chewu?
Puh chipao thaifüa hrüwu?
Etao Puh louche louzü,
Vah nou lü pongao laikhe.
Etao pfüre kros li bue,
Veo peirü rünü louzü;
Khouko ashu popalo,
Teile sü hayu laire.

title: VAH SOULO
firstLine: Chachire douhi , vah soure sü bue
author: Dr.C.R. Blackall

lines: Chachire douhi , vah soure sü bue,
Routhou sü meire, chachire mai hae;
Mapao nou vah soure maisü kubue,
Zhou puh nou kuyu pai keilo.
Dourou sü chathai hi pove jülo,
Lou soulo , panou lesü asalo;
Khei vemo jünou , muteiyu teile,
Sana teile poa vah soulo.
Chachiyu maisü buu avei ngaolai,
Teile louyuma, vah sü veayuma;
Mapao vei asayu sü ngaozholai,
Veayu teizhi latayu thai.
Zhukhaio, rakiva hilo velouzü,
Veasho-a vah soumai nou buu ngaolai;
Mapao vei leshi painou kuyuhai,
Teisa hriloure donou kue.

chorus: Habüa Mapao nou paoe, khouko sü peilai;
Koukhe lou mosa sü vah sou.

title: TALOU VYALO
firstLine: Deichi deizhe hilo sü nou, Bekho nou kuyu keilo
author: Wm. H. Gardner

lines: Deichi deizhe hilo sü nou,
Bekho nou kuyu keilo;
Paopeiyu chipao sü keilo,
Chipao sü etao donou.
Rako vei reih nasü tulo,
Sahra poku-a zhalo;
Cheche donou reih züyuki,
Rakivamai nou zhubue.
Sana bekho sü houpukhaio,
Reivo sü eitea soulo;
Veishi nou Jisu donou bai,
Eletao nou koloulai.

chorus: Be khosü keilou-a nou takou vyalo,

title: VAHSOUO, KHEIPHA SÜ VEWE
englishTitle: Work For The Night is Coming
firstLine: Vah souo, kheipha sü vewe, Shona hi vah sou rao
author: A.L. Walker

lines: Vah souo, kheipha sü vewe,
Shona hi vah sou rao;
Vah souo vidzü kou phaki,
Lenoua vah soulo,
Teinghei buki vah soulo,
Teinai buki vah souo;
Vah souo kheipha sü vewe,
Vah souchewure.
Vah souo kheipha sü vewe,
Teinai yuma vah souo;
Teiva hi lenoua vah souo,
Asoyu ngaolai;
Phabusa vah soulou wo,
Kini pojü khailo,
Vah souo kheipha sü vewe,
Vah soupu laimoe.
Vah souo kheipha sü vewe,
Teinghei louta laire, Ava sü halou laire,
Loutayu laire, Soulo moshi vah sourao,
Vapu palai more;
Vah souo kheipha sü vewe,
Vah soucheyu thai.

tune: Work For The Night is Coming

title: CHACHIREMAI KUYU
firstLine: Holo, hailo buyu doukhemai, Chachire meipare
author: J.O. Thompson

lines: Holo, hailo buyu doukhemai,
Chachire meipare;
Deikho, deizhe hi buyu dourou
Teinai hinou meire.
Seikoupeio chachiyu mai shona,
Heako teiva buki,
Koukhe teiva buki nou dourou
Pojüpeire donou.
Chuwo meipayu sana dourou,
Thashoa pove jükhaio;
Koukhe loulouzü ne sasho-a
Kilo dakhai talai.

title: HAYU MAI PHOUWE
firstLine: Hayu khemai sü phoure tavelo
author: W.A.O.

lines: Hayu khemai sü phoure tavelo,
Deichi hinou moa chaolaimaisü;
Ahi velo tea puh nou ku-a bue,
Zhao paopu nou zhou la-a buwe.
Hayu mai phouwe, Jisu hi velo,
Rako lelouhoa levea laimai;
Khaipeiyu ludu hisü savelo,
Teisa hrire ludu ngaopeiwo.
Eletao zhuvea vei vah soulaikhe,
Teithetsü Khrista thaifü lou-a;
Kaoduyu khemai phao lashu pei-a,
Jisu nou ludue tea paopeiwo.

chorus: Chaolaiyu maiye sü phou save pupeio;
Etao Mapao nou buyu buh hi;
Mapao Jisu nou mahmai donou thai peire.

title: THOUTAI VUYU
firstLine: Deikho buh aveihi sünou, Thoutai vu bulouzü

lines: Deikho buh aveihi sünou,
Thoutai vu bulouzü;
Le asa shonou kho-a bue,
Chachi lousüe tea nou.
Mapao Jisu ko avei hai,
Thao lekhehi busa?
Vuthou khaitouyu thou taisü,
Duki paopa laisa?
Tasho soulou sümo mainou,
Deiveimo buh hisü,
Thoutai vuthoukhai buyu ma,
Veayu muh ngaolou moe.
Sübüa ne kilai ekhemai,
Tsü hayu vasünou;
Avei ashi ngaolou sümoe,
Mapao Nenou doupeio.

title: RAISÜ LAIPEI KHAIO
firstLine: Zaithou hisü ahri rai laithou peio
author: Rev.E.F.Ufford

lines: Zaithou hisü ahri rai laithou peio,
Sühisü khailoure Asamai bue;
Oh! Thaonou buh sühi tave lou-a,
Khu vei-a hriloure raisü laipeilai?
Bah chi-a hriloure rai laipei khaio,
Asana ne daisou nou kho-a bue?
Zhou Puh vei rako leitayu laire,
Tharao puh rako hai hata zhulaire.
Zhoushi daobu maiye rai laipei khaio,
Ne nou vedao khaimo buh leiloure;
Thaoshi teikhai nou puletao pfü-a,
Teizhi zaithouhi pfü leita zhulaire.

chorus: Raisü laipei khaio, Raisü laipei khaio,
Raisü laipei khaio, Raisü laipei khaio,

title: NE DUSÜ MA-A TARE
firstLine: Ne dusü ma-a tare, ne dusü ma-a tare
author: J.B. Pounds

lines: Ne dusü ma-a tare, ne dusü ma-a tare,
Dushi losü nenou tala kou-are;
Ne du tama lelouzü, Dakhai vete holaire;
Dushi hilosü, ne nou tala koure.
Kilo buyu mainou ne kuwe khaive lou tea nou,
Ne ludu shilo sü takoupu khaiso;
Ne tala kouyu louzü dakhaive louho laido,
Südonou ne aku hilo tapuso.
Kilomai lapai keilo, Ne shihilo takouso,
Ne shihilo takoure tsü chopuso;
Oh! Asa Achipao hai, ne soutaosou-a keilo
Ne tacho tala mojünou tsü cholo.

chorus: Ne tala louzü, Ne Jihovah leshi hai,
Ne tala khaiso, ludu kaomo hisü.

title: HRÜLAI DONOU BUH BUE
firstLine: Hayu rako vupalo, Molaiyu khe phoulo
author: F.J.Crosby

lines: Hayu rako vupalo, Molaiyu khe phoulo;
Puletaoye ludu tai, Hilo sa-a tapeio;
Puletao hi Mapao nou, Kuyu paisü paopeio;
Paopeio, nühsü soudare, Putao donou buh bue.
Veayu deikho hisü nou,Teimai teizhi hinou;
Veishoyu teiva, kaona, Sheeyu hi sapa peio;
Jisu hi pove dzüpeio, Kuyu paisü paopeio,
Paopeio, nühsü soudare,Putao donou buh bue.
Leshi rako loua tapeio, Mapao zhih hinou tawo;
Ahri ea khailu peiyu, Chuo deiphao hi shakhaio;
Teiva bukinou takhaio, Thakhaio teizhi laire;
Paopeio, nühsü soudare, Putao donou buh bue.

chorus: Nühsü sou dare Putao donou buh bue.

title: GREENLAND TEIDEI MAINOU
firstLine: Greenland teidei mainou, India teidei hi mainou
author: Bishop Heber

lines: Greenland teidei mainou, India teidei hi mainou,
Afrika hi mainou, Sühi rei, vao khe mainou;
Dao raiki nuh khemai, Hashi paoyu dei khokhe,
Putao nou E la bue,Ve mah rai pheipa peio tea.
Ngaopi zaidu dzünou, Sühaoyu Ceylon teidei,
Kini alao soubua,Mai khemai zhaohsho zhibue;
Jihovah leshi hai, Putao nou poba thaore,
Ngheichayu zhaosho mai, Nou hako süü chuh thobue.
Rako meiva ngaolou, Mai etao tashu laikhe,
Taho meibvü pomoa, Tayu mai vapei laikhe;
Khaipeiyu, khaipeiyu, Sü taho shangao laikhe,
Jisu zhih hai zhaohsho, Zhosou mai hi paolaikhe.
Teikhai ne-a taho, Reidzü ne-a taho pao,
Chu koute maikhemai Saitan kinou zhaosho bue;
Jihovah zhaotu sü, Putao donou dathare,
Khailu peiyu Veo sü, Thasho-a khaive laire.

title: TAHO KO PAO DOUPEIO
firstLine: Mah nou zhitei buh hinou putao khobue
author: J.W.P.

lines: Mah nou zhitei buh hinou putao khobue,
Zhao me hinou motare;
Khrista nou khailupei ko thaonou paolai,
Zhou! putao hi paomo hie.
Takhaio, Mapao nou neye khouko peilai,
Rako nou süthai peilai;
Ne kaolaimoe Puh nou seitayu hisü,
Takhaio sounapu khaiso.
Mapao leshi nou süyu buh hi ta-wo,
Savayu sü thaokhai-a;
Ne teile sü puh vah hi peithou khai-o,
Hayu khemai taho phouo.

chorus: Oh! Deiphao veishi hi ko pao ,

title: LESHIYU KHAMAITAO
firstLine: He! leshiyu Asamai, Jisu nou labure

lines: He! leshiyu Asamai, Jisu nou labure;
Kushu lounou nevei nah teilourao,
Reih buh hi huloure soulaikhe.
Jisunou etao lare, Avei reihmai taore;
Reih sünasü nelenou koloure,
Hapeiyu khouko sü ne peire.
Khoulo, khoulo, reihmaitao,
Vebuh hi taloure,
Tobai soumoa tsü, leroli, soulo,
Jisu vei reihmai eletao nou.

chorus: Jisu, Jisu vei reihmai eletao nou,

title: MAI PHOUMAI
firstLine: Jisunou paoyu pai E choue
author: James M. Gray

lines: Jisunou paoyu pai E choue,
Galilee maitaohi;
Zaipe hibu khah phoumaihi,
“Athai fülo,” tea paoe
Nechipao hai Avei soulai,
Jisu süsü soupeio!
Galilee maihi baimoanou,
Zhou Ahi-a paowe.
Nethai fülai le teiteinou,
Ne koa zhou E talai;
Amah vanou E thaowoso,
Eye khaipeio Mapao.
Ale hinou khahphou maili,
Sounü sho-a buwe;
Khahbe laithoure buh ngaopeio,
Galilee teile büa.

title: ETAO LOU SOUPU LAIKHE
firstLine: Etao Mapao shoyu lousou pulaikhe
author: Lyman G. Cuvler

lines: Etao Mapao shoyu lousou pulaikhe,
Eh Puo leshi süre donou Puh thaipeie;
Deiphao maihi Puh leshi eh paolaikhe,
Puh dai büa ekhemai donou la peisa?
Souvapei donou etao Puh sholaikhe,
Puhnou ahri chipao etaohi khaipeie,
Puh louche loumai hi Puh ngheitei tea bue,
Puh zhuvea lüloumai hi pongao peilai.
Rakoye donou etao Puh sholaikhe,
Raki buh etao ngheithou nou ngaoloulai;
Puh vebuh hinou etao vejü yuki,
Paosha louho Puhvei zhuvea ve nagolai.

chorus: Puh dai büa kros hinou thaie;
Sasho-a paoshoyu Puh vei sou peilai,
Etao do soure donou Puh nou vea peie.

title: ETAO PUO VEI ZHUVEA
firstLine: Etao puo vei zhuvea mei-va teisa va bue,Puh kihi
author: P.P.B.

lines: Etao puo vei zhuvea mei-va teisa va bue,Puh kihi,
Etao hi meiva sü peiwe zaipei hi vare donou.
Mah teizhi sü velou loure, Teikhai teirüshi vere,
Mahmai nou zhi-a khobure, Zaipe hi meiva nasü.
Ne meibvü soutaosou valo, Maitaoli veasho bure,
Chu putao soyu buh phou bue, Teizhi hinou halou veie.

title: VAH SOUE, KHOE, VEACHIPAOE
firstLine: Takhaio, takhaio, Jisu donou! Khobulo, vah soukhaio
author: Mrs. Frank A. Breck

lines: Takhaio, takhaio, Jisu donou!
Khobulo, vah soukhaio;
Mapao nou neye doupeilai,
Veachi paoyu; Mapao nou peiyu vah soulo,
Ne jüpa vah do-a buso;
Khobulo, vah soukhaio, veachipao.
Takhaio, deiphaova buliki,
Chaokhaiso, nakhaiso,
Leshi vei sahra zhalou-a,
Paodou peikhaio; sashoyu khailu peiyu lou,
Maihrülaiye panou soukhaio,
Khobulo, vah soukhaio, veachipao.
Takhaio, nele khouchilou-a,
Khobulo,vah soukhaio;
Taho rashina vei khouko
Souha peiwo, Ramai khouko sü banoulo,
Nenou veikhaimoa veiloulai;
Khobulo, vah soukhaio, veachipao.

title: MAPAOYE KHO-A BUE
firstLine: E nou Mapaoye kho-a bue
author: W.L. Alexander

lines: E nou Mapaoye kho-a bue,
Lashu Eye daorepu;
Veishoyu Puh nghoujü hinou,
Savayu Puh ki hinou.
Veayu ludu E tawure,
Teikhai teirü hrohi-a;
Süshoyu kou pfü-a likhu,
A hrü donou terou bue.
E ko-a tayu sakhemai,
Romü hi veyu doure;
Ali linou E thao tare,
Ngaobamai reih buh hinou.
Ovai putao veihdu jüre,
Kolouyu thasho ngaore;
Sashoa putao nou E sühlai,
Veayu hrü hai cheyu thai.

title: KHOLO, PAIKHAI TOUSO
firstLine: Vealaimai donou kili bue
author: W.H. Bellamy (arr.)

lines: Vealaimai donou kili bue,
Veayu hoyu, ngaopu laimoe,
Sühi hrü soudakhai laimoe,
Thao nou sühi venü mowe?
Kousüh pfüla louho buyu,
Deiphaohi veayu mai zhai baie,
Zhulo, ne rako vei ngaolai,
Kaona kholo pai khai touso.
Ne ludu hi shu bulouzü,
Shu peirü pfüyu Puh cholo,
Ne leveayu ngaobu louzü,
Ne veipuyu vedao laihie.
Veayuma vah soupu loukhaio,
Nevei veachi sü keipeiai,
Soyu teithe vezhi laire,
Kholo nasha-a khobulo.

title: HAILO PHEPO BUE
firstLine: Reipe holo E mai taoli ngaoe
author: J.W.V.

lines: Reipe holo E mai taoli ngaoe,
Shona büa vei-a , E phe-a bue;
Putao sou nou veayu alia hae,
Kilomai vuzhi khalou hobue.
Leshiyu Apfü Apuo khemai,
Nuh sü hinou ve E kho-a bue;
Rai-a tayu nahkhemai süthaia,
Reipe hinou E veyu khobue.
Rai tayu Atu Asamai nou,
Kilomai kheyu khopo-a bue;
Rakimai sabue sahkaa ba-a,
Kilomai kheyu zhisho-a bue.
Nuh sühinou nahtou khemai nou,
Pfü puo vere sü kho-a nou bue;
Khou teighi va büa, vidzü zhai büa,
Apfü du ki velaisa zhibue.

chorus: Leshi maitao sü kho-a nou bue,
Shona büa zhai veie, heako büa vae,

title: BEULAH NUH HI
firstLine: A doukou nou reih pai ali anou hi chouvewe
author: C.A.M.

lines: A doukou nou reih pai ali anou hi chouvewe,
Deiphao vei mahmai hrülai hi bue tea E süloue;
Deiphao liki, piyu nou Eye hako nou kuwe,
Sütao sü velouhoe, Beulah nuh hi.
Khekou nou teikhai veloua deiphao hisü hrüvewe,
Deiphao mainou ngaoba maiye reih sou-a nou bue;
Ramai ki hinou Ewo kaonasho-a hrü-a bue,
Hashisü velouhoe Beulah nuh hi.
Teikhai teirüshi vetheo sünou Eye soupihoe,
Ramai bahnou vupei-a E wo sobuh ngaoloue;
Haihisü teingheinou va-a bue, hashi velouhoe,
E teisa khailuloue, Beulah nuh hi.
Ramai nou souyu vahsü zhu-a Esü khupa bue,
Chuwo Puh paisü chouloua Aludu ngaoloure;
Rako hinou hrüa Enou khaipeiyu ko sücheloue,
Vasho-a sobulai, Beulah nuh hi.

chorus: E hrüwe, deichi vanou teihao hayu teikhenou
E küwe dzüla hinou thekhai moyu dzüla
Oh! E nüh nüwe, manna tou we,
Kini buyu rakinou, Sühi E hrüwe,

title: LÜSHIYU NUH
firstLine: E nou zhingaoyu nuhli bue
author: Gurdon Robins (arr.)

lines: E nou zhingaoyu nuhli bue,
Süsü E nou zhokou nou ngaoe;
Nuh süna veiyu paohao hoe,
Teisa nou süsü va-a bue.
Sava shoyu reipe hi nuh,
Teizhi ha-a, soyu buh bue;
Vedao loumai rapu laimoe,
Raiki taramai vedaolai.
Sühi ratei zhaivei sholai,
Va tyatyali nou va bulai;
Teinghei payu-a kolaimoe,
Sühi khei teizhi ha donou.
Kaona shoyu Aki sühi,
Chishoyu teikhai hülaimoe;
Vea-a veihdu hi tayumai,
Raki sofü hi ve solai.

chorus: Ne zai pehi E ve bulai.

title: CHO LOU HOYU REI HI VÜNAI BÜA
englishTitle: Numberless As The Sand Of The Sea
firstLine: Khai teithe Jordan hi ve daoyu ki
author: F.A.B.

lines: Khai teithe Jordan hi ve daoyu ki,
Mapao Jisuye Eh ve ngaolai;
Chosha lou hoyu reihi vü nai büa,
Sükisü daizhozhou khupalai.
Deiphaohi veayu veishi thao-a nou,
Khailou mai hrülai vedaoyuki;
Sühinou sakhemai salam soulai,
Süteithe daizhozhou khupalai.
Zhaiveiyu reipe nou Eh ve la-a ,
Hriyu süübe phinou ve solai;
Paokhai touyu füdei sü ve zhulai,
Süteithe daizhozhou khupalai.
Khailupei Mapaoye vedao yuki,
Puhvei khupa vasü vengaolai;
Veo teidei veishi Puh nou khoyuki,
Süteithe daizhozhou khupalai.

chorus: Chosha louhoyu reipe hi vünai büa.
tune: Numberless As The Sand Of The Sea

title: VUCHA DAOPFÜ LAIWU?
firstLine: Buh vei shoyu nuh hi E velai tea cho-we
author: E.E.Hewitt

lines: Buh vei shoyu nuh hi E velai tea cho-we,
Teinghei louthai E sühi velai;
Mapao vei khupa zhuvea vanou E lawe,
Peirü va vucha dao pfülaiwu?
Mapao khouko vanou E pa vah soubulo,
E pa rako nüyu mai soulo;
Puhye paoshoyu hai reidzü büa küyuki,
Süteithe vuhtao Avei soulai.
E khe Puh zhu ngaoyuki daizhou asalai,
Arako Puh phihi veyuki;
Sana nuh hisü Eye pa sapuloulai,
Peirü va vucha daopfü laiwu?

chorus: A peirü vahisü vucha daopfü laiwu?
Koukhe teinghei lou tayu thai sü;
E nou aso buh ve telouyu phakisü,

title: ZHUVEA NOU KHAIPEIE
firstLine: Deiphao raiphu nai detalai
author: F.J. Crosby

lines: Deiphao raiphu nai detalai,
E chu bü-a lou soulai moe;
Veo teideihi E veyuki oh!
daizhozhou asa sholai.
Vuli deiphao Aki kaolai,
Duki laisa E paolou hoe;
Ana E-süe A Mapao nou,
Rakinou buh souda khaitoue.
Khekou teinghei loulao vanou,
Vuli teinghei lou tayu thai;
“Sou veie”tea Mapao nou paolai,
Süthai E soyu buh ngaolai.

title: AKU BUH HI
firstLine: E tapo reilo shokhelai
author: Johnson Oatman. Jr.

lines: E tapo reilo shokhelai,
E teithetsü kupu khelai;
E tapu khelai tea khowe,
Mapao Aphi ka poreipeio.
E deiphao hi bupu nü moe,
Lekiyu, piyu buh hisü;
Maita linou bupu yuma,
Ewo kuyu buh zhi-a bue.
E deiphao jü kubuh velai,
Saitan nou Eye duyuma;
Lü vanou sayu sü ngaolai,
Sheeyu lou kubuh hinou soue.
E kushoyu buh hi velai,
Veishoyu vasü E ngaolai,
Raki khe ngaomosa kholai,
Mapao E sa raki khepeio.

title: VEJÜLAI KI HINOU
firstLine: Etao hrülai ki hinou daolaiwu?
author: Words arranged

lines: Etao hrülai ki hinou daolaiwu?
Vashoa buyu zaipe hinou;
Leshiyu samai nou kho buyu hi,
Süzhou daizhozhou asa laisa.
Etao hrülai ki hinou daolaiwu?
Leveayu teisa habai laiwu?
Khailou mai koa Etao lou soulaiwu?
Süzhou daizhozhou asa laisa.
Etao hrülai ki hinou daolaiwu?
Eletao Khai-apeio ngaolaiwu?
Leshimai linou liye daolaiwu?
Süzhou daizhozhou asa laisa?

title: VEJÜYU DAIZHOU LESHIE
firstLine: Rei tacho pathai fü aveili bue
author: G.F.R.

lines: Rei tacho pathai fü aveili bue,
Sheeyu mai thethe vejübulai;
Thaonou zhuvea leshi phou pfüa buwe?
Etao Mapao thaoye paokha lai?
Mai hrülai vejüyu daizhou leshie,
Puh nou neye pai nasho kubue;
Arako daisou nou Puhye polou moe?
Khailupeiyu hai sa-a peire.
Mai hrülai vejüyu daizhou leshie,
Puh nou ne kuyu paisü keilo;
“Tavelo, levea kousü-a laikhemai”,
Ahi ve nekou sü thaowurao.

chorus: Maithethe peihi Puh nou Vewo süe,
Sühi sü veiyu hrülai buyu donou,

title: ETAO RAKI KHEYU KI
englishTitle: When We All Get To Heaven
firstLine: Jisu vei khupa lou soulai
author: E.E.Hewitt

lines: Jisu vei khupa lou soulai,
Puh vei zhuvea lou soulo;
Veishoyu rakiva buh sü,
Eh donou souda peilai.
Etao veihdu tabu hinou,
Teihao nou sühao loulai;
Ana tare tacheyu thai,
Veayu bupulai more.
E khemai chechea hrülaikhe,
Teithetsü Puh vah soulai;
Vuli asayu ngaoloulai,
E nou souyu zha ngaolai.
Nghoujülo takou buu ngaolai,
Puh zhaivei etao zhulai;
Thasho sana romü houlai,
Etao sana du talai.

chorus: Etao veilouyu lou soulai (eh lou soulai).
tune: When We All Get To Heaven

title: KIHILO VE SHOLAI
firstLine: Teikhai shi velou hoyu buh hi
author: F.J. Crosby

lines: Teikhai shi velou hoyu buh hi,
Teizhi laimoe;
Teisa asayu vasü valai,
Teitheyu büa valai.
Lü-vei shou nou teikhai buh thailo
Pfü zhaotalai;
Leshinou raki du ngaopeilai,
Paoshoyu lou soulai.
Ajü tarai tayu sakhemai,
Sühi sü bue;
Ekhemai putaoye sü daolai;
Akhaihi ki velai.
Sayu nou paohao louho shona,
Sayu teithe;
Sü hisü veayu ngheidzü veishi,
Puh nou southe peilai.

title: DEICHI HI AKI BUE
firstLine: Deichi hi aki bue teikhai vakou
author: L.W. Mansfield

lines: Deichi hi aki bue teikhai vakou,
Ramai nou souda peiyu kishoyu;
Sheeyu mai thethesü sühi lalai,
Mapaoye paosho-a bue.
Teizhi nou teithe hi pasho laimoe,
Veayu ngaoba sühi bupulaimoe;
Jisu nou etaoye pfü a velai,
Teisa veishoyu buh hi.
Sühi aki buki asayusa,
Etao nou Ramaiye paosho bulai;
Zhecheyu lou nouko zho-a talai,
Aki kükou bupuki.

chorus: Deichi hi, deichi hi aki bue,

title: HE! BEULAH FÜ
firstLine: E kuyu teidei nou louloure
author: Edgar Page Stites

lines: E kuyu teidei nou louloure,
Buh veishoyu hinou e veloure;
Sühi sana romü zhuvea deie,
Mapao vei zhaipao ngaowe.
Mapao Jisu nou e pfüa zhouwe,
Puh khe hinou e leshi ngaowe;
Teithe-tsü Puh nou e shou buwe,
Khaipao sühi dupeie.
Raki vakou buh sü zhuvea deie,
Zhidzü peishoyu sühi reie;
Khouko buyu Ramai paoshoyu,
Lou sü asayu soupue.

title: JORDAN REIPE HINOU
firstLine: Pikhai moa zhaotalai Jordan reipe
author: Samuel Stennett

lines: Pikhai moa zhaotalai Jordan reipe,
Kanaan veishoyu buh hi;
Sühi aki veishoyu bu bue,
Maihrülai ve zhoubu bue.
Buh sü teizhi nou pasho laimoe,
Sheeyu teisa daibou bue;
Jisu nou etaoye pfü a velai,
Teisa asayu kühie.
Khouko zhouyu teithetsü sühi bue,
Veayu ngaoba bupulaimoe;
Daisou nou etao sühi pukhailai?
Jordan pikhai a zhoulo.

title: SÜHI DAIBVÜ LAISA!
englishTitle: What Must It Be To Be There
firstLine: Etao nou paowe veishoyu buh sü
author: Mrs. Elizabeth Mills

lines: Etao nou paowe veishoyu buh sü,
Sana romü nou zhuvea buh;
Sühi veayu teizhi bupulaimoe,
Sühi daibvü laisa!
Etao nou paowe zaipe veishoyu,
Raki vakou mai thethesü;
Mapao Jisu khe hinou loulai,
Sühi daibvü laisa!
Etao nou paowe asayu lou sü,
Puhye paosho buyu lou sü;
Maihrülai nou ko-a sholouki,
Sühi daibvü laisa!

tune: What Must It Be To Be There

title: SÜHI KHEI HAE
firstLine: Ramai nou kükou soupeiyu nuh sü
author: John R. Clements

lines: Ramai nou kükou soupeiyu nuh sü,
Sana nou souyu nuh hi;
Teikhai khei hi teizhi bupulaimoe,
Sühi khei hae, teithe bue.
Sühi romü teithe-tsü hou buyu,
Veayu zhaotou bupulaimoe;
Mapaovei zhaipao nou zhuvea deie,
Sühi khei hae, teithe bue.
Ngheidzü nou teizhi zaipe thailaimoe,
Veayu sheeyu laimoe;
Jisu khe hinou etao louloure,
Sühi khei hae, teithe bue.

title: SANA VEI NUH
firstLine: E paochowe buh veishoyu ali bue
author: Horatius Bonar

lines: E paochowe buh veishoyu ali bue,
Teikhai vakou sana vei nuh;
Sühi mai thethesü loulaiye,
Mapao Jisu khe hinou.
Sühi ngheidzü pasho bupulaimoe,
Rü alia zhaotou laimoe;
Sana romü nou daizhou veie,
Etao kihi veishoyu.
E donou buh sü souda peire,
Jisu nou e kuyu paiwe;
Puh khe hinou e louloure,
Sana vei nuh kükou hi.

chorus: E zhou talai sü buh hilo,

title: VEISHOYU FÜDEI
firstLine: Teikhai vakou veishoyu füdei bue
author: F.J. Crosby

lines: Teikhai vakou veishoyu füdei bue,
Sheeyu teisa daibou bue;
Mai thethesü sühi laloure,
Puhye paosho buyu lou.
Teizhi teithe sühi velaimoe,
Ngaoba veayu laimoe;
Veishoyu zaipe nou kükou souwe,
Zhidzü thethe sühi reie.
Etao Jisu ngaoyuki daibvüsa,
Puh khe hinou louloure;
Teisa teithe puhye paosho lai,
Veishoyu füdei hinou.

title: VEO LUDU HI
firstLine: Veopu Jisu vei ludu veishoyu
author: E.E. Hewitt

lines: Veopu Jisu vei ludu veishoyu,
Khouko buyu mai zhou buyu;
Kros pfüa zhoulo mai thethesü,
Teikhai kihi veloure.
Ludu hi zhaotou reitou shona,
Jisu nou etaoye pfüwe;
Puh khe hinou kükou souraye,
Khaipao sühi dupeie.
Ludu reipe hinou sana romü,
Etao donou houpeire;
Veishoyu nuh hinou laloure,
Teisa veishoyu bue.

title: VEISHOYU KI
firstLine: Veishoyu ki teikhai vakou bue
author: W.L. Thompson

lines: Veishoyu ki teikhai vakou bue,
Jisu nou etaoye souda peie;
Sühi veayu teizhi bupulaimoe,
Veishoyu ki hinou.
Aki sühi zhaotou bupulaimoe,
Mai thethesü sühi loulai;
Mapaovei zhaipao zhuvea deie,
Veishoyu ki hinou.
Etao kihi velouyuki asasa,
Jisu nou etaoye kuyu paiwe;
Puh khe hinou teisa hrülai,
Veishoyu ki hinou.

title: REILO BU KIHILO
firstLine: Reilo bu kihilo etao zhou talai
author: S.F. Bennett

lines: Reilo bu kihilo etao zhou talai,
Teikhai vakou Ramai buh sü;
Sühi mai thethesü louloure,
Mapao Jisu khe hinou.
Teizhi teithe sühi bupulaimoe,
Sheeyu teisa daibou bue;
Asayu lou nouko zho-a talai,
Reilo bu kihilo.
Puo Ramaiye paosho buyu lou sü,
Etao nou ko-a sholouki;
Teisa teithe puhye paosho lai,
Reilo bu kihilo.

title: SASHOYU LOU
firstLine: Evei kükou vah sü thaiyuki
author: C.H. Gabriel

lines: Evei kükou vah sü thaiyuki,
Teikhai vakou e velouyuki;
Jisu khe hinou e loulaiye,
Sühi sashoyu lou sousho lai.
Puh vei zhaipao e nou ngaoyuki,
Veishoyu basha nou pasho lai;
Leshiyu Mapao e kühie,
Sühi sashoyu lou sousho lai.
Maithethe peihi sühi loulai,
Zaipe nou asayu lou soulai;
Puhye paosho buyu lou sühi,
Sühi sashoyu lou sousho lai.

title: BUH SÜ BEULAH FÜMO-WO?
englishTitle: Is Not This The Land Of Beulah?
firstLine: E paochowe buh sü Beulah fümo-wo?
author: Harriet B. McKeever

lines: E paochowe buh sü Beulah fümo-wo?
Sühi ngheidzü pasho laimoe;
Sana romü zhuvea deie,
Mapao Jisu khe hinou.
Zhidzü peishoyu sühi reie,
Zaipe nou asayu lou soulai;
Etao donou buh sü souda peire,
Buh sü Beulah fümo-wo?
Mai thethesü sühi louloure,
Veayu ngaoba sühi laimoe;
Khouko buyu Ramai paoshoyu,
Buh sü Beulah fümo-wo?

tune: Is Not This The Land Of Beulah?

title: VEO PEIRÜ RÜYU TEITHE
firstLine: Etao Jisu veipu teithe sü
author: El Nathan

lines: Etao Jisu veipu teithe sü,
Zhuvea daizhou veie;
Puh nou mai thethesü kuwe,
Peirü rüyu teithe sü.
Sheeyu mai thethe peirü rülai,
Saitan reihmai dulai;
Jisu nou Veopu souda peire,
Peirü rüyu teithe sü.
Asayu lou nou zho-a talai,
Deiphaojü veiloure;
Mapao Jisu paosho bulai,
Peirü rüyu teithe sü.

chorus: Peirü rüyu teithe, peirü rüyu teithe,
Peirü rüyu teithe, peirü rüyu teithe,

title: PAOPU VEI POUPA BAZÜ
firstLine: Paopu Jisu vei poupa bazü
author: Bernard of Clairvaux

lines: Paopu Jisu vei poupa bazü,
Kros koute zhuvea deie;
Etao zhaotou donou Puh süh re,
Khaipao sühi dupeie.
Puh thoure teizhi zhaotou vanou,
Teithe thethe peie;
Maihrülai Puhye lülou mai sü,
Thashoa teisa hrülai.
Veayu ngheidzü nou pasho laimoe,
Jisu nou thoure tea;
Etao sana Puh khe hinou,
Teisa asayu hrülai.

title: TEINGHEI PALO ROMÜ
firstLine: E paowe teinghei palo romü hi
author: I.G. Martin

lines: E paowe teinghei palo romü hi,
Jisu khe hinou lalai;
Teikhai vakou etao veloure,
Romü veishoyu hi.
Sühi mai thethesü ngaoloure,
Pikhai a zhou mai thethe;
Asayu lou nou zho-a talai,
Romü veishoyu hi.
Romü palo hinou etao loulai,
Mapao Jisu khe hinou;
Teisa teithe puhye paosho lai,
Romü veishoyu hi.

title: SÜHI SHOYU BUH ALI BUE
englishTitle: There Is A Paradise Of Rest
firstLine: Sühi shoyu buh ali bue teikhai vakou
author: W.R. Newell

lines: Sühi shoyu buh ali bue teikhai vakou,
Ramai nou souda peiyu kishoyu;
Sühi zhaotou teizhi bupulaimoe,
Veishoyu buh hinou.
Aki sühi mai thethesü loulai,
Sheeyu mai thethesü lalai;
Jisu nou etaoye pfü a velai,
Veishoyu buh hinou.
Teithe-tsü asayu lou sousho lai,
Puo Ramaiye paosho bulai;
Jordan reipe hinou zhou buyu,
Veishoyu buh hinou.

tune: There Is A Paradise Of Rest

title: E KIHI VEYUKI
firstLine: E kihi veyuki daibvü laisa
author: C.H. Gabriel

lines: E kihi veyuki daibvü laisa,
Jisu khe hinou e loulai;
Deiphao vah thethesü thaipeilai,
E kihi veyuki.
Puh vei zhaipao e nou ngaoyuki,
Veayu ngaoba sühi laimoe;
Asayu lou nou zho-a talai,
E kihi veyuki.
Maithethe peihi sühi ngaolai,
Zaipe nou asayu lou soulai;
Puhye paosho buyu lou sühi,
E kihi veyuki.

chorus: E kihi veyuki, e kihi veyuki,

title: E LALOU RE
firstLine: E lalou re Jisu thaifü laitea
author: Palmer Hartsough

lines: E lalou re Jisu thaifü laitea,
Deiphao zhaotou sü khailoure;
Puh nou e kuyu pai e choe,
Puh khe hinou e velai.
E lalou re Mapao Jisu vah soulai,
Puh zhe nou hrülou-a khailu peie;
Puh vei basha e shou buyu,
Puh khe hinou e velai.
E lalou re sheeyu ludu zhou laitea,
Puh nou e pfüa zhou buyu;
Teisa teithe Puhye paosho lai,
Puh khe hinou e velai.

chorus: E velai, e velai, Jisu hi e velai;
Puh nou e kuyu pai e choe,

title: KHAILU PEIWO PA LOULO
firstLine: Khailu peiwo pa loulo ne rümü hi
author: J.B. Mackay

lines: Khailu peiwo pa loulo ne rümü hi,
Jisu nou ne kuyu pai keilo;
Puh nou ne donou süh thaipeire,
Pa loulo ne rümü hi.
Romü palo hinou Puh tholo buyu,
Daisou nou Puhye polou moe?
Puh zhe nou neye khailu peilai,
Pa loulo ne rümü hi.
Arako teithe ne zhou kühie,
Jisu kuyu pai keilouwo;
Teisa asayu ne ngaoloulai,
Pa loulo ne rümü hi.

chorus: Puh nou ne rümü romü tholo bue,

title: E THAOTHOU KHAIRE
firstLine: Jisu hi Ahrü thaothou khaire
author: J.W. Van De Venter

lines: Jisu hi Ahrü thaothou khaire,
Puh hi sa-a peire;
E Puhye teisa nou leshilai;
Puh sa teisa hrülai.
Jisu hi Ahrü thaothou khaire,
Puh phi nou ve khurüe;
Deiphao hi vayu thaokhai wure,
Jisu E chu popeio.
Jisu hi Ahrü thaothou khaire,
Eye Nevei soupeio;
Rako Mashiye panou sülo,
E Nevei, Ne Aveie.

chorus: E thaothou khaire, E thaothou khaire,

title: E KIHI VEWE
firstLine: Jisu E Zhou nou kihi vewe
author: W.J. Kirkpatrick

lines: Jisu E zhou nou kihi vewe,
Ne hi likhei E asayu ngaoloue;
Mah ludu hinou E tala loue,
Chuo E kihi vewe .
Po taoli Nehi nou talare,
Chuo E leda lou-a Nehi vewe;
Jisu nou Eye ludu houpeie,
Chuo E kihi vewe.
Ahi checheyu alia hayu donou,
Nevei chipao louche loure;
Kukhe moe, Jisu zhe likhei kho-a,
E kihi vewe.
Chuwo Jisu vei kros hai E phouwe,
Puh zhenou Amah soushee peilai;
Zhenou küve mah teitei holoure,
E kihi vewe.

chorus: Jisu E zhou nou kihi vewe,
Mapao E chuo Ne chipao poloure,

title: JISU SHOU BU WE
englishTitle: Safe In The Arms Of Jesus
firstLine: Jisu vei basha kükou e shou buwe
author: F.J. Crosby

lines: Jisu vei basha kükou e shou buwe,
Puh vei leshi kükou e zhouwe;
Teizhi ngaoba sühi bupulaimoe,
Jisu shou e buwe.
Deiphao zhaotou nou e pasho laimoe,
Puh nou e rümü khopeie;
Asayu lou nou zho-a talai,
Jisu shou e buwe.
Teisa asayu sühi e ngaoloure,
Puhye paosho buyu lou sühi;
Jordan reipe hinou zhou buyu,
Jisu shou e buwe.

chorus: Jisu shou buwe, Jisu shou buwe,
Puh vei leshi kükou e buwe;
tune: Safe In The Arms Of Jesus

title: NENOU KUYU PAI CHOUE
firstLine: Nenou kuyu pai choue Mapao Jisu
author: Lewis Hartsough

lines: Nenou kuyu pai choue Mapao Jisu,
Kros koute zhe sü seipeie;
Zhaotou mai etao khailupeire,
Mapao Jisu hi e velai.
E zhaotou mai nou reibou shona,
Nevei zhe nou e sa peilo;
Ne zhe nou thethe soupuelai,
Kalvari hinou sü peie.
Nevei basha daizhou leshie,
Puh nou e rümü khailupeie;
Teisa asayu e ngaoloure,
Mapao Jisu hi e velai.

chorus: E velai, Mapao, Ne hi e velai,
Nevei zhe nou e sa peilo,

title: MAI KHOULAISHO BUE
firstLine: Mai khoulaisho bue Jisu lülou tea
author: P.P. Bliss

lines: Mai khoulaisho bue Jisu lülou tea,
Puh kuyu pai cho-a zhouwe;
Teithetsü arako lülouwo,
Khailu peiyu sü ngaolouwo.
Mai khoulaisho bue zhaotou khailou tea,
Ramai kuyu pai keilouwo;
Puh nou ne rümü tholo bue,
Mai khoulaisho bue.
