Mai khoulaisho bue ana khoraye,
Teithe thethe sü thaipuelai;
Jisu khe hinou louloure,
Khailu peiyu sü ngaolouwo.

title: PO SHEELAYU LOU
firstLine: Ramai kükou aki sheelayu lou
author: Poumai Hymn Committee

lines: Ramai kükou aki sheelayu lou,
Etao nou ko-a sholou bue;
Aki hi Ramai zhaipao pasho,
Khouko buyu Ramai sholo.
Puo Ramaiye paosho buyu aki,
Mai thethesü sühi loulai;
Lülouho etao zaipe hinou,
Aki sheelayu lou soulai.
Khaipao zaipe sühi etao ngaowe,
Puh nou etaoye sa-a peie;
Teisa teithe Puhye paosho lai,
Po sheelayu lou sousho lai.

chorus: Ramai aki hi, sheelayu aki hi,

title: JISU THAIPU LUKOU
firstLine: Zhuvea veishoyu lukou ngaowe
author: Mary B.C. Slade

lines: Zhuvea veishoyu lukou ngaowe,
Jisu thaipu lukou hi;
Etao Puh thaifü zhou talai,
Veishoyu teikhai kihi.
Puh nou sheeyu zhaotou reih hinou,
Etao pfüa zhou buyu;
Teithe thethe Puh thaifü zhoulo,
Puh lukou hi zhoulo.
Jordan reipe hinou zhouyuki,
Jisu nou etaoye pfüwe;
Teisa kihi velouyuki,
Asa lou soulaihe.

title: JISU VEI ZHIVA NOU
firstLine: Daisou nou evei zhaotou sa lai?
author: Robert Lowry

lines: Daisou nou evei zhaotou sa lai?
Jisu vei zhiva nou khailu peie;
Daisou nou evei rümü thethe lai?
Jisu vei zhiva nou thethe peie.
Evei basha donou mo-a süe,
Jisu vei zhiva nou khailu peie;
Evei vah souyu donou mo-a,
Jisu vei zhiva nou khailu peie.
Havei soupeiyu zhiva kükou sü,
Teisa asayu soupuelai;
Khaipao sühi etao dupeire,
Jisu vei zhiva nou khailu peie.

chorus: Jisu vei zhiva nou khailu peie.

title: NEDO SOULOUWO
firstLine: Nedo soulouwo Mapao Jisu
author: Adelaide A. Pollard

lines: Nedo soulouwo Mapao Jisu,
Newo eh soupei Mapao bue;
Evei rümü Ne hi e peie,
Nedo soulouwo Mapao.
Nedo soulouwo Mapao Jisu,
Nevei zhe nou e sa peilo;
Thethe soupuelai Kalvari,
Nedo soulouwo Mapao.
Nedo soulouwo Mapao Jisu,
Nevei zhaipao e shou pasholo;
Jisu nou e thoulou veyuki,
Nedo soulouwo Mapao.

chorus: Evei rümü Ne hi e peie,

title: TEIKHAI THAOPU VEI KHUPA
firstLine: Teikhai thaopu vei khupa leshi
author: F.M. Lehman

lines: Teikhai thaopu vei khupa leshi,
Maihrülai paokha laimoe;
Puh nou Nah Jisu seipeie,
Etaoye khailupeire.
Deiphao zhaotou zaipe nou reibou,
Puh vei khupa nou sa-a peie;
Puh zhe nou hrülou-a peire,
Etaoye khailupeire.
Teisa teithe puhye paosho lai,
Puh vei khupa daizhou leshie;
Asayu lou nou zho-a talai,
Etaoye khailupeire.

title: ASAHRA POA REIKHE
firstLine: Asahra poa reikhe Khrista reihmai
author: Sabine Baring-Gould

lines: Asahra poa reikhe Khrista reihmai,
Kros pfüa zhou buyu reihmai;
Veopu Jisu nou etao pfüwe,
Reih hi takou talai.
Saitan reihmai zhaowe Puh minou,
Etao reihmai asahra poalo;
Khouko buyu Ramai paoshoyu,
Reih hi takou talai.
Mai thethesü reihmai sa-a zhoulo,
Mapao Jisu khe hinou buki;
Teisa teithe puhye paosho lai,
Reih hi takou talai.

title: KHRISTA VEI REIHMAI THOLO
englishTitle: Stand Up, Stand Up for Jesus
firstLine: Khrista vei reihmai tholo kros pfüa
author: George Duffield

lines: Khrista vei reihmai tholo kros pfüa,
Veopu Jisu vei basha nou;
Reihmai thethesü asahra poalo,
Puh nou reih sü dulai.
Saitan reihmai zhaowe Puh minou,
Puh vei paosho buyu hi tholo;
Rü alia zhaotou reitou shona,
Puh nou reih sü dulai.
Peirü rüyu teithe veloure,
Sheeyu mai thethesü lalai;
Jisu khe hinou etao louloure,
Puh nou reih sü dulai.

tune: Stand Up, Stand Up for Jesus

title: CHIPAO VEI KROS
firstLine: Reitoutao buh hinou chipao vei kros
author: George Bennard

lines: Reitoutao buh hinou chipao vei kros,
Kalvari koute tholo bue;
Sühi Jisu nou süh thaipeire,
Zhaotou mai khailupeire.
Chipao vei kros sühi e leshiwe,
Puh zhe nou zhaotou sa-a peie;
Deiphao mai nou Puhye polou shona,
E nou kros pfüa zhouwe.
Kros koute Jisu nou thoure tea,
Etao donou teisa hrüyu;
Teisa teithe Puhye paosho lai,
Sana peirü rülai.

chorus: E nou kros sühi leshi bue,

title: NEVEI DAIZHO ZHOU BASHA
firstLine: Nevei daizho zhou basha nou
author: John Newton

lines: Nevei daizho zhou basha nou,
Zhaotou mai e khailupeie;
E zhaotou reibou shona arako,
Puh nou e ngaoloure.
Basha nou e rümü teithe soupue,
Zhaotou vanou e khailupeie;
Jisu lülouyu teithe sühi,
Basha daizhou leshie.
Teisa teithe sühi etao loulai,

title: RAMAIYE PAOSHOLO (OLD 100TH)
englishTitle: Praise God, From Whom All Blessings Flow
firstLine: Ramaiye paosholo deiphao mai thethesü
author: Thomas Ken

lines: Ramaiye paosholo deiphao mai thethesü,
Puh vei khupa leshi lou soulaikhe;
Etao vei rü alia vupeiyu Mapao,
Varuyu ki hinou Puhye paosho bue.
Puh nou khopeiyu thaonou paolou süe?
Teikhai hinou süe teiva hinou süe;
Deichi hi reitoutao deikho hi kükoue,
Veishoyu zidzü nou kükou soushee peie.
Teikhai vakou sana romü buh sü,
Ramai nou etao donou souda peire;
Asayu lou nouko zho-a talai,
Teisa teithe hrülai.

chorus: Mapao Jisu khe hinou etao buki;
tune: Praise God, From Whom All Blessings Flow
